Ranged spell attack: 1d6 Necrotic and you gain temp HP equal to your PB. 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11, 4d6 at 17.

display.components: V, S, M (a drop of your own blood)
display.description: Take 1d6 Necrotic that can't be reduced; for the duration one target of each damaging spell you cast takes +1d6 of the spell's type. Both +1d6 per slot level above 2.

display.components: V, S, M (a pinch of grave dirt)
display.description: A grounded creature makes a Str save or is swallowed 10 feet deep: Total Cover, Restrained, Blinded, and unable to breathe; each action and DC 15 Athletics check digs 5 feet up (all the way on a 5+ margin), emerging Prone. On a success it is Prone with Speed 0 until its next turn ends. Creatures on stone, metal, or 2+ inches of wood auto-succeed.

display.components: V, S, M (a bit of animal fur or hide)
display.description: Each Beast in a 100-foot Emanation makes a Wis save or is Charmed and obeys your commands (renewed with a Magic action each turn); on a success it is only Charmed until your next turn. The howl carries 300 feet.

display.components: V, S, M (a pinch of bone dust)
display.description: An Undead you can see makes a Cha save or is Charmed (even if immune) and Friendly to you; on a success it has Disadvantage on its next attack against you before your next turn. Harming it or forcing it to save ends the spell. One more target per slot level above 1.

A creature makes a Str save or takes 2d6 Force, is pulled up to 30 feet toward you, and is chained: it can't get more than 30 feet from you and you have Advantage on attacks against it (repeat save each turn; ends if you get over 30 feet apart). Half damage only on success. +1d6 per slot level above 2.

display.components: V, S, M (a silver bell worth 10+ GP)
display.description: Each creature in a 15-foot-radius Sphere makes a Wis save: 2d6 Psychic and Frightened for the duration (repeat save each turn), or half damage and Frightened until its next turn ends. +1d6 per slot level above 2.

A creature makes a Dex save: 2d8 Fire plus 2d8 Necrotic or Radiant (chosen on casting) and it keeps burning, repeating the damage each turn until it or an adjacent creature spends an action for a new save; half damage once on a success. Anything it kills turns to ash with its nonmagical gear.

Rot strikes a target and leaps to up to three more within 30 feet of it (creatures or ordinary plants). Creatures make a Con save: 3d8 Necrotic and Poisoned, taking 1d8 Necrotic each turn until a save ends it; half damage only on success. Plant creatures fail automatically and plants wither. One more leap per slot level above 3.

display.components: V, S, M (a vial of blood)
display.description: Chosen creatures in a 15-foot Emanation make a Dex save for 3d10 Necrotic, half on success. If it hurts a Small or larger creature, one creature you choose in the area heals half the damage roll. +1d10 per slot level above 3.

display.components: V, S, M (a five-pointed wicker star)
display.description: A mark on a fixed surface makes an invisible 30-foot-radius Sphere where Aberrations, Fey, Fiends, Monstrosities, and Undead have Disadvantage on checks and attacks, and must pass a Wis save or be Frightened when first entering on a turn or starting a turn there. Longer with higher slots: 1 hour at level 4, 8 hours at 5, and 24 hours without Concentration at 6+.

A ghostly sickle hovers with you. On casting and as a Bonus Action each turn, make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 30 feet: 2d8 Necrotic and you gain temp HP equal to half. +1d8 per slot level above 3.

A creature you know on your plane makes a Wis save or hears discordant music and has Disadvantage on D20 Tests; the first time each turn it fails one, it repeats the save. A creature that fails can't be targeted by a ritual casting again for 24 hours.

display.castingTime: Reaction, when another creature within range takes damage
display.description: Spend and roll a Hit Die and heal it + your spellcasting modifier, doubled if the trigger was a Critical Hit. One more Hit Die per slot level above 1.
Melee spell attack against a creature or nonmagical object: 1d8 Force and -1 AC against the next attack before the end of your next turn. 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11, 4d8 at 17.

display.castingTime: Reaction, when a creature you can see in range targets you with an attack
display.components: V, S, M (a smear of camphor)
display.description: The attacker makes a Con save (Blindsight or immunity to Blinded auto-succeeds): Blinded until the end of the turn, or on a success it subtracts 1d4 from that attack. It then auto-succeeds against your Eye Burn for 24 hours.

display.components: V, S, M (a dried corn husk or wheat hull)
display.description: A 30-foot Cube of shadow curses hostile creatures in it when it appears, when they first enter on a turn, or end a turn there, until the end of their next turn: the first damage they take each turn adds 1d6 Necrotic, and a creature you choose in the field heals that much. +1d6 per slot level above 5.

display.components: V, S, M (a scrap of a banner)
display.description: Ghost knights charge a 90-foot by 20-foot Line: chosen creatures make a Wis save or take 5d12 Necrotic, are Frightened until your next turn, and use their Reaction to flee; half damage only on success. +1d12 per slot level above 6.

display.components: V, S, M (a piece of moonstone)
display.description: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of silvery Dim Light reveals Invisible things as shimmering shapes, and allies in it can use a Bonus Action to gain 2d6 temp HP. +1d6 per slot level above 3.

A creature with Intelligence 4+ makes an Int save or is Charmed by a looping song: 1d6 Psychic at the start of its turns and Disadvantage on Perception and Concentration saves, repeating the save each turn. +1d6 per slot level above 2.
Your held weapon or Unarmed Strikes hunger: your first hit on a creature each turn adds Necrotic equal to your spellcasting modifier and grants that much temp HP.

display.components: V, S, M (a devil's trumpet blossom)
display.description: Whenever the cursed creature takes the Attack or Magic action, it makes a Wis save or wastes the action. The spell ends after its third successful save.

display.components: V, S, M (a small metal cube)
display.description: A creature makes a Wis save or perceives no other creatures by any sense or magic, rationalizes their spaces as blocked, and can't tell what hurts it; it repeats the save each turn.

display.components: V, S, M (a four-leaf clover and a shard of broken mirror)
display.description: Another creature carrying the touched trinket has Advantage on D20 Tests while you have Disadvantage on them.

display.components: V, S, M (a Dagger worth 1+ CP)
display.description: A creature dead less than a minute returns to life with HP equal to your current HP; you drop to 0 HP with two failed Death Saves and must immediately make another, unable to heal or stabilize before it.

display.castingTime: Reaction, when a creature you can see within 60 feet damages your ally
display.components: V, S, M (a pin or needle)
display.description: The attacker makes a Wis save, taking Psychic damage equal to the damage it dealt, or half on success.

display.components: V, S, M (a vial of tears)
display.description: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of mist: creatures in it when it appears, entering on a turn, or ending a turn there make a Cha save or until their next turn ends have half Speed, Disadvantage on attacks, and -1d8 on damage rolls.
Chosen creatures in a 30-foot Cone make a Dex save: 5d6 Force and Blinded until a save at the end of a turn or any healing ends it; half damage only on success. +1d6 per slot level above 4.
Insight and Perception checks against the willing creature you touch take a -1d4 penalty.

A creature makes a Wis save or is Charmed and must use its action to move to and melee attack a creature you mentally pick (acting normally if you pick none or it can't reach); it repeats the save each turn, and you must spend a Bonus Action each later turn to keep control.

A creature makes a Cha save or is cursed: -1d4 on attacks and checks, and when it takes damage you can use a Reaction for 10 temp HP. On a success you gain 5 temp HP and it subtracts 1d4 from checks until your next turn.

display.components: V, S, M (adamantine or diamond powder worth 200+ GP, which the spell consumes)
display.description: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of light: you and up to your spellcasting modifier (min 1) other creatures who finish a Long Rest in it gain +1 AC for the rest of the duration.

display.components: V, S, M (powdered silver worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes)
display.description: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of light: you and up to your spellcasting modifier (min 1) other creatures who finish a Long Rest in it gain 2d10 temp HP and Advantage on Charisma checks with their proficient skills for the rest of the duration.

display.components: V, S, M (a drop of blood, which the spell consumes)
display.description: Learn a creature's species and type, current HP, conditions, and its damage and condition Vulnerabilities, Resistances, and Immunities; your next check or attack against it before the end of your next turn has Advantage.

A 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high Cylinder of red light: living creatures make a Con save for 4d10 Necrotic (half on success) while Constructs and Undead heal 4d10. It dispels magical Darkness of level 3 or lower it overlaps. +1d10 and +1 dispel level per slot level above 3.

A 15-foot Emanation: non-designated creatures entering, starting a turn in it, or that it reaches make a Cha save (once per turn) for 2d6 Necrotic and Disadvantage on attacks and checks until their next turn ends, or half damage only. +1d6 per slot level above 3.
A 15-foot Cone of light and wind heals allies in it 2d6; hostile Undead there make a Con save for 2d6 Radiant, half on success. +2d6 each per slot level above 2.

A creature makes a Wis save: 2d6 Psychic and Frightened until your next turn, with Vulnerability to Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing (your pick) meanwhile; half damage only on success. One more target per slot level above 2.

display.components: V, S, M (a dried corn husk or wheat straw)
display.description: At the end of any turn in which you hit a creature with an attack roll, you become Invisible until the start of your next turn.
Ranged spell attack: 1d10 Cold, or 1d12 if the target is at least partly submerged. Cantrip Upgrade: two clouds at level 5, three at 11, four at 17, each a separate attack.
A creature makes a Wisdom save or gains Vulnerability to a damage type you choose (if Immune to it, it loses the Immunity instead). It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

A willing creature grows flippers and a tusk: Resistance to Cold while submerged, Speed 5 feet, Swim Speed 50 feet, and on a turn it moves 15 feet straight toward an enemy it can gore as a Bonus Action for 2d6 + Strength modifier Piercing.

A spirit guards a Large or larger ship: Immunity to Fire damage; a Large or larger creature that damages it makes a Wisdom save, 5d6 Psychic or half; and while aboard you can expend a spell slot as a Bonus Action to restore Hit Points equal to three times the slot level + your spellcasting modifier.

display.components: V, S, M (a pinch of bear fur)
display.description: Three phantasmal bears fill a 20-foot Cube you can move 40 feet as a Bonus Action. Enemies in it when it appears, when it moves onto them, or when they enter or end their turn there make an Intelligence save (once per turn): 4d8 Psychic and Frightened until the end of their next turn, or half only. Per slot level above 5: +20 feet cube, two more bears, +2d8.

display.components: V, S, M (a bezoar formed in a wolf's stomach)
display.description: A 1-mile Sphere around you darkens to Dim Light with heavy snow (Difficult Terrain, Heavily Obscured) that doesn't hinder you. You have Advantage on all d20 Tests and on saves to resist or end conditions, attacks against you have Disadvantage, and you have Immunity to all damage except one random type (d12), to which you are Vulnerable.

display.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when you see a creature make an attack or spell attack
display.description: The attacker makes a Wisdom save or attacks a different eligible target of your choice (not itself); with no other target, the attack is wasted.

display.components: V, S, M (a silver spindle worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes)
display.description: Choose one. Change the Past: a creature you can see that died since the start of your last turn returns with 1 Hit Point (not old age, no missing parts). Guide the Present: your first attack roll or ability check before the end of your turn counts as a natural 20. Shape the Future: Advantage on ability checks and saves for 1 minute from the start of your next turn. Each extra casting before a Long Rest has a cumulative 25 percent chance to fail.
A wind-powered vehicle's sailing Speed increases by 10 feet (or 1 mph).

display.castingTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
display.description: The target takes an extra 3d8 Necrotic and makes a Constitution save or gains an Exhaustion level until the spell ends. At the end of each of its turns it saves again: success removes this spell's Exhaustion, failure adds a level. +1d8 per slot level above 3.

display.components: V, S, M (two small spindles bound together with thread)
display.description: Bind your fate to a willing creature. While within 60 feet, either of you can use a Reaction to let the other reroll an ability check, attack roll, or save; each time, both your Hit Point maximums drop by 1d4 (dying at 0) until the spell ends.

display.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when an attack would reduce you to 0 Hit Points but not kill you outright
display.components: V, M (a drop of your blood)
display.description: Instead of dropping to 0, you drop to Hit Points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier, become Invisible, and leave an illusion of your corpse (Study and an Investigation check against your DC reveals it). Invisibility ends if you attack, cast a healing spell, or harm a creature.

display.components: V, S, M (branch, leaf, or bark from a World Tree)
display.description: Touching a tree, you and up to eight willing creatures touching it travel to a random spot on Yggdrasil, or a chosen general destination if you touch a World Tree. Your Hit Point maximum drops by a roll of one of your Hit Dice until a Long Rest.

display.castingTime: Reaction, which you take in response to another creature's turn starting
display.description: The creature can immediately use its Reaction to Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help.

display.components: V, S, M (a tuft of bear fur)
display.description: Your arms become bear paws; make a melee spell attack: 3d10 + spellcasting modifier Slashing, and a target no more than one size larger is knocked Prone. You can attack with the claws for the duration. 4d10 with level 5 or 6 slots, 5d10 with 7 or 8, and 6d8 at 9.
A Beast or Humanoid you can see makes a Constitution save or gains an Exhaustion level; at the end of its next turn it saves again or gains another. The Exhaustion remains after the spell.
Choose an object you can see. The target makes a Wisdom save (charm-immune creatures succeed) or must try to take it, stealing or fighting its holder, then fleeing to guard it until the spell ends.

display.castingTime: Reaction, which you take in response to a saving throw being rolled by a creature that you can see within 30 feet of yourself
display.components: V, S, M (a tangle of thread)
display.description: The creature rerolls the save, adding or subtracting your spellcasting modifier (your choice), and must use the new result.
Allied, adequately crewed ships within a 60-foot Emanation move 10 feet faster by oar.

display.components: V, S, M (a handful of mud and a handful of sea water)
display.description: A sailing vessel with a crew up to 10 treats soil, mud, and packed dirt as water, sweeping aside snow, ice, plants, and small stones (not boulders). Level 7: crew up to 30 for 24 hours. Level 9: any crew for 1 week.

display.components: V, S, M (a handful of water)
display.description: A wave freezes over a 20-foot square. Creatures there make a Dexterity save or are Restrained (action and Strength (Athletics) against your DC, or Help, to free). Others treat it as Difficult Terrain and make a Dexterity save or fall Prone on entering or ending a turn there. Level 3: trapped creatures can't Attack or cast somatic spells. Level 5: they are entombed with Total Cover, saving each turn and taking 2d6 Cold either way.

display.components: V, S, M (a knotted string of wool)
display.description: A creature you can see makes a Wisdom save or is linked to you; once per turn the first attack that hits you hits it instead, if it could be targeted. With a level 8 or 9 slot, every such attack is redirected.
Put out any magical or nonmagical flames you choose in a 60-foot Cube from you; creatures made of fire take 1d12 Force. Per slot level above 1: +10 feet and +1d12.
Advantage on Intelligence checks and saves. As a Magic action you can gain Truesight 30 feet until the start of your next turn, then the spell ends.

Creatures you choose within 60 feet of a point that can hear you make a Wisdom save or are Frightened of you for the duration. While any remain Frightened, your Speed is doubled and your attacks deal an extra 3d6 Necrotic to Frightened enemies.

display.components: V, S, M (a bit of pitch)
display.description: A siege weapon you touch deals an extra 1d10 Fire on hits. A Bonus Action moves the effect to another siege engine you touch.
A melee weapon you touch bears a fire rune and deals an extra 1d8 Fire on a hit.

display.components: V, S, M (a drop of water melted from an icicle)
display.description: A 5-foot fist of ice flies along a 120-foot Line: Dexterity save, 4d8 Cold or half. One Huge or smaller creature that failed can be Grappled (escape DC your spell save DC), taking 2d8 Cold at the end of each of its turns until it escapes and the fist shatters. +1d8 per slot level above 4; at level 7+ it ignores Cold Resistance.

A 20-foot-radius Sphere of fog is Heavily Obscured Difficult Terrain until a strong wind disperses it. A creature starting its turn there or entering makes a Constitution save or has its Speed halved until the end of its next turn, and takes 2d4 Cold per 5 feet it moves inside. You are immune.

A creature makes a Charisma save or has Disadvantage on attacks and can't willingly move farther from you. It repeats the save at the end of each turn (with Disadvantage if it can see you within 30 feet). One extra target per slot level above 1.

display.castingTime: Reaction, which you take after failing a saving throw
display.description: Reroll the failed save as a Charisma save, whatever its original type.
Spirits crew a vessel you touch; while you are within 30 feet it can take a full complement of ship actions, including movement and siege weapons. They can't fight or repair.
Advantage on attacks against Large or larger creatures, and your attacks deal an extra 2d6 Force to them.
+20 feet Speed, +2 AC against Large or larger attackers, and you don't provoke their Opportunity Attacks.

display.components: V, S, M (a handful of molars)
display.description: Huge teeth clamp a creature within 90 feet: it is Grappled (escape DC your spell save DC) and takes 2d10 Bludgeoning at the start of each of its turns; escaping ends the spell. 3d10 at level 5, 5d8 at 7, 6d8 at 9.

display.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when a creature succeeds or fails on a d20 Test
display.description: Add or subtract 1d6 from the d20 Test.
A Large or smaller unattended object sheds Bright Light 20 feet and Dim Light 20 more; you and creatures you choose in its Bright Light are immune to Extreme Cold.

Your mouth becomes a wolf's maw (you can't speak or cast verbal spells). Bite attacks deal 4d10 + spellcasting modifier Piercing and Grapple (escape DC your spell save DC). Biting a creature you already grapple can swallow it into a pocket dimension: Blinded, Restrained, Total Cover, and 3d12 Force at the start of each of your turns; it saves at the end of its turns to be vomited out, as it is when the spell ends. One creature at a time. +1d12 bite per slot level above 6.
Shape a section of ice no more than 5 feet in any dimension into a crude but functional form: a weapon, statue, coffer, a passage through 5 feet of ice, or a seal over a narrow opening.

display.components: V, S, M (a shard of ice)
display.description: In a 30-foot Emanation, you and creatures you choose treat slippery ice as normal terrain and count as one-tenth their weight for breaking thin ice.

display.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when a Giant sees you
display.components: V, S, M (a hair or nail clipping from a goblinoid)
display.description: The Giant makes a Wisdom save or its attitude toward you improves one step. Charm-immune Giants are unaffected, and each Giant can be targeted only once.

A creature that hears your drinking song makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed and Friendly, doing nothing but singing along. Each Bonus Action spreads it to another creature within 30 feet of you or a singer (two per Bonus Action at level 3+), up to your spellcasting modifier in total. If any singer is attacked, the spell ends for all.

display.components: V, S, M (a shard of a giant animal's bone)
display.description: Shape-shift into a Giant you have seen with CR up to your level, gaining Temporary Hit Points equal to its Hit Points. You use its stat block but keep your type, alignment, mental scores, Hit Points, Hit Dice, proficiencies, communication, and Spellcasting. A Magic action changes to another eligible form.

display.castingTime: Reaction, which you take after taking damage
display.description: You are Invisible until the end of your next turn and can use a Bonus Action to move your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Ends after you attack, deal damage, or cast a spell.
A Medium or smaller creature has Advantage on ability checks; on a failed check it can end the spell for itself to succeed instead. One extra creature per slot level above 3.
A 30-foot Emanation gives creatures in it Advantage on Perception checks and prevents them from being surprised. A creature in the aura that keeps singing can extend it by 2 hours, repeatedly.
A 30-foot Emanation of dirge. When you create it and at the start of each of your turns, one creature in it makes a Constitution save or takes 3d8 Necrotic.

display.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when a creature you can see drops to 0 Hit Points or fails its third Death Saving Throw
display.description: The creature is restored to 1 Hit Point, and you lose half your current Hit Points.
In a 30-foot Emanation, you and your allies add your spellcasting ability modifier to melee weapon damage rolls.

display.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when another creature takes a Reaction
display.description: The creature's Reaction doesn't happen and it can't take another; any slot or resource it would have spent is not spent. You lose your next Reaction.
A rune on a creature's skin gives it Resistance to one damage type of your choice.
A rune on a melee weapon lets its wielder make one attack per turn with Advantage. Ends if the weapon leaves their possession.
A vehicle with at least 1 Hit Point regains Hit Points equal to twice your spellcasting modifier at the start of each of your turns.
A vehicle with a damage threshold has it increased by your spellcasting ability modifier.
A vehicle with at least 1 Hit Point regains 4d12 + spellcasting modifier Hit Points. +1d12 per slot level above 3.
A vehicle's crew has Advantage on d20 Tests to control or operate it.

display.components: V, S, M (a piece of boot leather)
display.description: Choose up to two skills you have Expertise in; allies in a 30-foot Emanation count as proficient in them.

display.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when you or an ally takes damage
display.description: A spectral shield-maiden reduces the triggering damage by 1d10 + your spellcasting modifier. +1d10 per slot level above 1.

display.components: V, M (two silver beads of equal weight)
display.description: A creature's Speed doubles, Opportunity Attacks against it have Disadvantage, and it has Advantage on Acrobatics checks on turns it moves. It can end the spell for itself to automatically succeed on a Dexterity save. One extra creature per slot level above 3.

display.castingTime: Reaction, which you take in response to taking damage from a creature that you can see within 30 feet of yourself
display.description: The creature makes a Charisma save: 4d10 Psychic and Incapacitated until the start of your next turn (Stunned if it fails by 5 or more), or half and no condition. +1d10 per slot level above 4.
Spectral shields give up to your spellcasting modifier creatures within 30 feet +2 AC (+3 with a level 6 slot, +4 with level 8).
A creature holding the runed stone has Advantage on Charisma checks.
A weapon deals an extra 2d8 Lightning on a hit, and the target makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 feet (and knocked Prone if it fails by 5 or more). +1d8 per two slot levels above 3.

display.components: V, S, M (a drop of seawater)
display.description: A Huge leviathan spirit appears in enough water to hold it, acting after you on your Initiative and obeying your commands (Dodge otherwise). AC 13 + spell level, 70 Hit Points (+10 per level above 7), Swim 50 feet; Multiattack of Rends equal to half the spell level (1d10 + 5 + spell level Piercing, reach 10 feet) and a 30-foot cone Roar (Constitution save or Frightened).

Once, a creature holding the runed stone can throw it 60 feet as an action; it bursts in a 30-foot Sphere: Constitution save, 4d6 Fire plus 4d6 Radiant or half. Unattended flammables ignite, and snow or ice turns to Heavily Obscuring fog for 1 minute. Only one Sun Rune at a time; a creature can activate one per Long Rest.
Advantage on Dexterity checks and saves. As a Magic action, grow talons, move up to your Speed, and make a melee talon attack: 1d8 + spellcasting modifier Slashing. +1d8 per two slot levels above 1.
A creature holding the runed stone has Advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom checks and saves.

display.components: V, M (the petrified tongue of a serpent)
display.description: Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks. When you fail one, you can deal 1d4 Psychic to the creature you failed to fool and give it Disadvantage on attacks until the start of your next turn.

display.components: V, S, M (a drop of troll blood)
display.description: A creature regains 5 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns (if it has at least 1) and automatically succeeds on Death Saving Throws. Acid or Fire damage stops the regeneration on its next turn.

display.components: V, S, M (a silver pin, which is not consumed)
display.description: A creature makes a Wisdom save or takes 4d8 Psychic whenever it lies for the duration. +1d8 per slot level above 3.

A Huge cohort of spectral warriors appears; move it 30 feet as a Bonus Action. When it ends its move within 5 feet of a creature or a creature moves within 5 feet of it, make a melee spell attack: 2d10 + spellcasting modifier Force (once per creature per turn). +1d10 per slot level above 4.

display.components: V, S, M (a polished blue stone)
display.description: Choose a creature you can see: Advantage on melee attacks against it and Intelligence checks to recall lore about it. Ends if you don't attack it on your turn.
You know the current Hit Points and Exhaustion of creatures you can see within 30 feet. As a Bonus Action, stabilize a dying creature within 30 feet, ending the spell.

display.components: V, S, M (a freshly packed snowball)
display.description: Create a snow wall up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a 10-foot-radius dome. Each 10-foot section has AC 10 and 10 Hit Points, Immunity to Cold, Poison, and Psychic, and Vulnerability to Fire and Radiant. Creatures in an intact dome are immune to Extreme Cold. In snowy terrain it blends in (Investigation against your DC to spot).

display.components: V, S, M (a short piece of thread)
display.description: Creatures in a 20-foot-radius Sphere make a Wisdom save or have Disadvantage on all d20 Tests for 1 minute (save at the end of each turn). Per slot level above 3, exclude up to five creatures.

Outdoors only. A 20-foot-radius Sphere of fog and snow centered on you is Heavily Obscured Difficult Terrain. A creature starting its turn there or entering makes a Constitution save or gains an Exhaustion level (Cold-resistant creatures succeed; up to your spellcasting modifier creatures you designate are exempt). The Exhaustion ends when the spell does.

display.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when a creature scores a Critical Hit against you
display.description: Teleport behind the attacker and make a melee weapon attack with Advantage; on a hit it also takes damage equal to what its critical dealt you.
Once per turn, roll 1d12 and add it to or subtract it from a d20 roll by a creature you can see.

display.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage
display.description: An airbag reduces the triggering damage by 1d6. +1d6 per slot level above 1.

A magic bird carries an unattended object of up to 50 pounds within range to a surface within 200 feet along an unobstructed path, arriving at the start of your next turn. +50 pounds and +100 feet per slot level above 1.

A spectral flying-fish lure appears and moves 20 feet (again as a Bonus Action on later turns). Creatures that see it within 5 feet as it passes make a Wisdom save or are Baited (one fewer attack if they take the Attack action next turn) or Dragged (follow the lure, provoking Opportunity Attacks, and lose that much Speed next turn), your choice.

A willing creature lends you a level 1 spell slot, which you can use once before the start of your next turn or lose. A creature can lend three slots per Long Rest. Cantrip Upgrade: level 2 slots at level 5, level 3 at 11, level 4 at 17.
A working machine you touch is powered as if whelmed by a spirit or permanently enchanted. Duration 1 day with level 3 or 4 slots, 7 days with 5 or 6, 30 days with 7 or 8, and 1 year at 9.

display.components: S, M (a ball of wax worth 10+ GF, which the spell consumes; a blank piece of paper; and an envelope)
display.description: A creature's spoken message of up to 100 words is recorded and sealed. The designated recipient opens it as a Magic action (or Knock opens it) and it reads aloud in the speaker's voice. Anyone else forcing it open makes a Wisdom save: failure leaves the seal intact, success destroys the envelope.

A totem becomes enticing to demons (Fiends) in a 150-foot Emanation. A demon starting its turn there without Total Cover makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed and must Dash toward the totem each turn, until it comes within 5 feet, leaves the plane, or saves again after taking damage or being shaken. Larger Emanation with higher slots (300 to 1,000 feet). Outside Obojima, it can target Aberrations, Fey, Fiends, or Undead.

Sense curses within 30 feet; as a Magic action see auras on cursed creatures or objects and learn the item or spell that caused a curse and its rarity or level. Blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood, 1 inch of metal, or thin lead.

display.components: V, S, M (a drop of water)
display.description: A Small hydrant (AC your spell save DC, 30 Hit Points) blasts a 20-foot by 5-foot Line of water; creatures in it, or entering or ending a turn there, make a Strength save or are pushed to the end of the Line. A Bonus Action redirects the stream.
A capsule machine dispenses a random potion from the Combat, Utility, or Whimsy list of Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass (d20; +10 with a level 2+ slot). It vanishes if unused within 1 hour.

display.components: V, S, M (a jar of paint worth 5+ GF, which the spell consumes)
display.description: Paint a mundane-seeming trap up to 5 feet across (Investigation against your DC reveals it). It triggers when a non-designated creature comes within 5 feet, or as your Magic action against a creature within 10 feet; you are alerted. Dexterity save or pulled to the surface and Restrained for 1 minute (Athletics to escape, or a gallon of water); on a success, Speed halved. Lasts 8 hours to 30 days with higher slots.

display.components: V, S, M (a small Kyojin Candle worth 50+ GF, which the spell consumes)
display.description: Learn a curse's effects, source, and how to end it on a creature or object you touch, or the effects of a curse on a 30-foot Emanation (or whether a cursed creature or object passed through in the last 24 hours).

display.components: V, S, M (crushed rocks or sand)
display.description: An illusory road up to 15 feet wide and 120 feet long; creatures moving along it in any direction but the one you chose spend 3 feet of movement per foot.

Throw a summoned can; when the spell ends it bursts in a Sphere starting at 10 feet and growing 5 feet each of your turns: Dexterity save, accumulated Force damage or half. Base 8d4; moving it 20 feet or shaking it (Bonus Action) adds 1d4 once per round, up to 14d4. Ends early if a creature is carrying it at the end of a turn. +1d4 base and maximum per slot level above 3.
A spectral stop sign appears within 5 feet of you until your next turn; a creature makes a Wisdom save or can't move toward it. Cantrip Upgrade: two targets at level 5, three at 11, four at 17.

display.components: V, S, M (a scrap of trash)
display.description: Mouselike spirits devour all unattended Small or smaller nonmagical objects in a 10-foot Cube, except those you designate. +5 feet per slot level above 1.

A Huge spectral taxi travels a 120-foot Line, picking up willing Medium or smaller creatures within 5 feet of it and passing through objects (stopping at 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, or lead); passengers exit within 5 feet of where it stops.

display.components: V, S, M (cursed tuft of hair)
display.description: Choose 1,000 feet (number of demons), 500 feet (also direction and distance), or 250 feet (also kind and CR). Outside Obojima it can detect Aberrations, Fey, Fiends, or Undead.

display.components: S, M (a stem, leaf, or other piece of a plant)
display.description: A stationary vine ladder up to 15 feet tall appears on a solid surface; a new one replaces the last.

Ward a 15-foot-radius Sphere against one creature type of CR 2 or lower: entering requires a Charisma save or it falls Prone and stops; starting its turn inside, it saves or is shunted out, Prone, taking 2d8 Force. Maximum CR +1 per slot level above 2.

Ranged spell attack: 1d8 Piercing. On a miss, redirect a shard at another creature within 15 feet of the target with a second attack for 1d4 Piercing. Both rise by a die at levels 5, 11, and 17. Osteomancy spell.
A creature on the ground makes a Dexterity save: 1d4 Piercing and Prone, or half damage only. 2d4 at level 5, 3d4 at 11, 4d4 at 17.

A willing creature takes 1 Piercing as bone spikes grow; the first creature each turn that hits it with a melee attack takes 2d4 Piercing. +1d4 per slot level above 1; no Concentration at level 5+. Osteomancy spell.
Finger bones fire along a 30-foot by 1-foot Line: Dexterity save or 2d8 Piercing. +1d8 per slot level above 1. Osteomancy spell.

display.components: V, S, M (a melee weapon worth 1 SP+)
display.description: A spectral copy makes a melee spell attack against a creature within 20 feet for 1d8 of your weapon's type. You can then use your action to dash 20 feet straight at it and take the Attack action with that weapon. +1d8 and +10 feet per slot level above 1.

Ranged spell attack: 4d8 Piercing and a Strength save (Large+ with Advantage) or pushed 15 feet; slammed into an obstacle it is Restrained until the end of its next turn. +1d8 and +5 feet per slot level above 2. Osteomancy spell.

display.components: S, M (a whistle made of bones)
display.description: The first time a creature moves 5 feet within a 10-foot Square you choose, a maw erupts: 2d10 Piercing to each creature there, knocking one Prone. +1d10 per slot level above 2; at level 5+ it can trigger twice.
Touching a non-Undead corpse's bones replays an illusion of its last 6 seconds, showing only outlines of what affected it. Once per corpse per 24 hours. Osteomancy spell.

Grow a bone tail. When a creature moves within a 15-foot Emanation, take a Reaction for a melee spell attack: 2d4 + spellcasting modifier Piercing and pull it adjacent. +2d4 per slot level above 2. Osteomancy spell.
Your rib cage swallows a creature: Strength save or 4d8 Piercing and regurgitated at a point within 60 feet; half damage only on a success. +1d8 and +10 feet per slot level above 3. Osteomancy spell.

display.components: V, S, M (a calcified bamboo stick)
display.description: Up to four creatures on the ground make a Dexterity save or take 3d10 Piercing and are impaled 5 feet up, Restrained, taking 1d10 each turn; Athletics against your DC as an action breaks free. +1d10 to both per slot level above 3. Osteomancy spell.

display.components: V, S, M (a melee weapon worth 1+ SP)
display.description: Three spectral duplicates each make a melee spell attack against creatures within 30 feet for 4d8 of your weapon's type. Then a Bonus Action dashes you 30 feet toward one without provoking for a weapon attack. +2d8 per duplicate per slot level above 3.

display.components: V, S, M (a flute made of a femur worth 50+ GP)
display.description: Creatures you choose in a 30-foot Sphere make a Wisdom save or are Frightened, Prone, and Speed 0 for the duration; one that takes damage repeats the save at the end of its next turn. Osteomancy spell.

display.components: V, S, M (a virgin's carpal bone)
display.description: A creature makes a Strength save or is sealed in a bone iron maiden: Restrained, Incapacitated, Total Cover, and 3d6 Piercing each turn, saving at the end of each turn. The maiden has AC 10 + spellcasting modifier, 80 Hit Points, Immunity to Psychic and Poison, Vulnerability to Bludgeoning. +1d6 and +20 Hit Points per slot level above 4. Osteomancy spell.

display.components: V, S, M (a piece of spinal bone and a diamond worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes)
display.description: Ranged spell attack: 4d6 Necrotic, and another creature within range regains that many Hit Points, or returns to life with them if dead less than a minute (not old age). Fails if either lacks bones. +1d6 per slot level above 4. Osteomancy spell.

Bone trees fill a 30-foot-radius, 20-foot-high Cylinder: chosen creatures make a Dexterity save, 4d8 Piercing or half. The area is Difficult Terrain giving Half Cover, and moving in it costs 2d8 Piercing per 5 feet (not you). Osteomancy spell.
You become an exact physical duplicate of a Humanoid of your size that you can see, undetectable by physical examination; your voice and equipment don't change.
Crushing deep-sea water surrounds a creature you can see: 3d6 Bludgeoning, and it can't speak or use Verbal components for the duration.

During your Contact Deity, make the contacted deity manifest nearby for 1 hour. It acts as it wishes and treats you as an ally unless you act against it, but not your allies; protecting others counts as acting against it.

Leap up to 10 feet and make a melee spell attack with a spectral claw: 1d8 Slashing or Force, and your next attack against it before the end of your next turn has Advantage. 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11, 4d8 at 17.
The first time you fail an Intelligence check, succeed automatically if its DC is below your spell save DC, otherwise add +2. Once per Short Rest.
A creature makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d6 Psychic and can't see you until the end of your next turn. 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11, 4d6 at 17.

Roll 2d6 for a creature you can see and add 2d6 at the start of each of your turns. Above its Strength: Disadvantage on Strength attacks. Above its Dexterity: Speed halved and attacks against it have Advantage. Above its current Hit Points: it implodes and dies.
Ask a Mythos deity 1d6 yes-or-no questions and receive correct answers (or unclear). On a d20 roll of 1 when you cast it, the deity appears and attacks everyone, including you, for the duration.
A 20-foot-radius Sphere of lightly obscuring fog with fleeting shapes; creatures ending their turn in it take 1d4 Psychic, and Beasts of Intelligence 3 or less won't enter willingly.

A creature believes it is rotting. Choose: it Dashes away from allies whenever it starts a turn within 30 feet of one, or it Dashes at its nearest enemy each turn and makes an Unarmed Strike against an enemy within 5 feet.
A Bloodied Mythos or Deity creature you can see is sent to a random location on a plane tied to its type.

A creature makes a Charisma save. On a failure, when it takes damage from an attack you can use your Reaction to make the damage dice deal their maximum. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.
A 30-foot-radius Sphere of dust: creatures of a chosen type (not Beast or Humanoid) take 20 Force when it appears or moves onto them, or when they enter or end their turn in it (once per turn).
A creature gains a curse point at the end of each of its turns and dies on the third, unless the spell ends first.
A creature you can see takes 1d4 + 2 Psychic, and attacks and Unarmed Strikes against it crit on 19 or 20 until your next turn. Scales to 2d4 + 4 at level 5, 3d4 + 6 at 11, 4d4 + 8 at 17.

Targets make a Dexterity save or are swarmed by spectral cats: 4d6 Slashing at the start of each turn, Disadvantage on checks and attacks, and moving requires a Constitution save or they fall Prone and take 2d6 more. They repeat the Dexterity save at the end of each turn. +2d6 per slot level above 5.
You can't be knocked Prone while not Incapacitated, can use a Reaction to reduce falling damage by five times your level, have Advantage on Dexterity checks and saves, and jump twice as far.
A creature takes 8d6 Necrotic; on a failed Strength save it is also knocked Prone and moved up to 40 feet within range.
A spectral panther pounces: Strength save or 8d6 Force and Restrained (2d6 Force each turn; Athletics against your DC as an action ends it), or half and the spell ends. +1d6 per slot level above 3.

At the end of each of your turns, every creature within 30 feet that can see you, including you, takes 5d8 Necrotic (it can't break your Concentration). Creatures it kills collapse into slime, revivable only by True Resurrection or Wish.

A 20-foot-radius Sphere of gloom. The Darkness Hides Terrors: chosen creatures make a Dexterity save, 4d8 Psychic and a Reaction move away, or half. Tomb of Shadows: Constitution save, 4d8 Necrotic and -20 feet Speed, or half. +1d8 per slot level above 3.

A Shadow Spirit (Infiltrator or Assassin) acts after you and obeys your commands. AC 11 + spell level, 50 (Assassin) or 40 (Infiltrator) Hit Points +10 per level above 5, Resistance to Necrotic, Immunity to Cold, moves through objects, and Hides as a Bonus Action in dim light. Attacks equal to half the spell level: Chill Touch (1d8 + 3 + level Cold) or Deathly Bolt (150 feet, 2d4 + 3 + level Cold, +2d4 if hidden).
A 10-foot Cube of Darkness from you: Wisdom save, 2d8 Psychic and Blinded while in it, or half. It lasts until the end of your next turn. +5 feet per slot level above 1.
Ranged spell attack: 2d8 Necrotic, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the damage. +1d8 per slot level above 1.
Your spell damage dice against a chosen creature are maximized, and as part of this casting you can also cast a level 5 or lower one-action spell, expending both slots.
Each Bloodied creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a Constitution save or dies and turns to dust with its nonmagical gear, revivable only by True Resurrection or Wish.

A soundproof 5-foot Emanation: Perception checks to hear across its edge have Disadvantage in both directions, and creatures have Advantage on saves against effects that need them to hear a sound from the other side.
Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere makes a Constitution save: 2d4 Force and Deafened until the end of your next turn on a failure, half damage only on a success. +2d4 per slot level above 1.
Ranged spell attack against a creature or object for 1d8 Force. Increases to 2d8, 3d8, and 4d8 at levels 5, 11, and 17.

display.components: V, S, M (Artisan's Tools or a Herbalism Kit)
display.description: Choose an Artisan's Tool or Herbalism Kit; add 1d6 to ability checks when you take the Utilize action with it.

display.castingTime: Reaction, when you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage
display.description: Resistance to the triggering type until the start of your next turn, and your first melee hit next turn deals +1d6 of that type. +1d6 per slot level above 1.
One creature makes a Strength save or its Fly Speed becomes 0; an airborne target descends safely 60 feet per round.

Each other creature in a 10-foot Emanation makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 Bludgeoning and falls Prone; loose earth or stone there becomes Difficult Terrain until cleared. +1d6 per slot level above 1.

display.components: V, S, M (a pebble with a hole in it)
display.description: A creature you can see that can see your eyes makes a Constitution save or takes Necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus and has Disadvantage on its next Dexterity save before the end of its next turn.

Shape dirt or stone in a 5-foot Cube: excavate loose earth and move it 5 feet, draw shapes or colors for 1 hour, or make the ground Difficult Terrain (or normal) for 1 hour. Two lasting effects at most.
Mark of Passage spell. Teleport up to 5 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, not through solid objects or out of restraints.

display.components: V, S, M (a pinch of dirt)
display.description: A touched creature (Wisdom save if unwilling) gains or loses one ancestral trait: attack damage +/- 1d4, Speed +/- 20, climb or fly gained or reduced, one attack's damage type changed, Darkvision gained or reduced, or HP max +/- 1d4 + 4. One more trait per slot level above 2.

display.type: Armor (Any Medium or Heavy, Except Hide Armor)
display.description: This suit of armor is reinforced with adamantine, one of the hardest substances in existence. While you’re wearing it, any Critical Hit against you be comes a normal hit.

This magic ammunition is meant to slay creatures of a particular type, which the GM chooses or de termines randomly by rolling on the table below. If a creature of that type takes damage from the am munition, the creature makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking an extra 6d10 Force damage on a failed save or half as much extra damage on a successful one. After dealing its extra damage to a creature, the ammunition becomes nonmagical. 1d100 Creature Type 1d100 Creature Type 01–10 Aberrations 51–60 Fey 11–15 Beasts 61–70 Fiends 16–20 Celestials 71–75 Giants 21–25 Constructs 76–80 Monstrosities 26–35 Dragons 81–85 Oozes 36–45 Elementals 86–90 Plants 46–50 Humanoids 91–00 Undead

or Very Rare (+3) You have a bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. The bo nus is determined by the rarity of the ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical. This ammunition is typically found or sold in quantities of ten or twenty pieces. Ten pieces of this ammunition are equivalent in value to a potion of the same rarity.

Your Constitution is 19 while you wear this amulet. It has no effect on you if your Constitution is 19 or higher without it. Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location Wondrous Item, Uncommon (Requires Attunement) While wearing this amulet, you can’t be targeted by Divination spells or perceived through magical scrying sensors unless you allow it.

While wearing this amulet, you can take a Magic action to name a location that you are familiar with on another plane of existence. Then make a DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check. On a successful check, you cast Plane Shift. On a failed check, you and each creature and object within 15 feet of you travel to a random destination determined by rolling 1d100 and consulting the following table. 1d100 Destination 01–60 Random location on the plane you named 61–70 Random location on an Inner Plane deter mined by rolling 1d6: on a 1, the Plane of Air; on a 2, the Plane of Earth; on a 3, the Plane of Fire; on a 4, the Plane of Water; on a 5, the Feywild; on a 6, the Shadowfell 71–80 Random location on an Outer Plane deter mined by rolling 1d8: on a 1, Arborea; on a 2, Arcadia; on a 3, the Beastlands; on a 4, Bytopia; on a 5, Elysium; on a 6, Mechanus; on a 7, Mount Celestia; on an 8, Ysgard 81–90 Random location on an Outer Plane deter mined by rolling 1d8: on a 1, the Abyss; on a 2, Acheron; on a 3, Carceri; on a 4, Gehenna; on a 5, Hades; on a 6, Limbo; on a 7, the Nine Hells; on an 8, Pandemonium 91–00 Random location on the Astral Plane

While holding this Shield, you can take a Bonus Action to cause it to animate. The Shield leaps into the air and hovers in your space to protect you as if you were wielding it, leaving your hands free. The Shield remains animate for 1 minute, until you take a Bonus Action to end this effect, or until you die or have the Incapacitated condition, at which point the Shield falls to the ground or into your hand if you have one free.

This item first appears to be a sealed iron barrel weighing 500 pounds. The barrel has a hidden catch, which can be found with a successful DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check. Releasing the catch unlocks a hatch at one end of the barrel, al lowing two Medium or smaller creatures to crawl inside. Ten levers are set in a row at the far end, each in a neutral position, able to move up or down. When certain levers are used, the apparatus trans forms to resemble a giant lobster. The Apparatus of the Crab is a Large object with the following statistics: AC 20; HP 200; Speed 30 ft., Swim 30 ft. (or 0 ft. for both if the legs aren’t ex tended); Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. To be used as a vehicle, the apparatus requires one pilot. While the apparatus’s hatch is closed, the compartment is airtight and watertight. The com partment holds enough air for 10 hours of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside. The apparatus floats on water. It can also go underwater to a depth of 900 feet. Below that, the vehicle takes 2d6 Bludgeoning damage each minute from pressure. A creature in the compartment can take a Utilize action to move as many as two of the apparatus’s levers up or down. After each use, a lever goes back to its neutral position. Each lever, from left to right, functions as shown in the Apparatus of the Crab Levers table.
Clasp with six spectral keys. Magic action: touch a key to a door, window, gate, container, or hatch to cast Arcane Lock on it; the key vanishes. The clasp vanishes with its last key.

Charm Monster (DC 15) once per dawn; non-Humanoids save with Disadvantage. On attuning, gain proficiency in Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion (changeable each Long Rest). A successful Study-action Arcana check on an Aberration, Construct, Elemental, Fey, or Monstrosity also reveals its Immunities, Resistances, and Vulnerabilities.

Attunement) You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage while you wear this armor. Metal Shell. You can take a Magic action to give yourself Immunity to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage for 10 minutes or until you are no longer wearing the armor. Once this property is used, it can’t be used again until the next dawn.

Attunement) You have Resistance to one type of damage while you wear this armor. The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly by rolling on the following table. 1d10 Damage Type 1d10 Damage Type 1 Acid 6 Necrotic 2 Cold 7 Poison 3 Fire 8 Psychic 4 Force 9 Radiant 5 Lightning 10 Thunder Apparatus of the Crab Levers Lever Up Down 1 Legs extend, allowing the apparatus to walk and swim. Legs retract, reducing the apparatus’s Speed and Swim Speed to 0 and making it unable to benefit from bo nuses to speed. 2 Forward window shutter opens. Forward window shutter closes. 3 Side window shutters open (two per side). Side window shutters close (two per side). 4 Two claws extend from the front side of the apparatus. The claws retract. 5 Each extended claw makes the following melee attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage. Each extended claw makes the following melee attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). 6 The apparatus walks or swims forward provided its legs are extended. The apparatus walks or swims backward provided its legs are extended. 7 The apparatus turns 90 degrees counterclockwise provided its legs are extended. The apparatus turns 90 degrees clockwise provided its legs are extended. 8 Eyelike fixtures emit Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. The light turns off. 9 The apparatus sinks up to 20 feet if it’s in liquid. The apparatus rises up to 20 feet if it’s in liquid. 10 The rear hatch unseals and opens. The rear hatch closes and seals.

Attunement) While wearing this armor, you have Resistance to one of the following damage types: Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing. The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly. Curse. This armor is cursed, a fact that is revealed only when the Identify spell is cast on the armor or you attune to it. Attuning to the armor curses you until you are targeted by a Remove Curse spell or similar magic; removing the armor fails to end the curse. While cursed, you have Vulnerability to two of the three damage types associated with the ar mor (not the one to which it grants Resistance).
Rare (+2), or Legendary (+3) You have a bonus to Armor Class while wearing this armor. The bonus is determined by its rarity.

You gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class against ranged attack rolls while you wield this Shield. This bonus is in addition to the Shield’s normal bonus to AC. Whenever an attacker makes a ranged attack roll against a target within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to become the target of the attack instead.

This heavy cloth bag contains 3d4 dry beans when found. The bag weighs half a pound regardless of how many beans it contains and becomes a non magical item when it no longer contains any beans. If you dump one or more beans out of the bag, they explode in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on them. All the dumped beans are destroyed in the ex plosion, and each creature in the Sphere, including you, makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d4 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. If you remove a bean from the bag, plant it in dirt or sand, and then water it, the bean disappears as it produces an effect 1 minute later from the ground where it was planted. The GM can choose an effect from the following table or determine it randomly. 1d100 Effect 01 5d4 toadstools sprout. If a creature eats a toadstool, roll any die. On an odd roll, the eater must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 5d6 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. On an even roll, the eater gains 5d6 Temporary Hit Points for 1 hour. 02–10 A geyser erupts and spouts water, beer, mayonnaise, tea, vinegar, wine, or oil (GM’s choice) 30 feet into the air for 1d4 minutes. 1d100 Effect 11–20 A Treant sprouts. Roll any die. On an odd roll, the treant is Chaotic Evil. On an even roll, the treant is Chaotic Good. 21–30 An animate but immobile stone statue in your likeness rises and makes verbal threats against you. If you leave it and others come near, it describes you as the most heinous of villains and directs the newcomers to find and attack you. If you are on the same plane of existence as the statue, it knows where you are. The statue becomes inanimate after 24 hours. 31–40 A campfire with green flames springs forth and burns for 24 hours or until it is extinguished. 41–50 Three Shrieker Fungi sprout. 51–60 1d4 + 4 bright-pink toads crawl forth. When ever a toad is touched, it transforms into a Large or smaller monster of the GM’s choice that acts in accordance with its alignment and nature. The monster remains for 1 min ute, then disappears in a puff of bright-pink smoke. 61–70 A hungry Bulette burrows up and attacks. 71–80 A fruit tree grows. It has 1d10 + 20 fruit, 1d8 of which act as randomly determined po tions. The tree vanishes after 1 hour. Picked fruit remains, retaining any magic for 30 days. 81–90 A nest of 1d4 + 3 rainbow-colored eggs springs up. Any creature that eats an egg makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, a creature permanently increases its lowest ability score by 1, ran domly choosing among equally low scores. On a failed save, the creature takes 10d6 Force damage from an internal explosion. 91–95 A pyramid with a 60-foot-square base bursts upward. Inside is a burial chamber containing a Mummy, a Mummy Lord, or some other Undead of the GM’s choice. Its sarcophagus contains treasure of the GM’s choice. 96–00 A giant beanstalk sprouts, growing to a height of the GM’s choice. The top leads where the GM chooses, such as to a great view, a cloud giant’s castle, or another plane of existence.

This bag resembles a Bag of Holding but is a feeding orifice for a gigantic extradimensional creature. Turning the bag inside out closes the orifice. The extradimensional creature attached to the bag can sense whatever is placed inside the bag. Animal or vegetable matter placed wholly in the bag is devoured and lost forever. When part of a liv ing creature is placed in the bag, as happens when someone reaches inside it, there is a 50 percent chance that the creature is pulled inside the bag. A creature inside the bag can take an action to try to escape, doing so with a successful DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check. Another creature can take an ac tion to reach into the bag to pull a creature out, do ing so with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check, provided the puller isn’t pulled inside the bag first. Any creature that starts its turn inside the bag is devoured, its body destroyed. Inanimate objects can be stored in the bag, which can hold a cubic foot of such material. However, once each day, the bag swallows any objects inside it and spits them out into another plane of existence. The GM determines the time and plane. If the bag is pierced or torn, it is destroyed, and anything contained within it is transported to a random location on the Astral Plane.

This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions—roughly 2 feet square and 4 feet deep on the inside. The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. The bag weighs 5 pounds, regardless of its contents. Retrieving an item from the bag requires a Utilize action. If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it is de stroyed, and its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane. If the bag is turned inside out, its contents spill forth unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. The bag holds enough air for 10 minutes of breathing, divided by the num ber of breathing creatures inside. Placing a Bag of Holding inside an extradimen sional space created by a Handy Haversack, Portable Hole, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate orig inates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on the gate is sucked through it to a ran dom location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way and can’t be reopened.

This bag made from gray, rust, or tan cloth appears empty. Reaching inside the bag, however, reveals the presence of a small, fuzzy object. You can take a Magic action to pull the fuzzy ob ject from the bag and throw it up to 20 feet. When the object lands, it transforms into a creature you determine by rolling on the table that corresponds to the bag’s color. See “Monsters” for the creature’s stat block. The creature vanishes at the next dawn or when it is reduced to 0 Hit Points. The creature is Friendly to you and your allies, and it acts immediately after you on your Initiative count. You can take a Bonus Action to command how the creature moves and what action it takes on its next turn, such as attacking an enemy. In the ab sence of such orders, the creature acts in a fashion appropriate to its nature. Once three fuzzy objects have been pulled from the bag, the bag can’t be used again until the next dawn. Gray Bag of Tricks 1d8 Creature 1d8 Creature 1 Weasel 5 Panther 2 Giant Rat 6 Giant Badger 3 Badger 7 Dire Wolf 4 Boar 8 Giant Elk Rust Bag of Tricks 1d8 Creature 1d8 Creature 1 Rat 5 Giant Goat 2 Owl 6 Giant Boar 3 Mastiff 7 Lion 4 Goat 8 Brown Bear Tan Bag of Tricks 1d8 Creature 1d8 Creature 1 Jackal 5 Black Bear 2 Ape 6 Giant Weasel 3 Baboon 7 Giant Hyena 4 Axe Beak 8 Tiger

This small black sphere measures 3/4 of an inch in diameter and weighs an ounce. Typically, 1d4 + 4 Beads of Force are found together. You can take a Magic action to throw the bead up to 60 feet. The bead explodes in a 10-foot-radius Sphere on impact and is destroyed. Each creature in the Sphere must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 5d4 Force damage. A sphere of transparent force then encloses the area for 1 minute. Any creature that failed the save and is completely within the area is trapped inside this sphere. Creatures that succeeded on the save or are partially within the area are pushed away from the center of the sphere until they are no longer inside it. Only breathable air can pass through the sphere’s wall. No attack or other effect can pass through. An enclosed creature can take a Utilize action to push against the sphere’s wall, moving the sphere up to half the creature’s Speed. The sphere can be picked up, and its magic causes it to weigh only 1 pound, regardless of the weight of creatures inside.
This flavorless, gelatinous bead dissolves on your tongue and provides as much nourishment as 1 day of Rations.

6 charges, regains 1d6 + 1 at dawn (1 in 20 to be lost on the last). Magic action: 1 charge, one creature within 60 ft makes a DC 15 Con save or is Incapacitated (repeat save each turn); 3 charges, the same in a 30-ft Cone; 5 charges, Cloudkill (DC 17).

While wearing this belt, you gain the following benefits: Dwarvish. You know Dwarvish. Friend of Dwarvenkind. You have Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to interact with dwarves and duergar. Toughness. Your Constitution increases by 2, to a maximum of 20. In addition, while attuned to the belt, you have a 50 percent chance each day at dawn of growing a full beard if you can grow one, or a thicker beard if you already have one. If you aren’t a dwarf or duergar, you gain the fol lowing additional benefits while wearing the belt: Darkvision. You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet. Resilience. You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition. Belt of Giant Strength Wondrous Item, Rarity Varies (Requires Attunement) While wearing this belt, your Strength changes to a score granted by the belt. The type of giant deter mines the score (see the table below). The item has no effect on you if your Strength without the belt is equal to or greater than the belt’s score. Belt Str. Rarity Belt of Giant Strength (hill) 21 Rare Belt of Giant Strength (frost or stone) 23 Very Rare Belt of Giant Strength (fire) 25 Very Rare Belt of Giant Strength (cloud) 27 Legendary Belt of Giant Strength (storm) 29 Legendary

You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, while you are attuned to this weapon, your Hit Point maximum increases by 1 for each level you have attained. Curse. This weapon is cursed, and becoming at tuned to it extends the curse to you. As long as you remain cursed, you are unwilling to part with the weapon, keeping it within reach at all times. You also have Disadvantage on attack rolls with weap ons other than this one. Whenever another creature damages you while the weapon is in your possession, you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or go berserk. This berserk state ends when you start your turn and there are no creatures within 60 feet of you that you can see or hear. While berserk, you regard the creature nearest to you that you can see or hear as your enemy. If there are multiple possible creatures, choose one at random. On each of your turns, you must move as close to the creature as possible and take the Attack action, targeting the creature. If you’re unable to get close enough to the creature to attack it with the weapon, your turn ends after you’ve used up all your available movement. If the creature dies or can no longer be seen or heard by you, the next nearest creature that you can see or hear becomes your new target.
3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn. When you deal damage, spend 1 charge: +2d10 Necrotic and the target makes a DC 15 Con save or gains 1 Exhaustion level.

Evolving. Budding (Uncommon): Druidcraft, once-per-dawn Plant Growth (Overgrowth), and refresh plants in a 5-ft Cube. Flowering (Rare): once-per-dawn Insect Plague (bumblebees) at your DC. Somniferous (Very Rare): once per dawn, chosen creatures in 30 ft make a DC 17 Con save or sleep for 1 hour.

A matched pair. When your area effect forces saves, the wearer of the other band can be spared: it auto-succeeds and takes no damage instead of half. Once per dawn for the pair; destroying one crumbles the other.
While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface you are moving across. You also have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
While you wear these boots, you can cast Levitate on yourself.

While you wear these boots, you can take a Bonus Action to click the boots’ heels together. If you do, the boots double your Speed, and any creature that makes an Opportunity Attack against you has Dis advantage on the attack roll. If you click your heels together again, you end the effect. When you’ve used the boots’ property for a total of 10 minutes, the magic ceases to function for you until you finish a Long Rest.

While you wear these boots, your Speed becomes 30 feet unless your Speed is higher, and your Speed isn’t reduced by you carrying weight in excess of your carrying capacity or wearing Heavy Armor. Once on each of your turns, you can jump up to 30 feet by spending only 10 feet of movement.

These furred boots are snug and feel warm. While wearing them, you gain the following benefits. Cold Resistance. You have Resistance to Cold damage and can tolerate temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower without any additional protection. Winter Strider. You ignore Difficult Terrain cre ated by ice or snow.

While this bowl is filled with water and you are within 5 feet of it, you can take a Magic action to summon a Water Elemental . The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the bowl as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. The bowl can’t be used this way again until the next dawn. The bowl is about 1 foot in diameter and half as deep. It holds about 3 gallons.
While wearing these bracers, you have proficiency with the Longbow and Shortbow, and you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls made with such weapons.
While wearing these bracers, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class if you are wearing no armor and using no Shield.

While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a Magic action to summon a Fire Elemental . The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the brazier as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. The brazier can’t be used this way again until the next dawn.
While wearing this brooch, you have Resistance to Force damage, and you have Immunity to damage from the Magic Missile spell.

This wooden broom functions like a mundane broom until you stand astride it and take a Magic action to make it hover beneath you, at which time it can be ridden in the air. It has a Fly Speed of 50 feet. It can carry up to 400 pounds, but its Fly Speed becomes 30 feet while carrying over 200 pounds. The broom stops hovering when you land or when you’re no longer riding it. As a Magic action, you can send the broom to travel alone to a destination within 1 mile of you if you name the location and are familiar with it. The broom comes back to you when you take a Magic action and use a command word if the broom is still within 1 mile of you.

This candle’s magic is activated when the candle is lit, which requires a Magic action. After burning for 4 hours, the candle is destroyed. You can snuff it out early for use at a later time. Deduct the time it burned in increments of 1 minute from its total burn time. While lit, the candle sheds Dim Light in a 30-foot radius. While you are within that light, you have Advantage on D20 Tests. In addition, a Cleric or Druid in the light can cast level 1 spells they have prepared without expending spell slots. Alternatively, when you light the candle for the first time, you can cast Gate with it. Doing so de stroys the candle. The portal created by the spell links to a particular Outer Plane chosen by the GM or determined by rolling on the following table. 1d100 Outer Plane 1d100 Outer Plane 01–05 Abyss 55–59 Gehenna 06–10 Acheron 60–64 Hades 11–17 Arborea 65–69 Limbo 18–25 Arcadia 70–77 Mechanus 26–33 Beastlands 78–85 Mount Celestia 34–41 Bytopia 86–90 Nine Hells 42–46 Carceri 91–95 Pandemonium 47–54 Elysium 96–00 Ysgard

This cape smells faintly of brimstone. While wear ing it, you can use it to cast Dimension Door as a Magic action. This property can’t be used again until the next dawn. When you teleport with that spell, you leave be hind a cloud of smoke. The space you left is Lightly Obscured by that smoke until the end of your next turn.

You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a Magic action and using the carpet’s command word. It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it. Four sizes of Carpet of Flying exist. The GM chooses the size of a given carpet or determines it randomly by rolling on the following table. A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table, but its Fly Speed is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity. 1d100 Size Capacity Fly Speed 01–20 3 ft. × 5 ft. 200 lb. 80 feet 21–55 4 ft. × 6 ft. 400 lb. 60 feet 56–80 5 ft. × 7 ft. 600 lb. 40 feet 81–00 6 ft. × 9 ft. 800 lb. 30 feet

While gently swinging this censer, you can take a Magic action to summon an Air Elemental . The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the censer as possible, understands your lan guages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. The censer can’t be used this way again until the next dawn.

This hollow metal tube measures about 1 foot long and weighs 1 pound. As a Magic action, you can strike the chime to cast Knock. The spell’s custom ary knocking sound is replaced by the clear, ringing tone of the chime, which is audible out to 300 feet. The chime can be used 10 times. After the tenth time, it cracks and becomes useless.
While wearing this circlet, you can cast Scorching Ray with it (+5 to hit). The circlet can’t cast this spell again until the next dawn.

This fine garment is made of black silk interwoven with faint, silvery threads. While wearing it, you gain the following benefits. Poison Resistance. You have Resistance to Poison damage. Spider Climb. You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed and can move up, down, and across ver tical surfaces and along ceilings, while leaving your hands free. Spider Walk. You can’t be caught in webs of any sort and can move through webs as if they were Dif ficult Terrain. Web. You can cast Web (save DC 13). The web created by the spell fills twice its normal area. Once used, this property can’t be used again until the next dawn.

While you wear this cloak, it magically projects an illusion that makes you appear to be standing in a place near your actual location, causing any creature to have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. If you take damage, the property ceases to function until the start of your next turn. This prop erty is suppressed while your Speed is 0.
While you wear this cloak, Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive you have Disadvantage, and you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

This cloak has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the cloak, you can take a Magic action to pull its hood over your head and expend 1 charge to give yourself the Invis ible condition for 1 hour. The effect ends early if you pull the hood down (no action required) or cease wearing the cloak.
You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws while you wear this cloak.

While wearing this cloak, you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. In an area of Dim Light or Darkness, you can grip the edges of the cloak and use it to gain a Fly Speed of 40 feet. If you ever fail to grip the cloak’s edges while flying in this way, or if you are no longer in Dim Light or Darkness, you lose this Fly Speed. While wearing the cloak in an area of Dim Light or Darkness, you can cast Polymorph on yourself, shape-shifting into a Bat . While in that form, you retain your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The cloak can’t be used this way again until the next dawn.
While wearing this cloak, you can breathe underwater, and you have a Swim Speed of 60 feet.

Magic action: plant the stick to raise a 20-ft Cube of force for 1 hour that keeps out weather and keeps the inside dry and comfortable. Creatures, objects, and magic pass through freely. Unusable for 1d12 hours after it ends.
While touching this crystal orb, you can cast Scrying (save DC 17) with it.

While touching this crystal orb, you can cast Scrying (save DC 17) with it. In addition, you can cast Detect Thoughts (save DC 17) targeting creatures you can see within 30 feet of the spell’s sensor. You don’t need to concentrate on this Detect Thoughts spell to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if the Scrying spell ends.
Cast Hex or Scrying (DC 17). Once per dawn, a Reaction turns a successful D20 Test by a creature within 60 ft into a 1.

While touching this crystal orb, you can cast Scrying (save DC 17) with it. In addition, you can com municate telepathically with creatures you can see within 30 feet of the spell’s sensor. You can also cast Suggestion (save DC 17) through the sensor on one of those creatures. You don’t need to concentrate on this Suggestion to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if Scrying ends. You can’t cast Suggestion in this way again until the next dawn.
While touching this crystal orb, you can cast Scrying (save DC 17) with it. In addition, you have Truesight with a range of 120 feet centered on the spell’s sensor.

This cube is about an inch across. Each face has a distinct marking on it. You can press one of those faces, expend the number of charges required for it, and thereby cast the spell associated with it (save DC 17), as shown in the Cube of Force Faces table. The cube starts with 10 charges, and it regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn. Cube of Force Faces Spell Charge Cost Mage Armor 1 Shield 1 Tiny Hut 3 Private Sanctum 4 Resilient Sphere 4 Wall of Force 5

This cube is 3 inches across and radiates palpable magical energy. The six sides of the cube are each keyed to a different plane of existence, one of which is the Material Plane. The other sides are linked to planes determined by the GM. The cube has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. As a Magic action, you can expend 1 of the cube’s charges to cast one of the fol lowing spells using the cube. Gate. Pressing one side of the cube, you cast Gate, opening a portal to the plane of existence keyed to that side. Plane Shift. Pressing one side of the cube twice, you cast Plane Shift, transporting the targets to the plane of existence keyed to that side.

You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. You can take a Bonus Action to magically coat the blade with poison. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d10 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. The weapon can’t be used this way again until the next dawn.

display.type: Weapon (Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword)
display.description: You can take a Bonus Action to toss this magic weapon into the air. When you do so, the weapon begins to hover, flies up to 30 feet, and attacks one creature of your choice within 5 feet of itself. The weapon uses your attack roll and adds your ability modifier to damage rolls. While the weapon hovers, you can take a Bonus Action to cause it to fly up to 30 feet to another spot within 30 feet of you. As part of the same Bonus Ac tion, you can cause the weapon to attack one creature within 5 feet of the weapon. After the hovering weapon attacks for the fourth time, it flies back to you and tries to return to your hand. If you have no hand free, the weapon falls to the ground in your space. If the weapon has no un obstructed path to you, it moves as close to you as it can and then falls to the ground. It also ceases to hover if you grasp it or are more than 30 feet away from it.

This stoppered flask sloshes when shaken, as if it contains water. The decanter weighs 2 pounds. You can take a Magic action to remove the stopper and issue one of three command words, whereupon an amount of fresh water or salt water (your choice) pours out of the flask. The water stops pouring out at the start of your next turn. Choose from the fol lowing command words: Splash. The decanter produces 1 gallon of water. Fountain. The decanter produces 5 gallons of water. Geyser. The decanter produces 30 gallons of water that gushes forth in a Line 30 feet long and 1 foot wide. If you’re holding the decanter, you can aim the geyser in one direction (no action required). One creature of your choice in the Line must suc ceed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or take 1d4 Bludgeoning damage and have the Prone condition. Instead of a creature, you can target one object in the Line that isn’t being worn or carried and that weighs no more than 200 pounds. The object is knocked over by the geyser.

This box contains a set of cards. A full deck has 34 cards: 32 depicting specific creatures and two with a mirrored surface. A deck found as treasure is usu ally missing 1d20 − 1 cards. The magic of the deck functions only if its cards are drawn at random. You can take a Magic action to draw a card at random from the deck and throw it to the ground at a point within 30 feet of yourself.
