While holding this shield, you have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and spell attacks have disadvantage against you.

This 2-foot-diameter black sphere is a hole in the multiverse, hovering in space and stabilized by a magical field surrounding it. The sphere obliterates all matter it passes through and all matter that passes through it. Artifacts are the exception. Unless an artifact is susceptible to damage from a sphere of annihilation, it passes through the sphere unscathed. Anything else that touches the sphere but isn't wholly engulfed and obliterated by it takes 4d10 force damage. The sphere is stationary until someone controls it. If you are within 60 feet of an uncontrolled sphere, you can use an action to make a DC 25 Intelligence (Arcana) check. On a success, the sphere levitates in one direction of your choice, up to a number of feet equal to 5 × your Intelligence modifier (minimum 5 feet). On a failure, the sphere moves 10 feet toward you. A creature whose space the sphere enters must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be touched by it, taking 4d10 force damage. If you attempt to control a sphere that is under another creature's control, you make an Intelligence (Arcana) check contested by the other creature's Intelligence (Arcana) check. The winner of the contest gains control of the sphere and can levitate it as normal. If the sphere comes into contact with a planar portal, such as that created by the gate spell, or an extradimensional space, such as that within a portable hole, the GM determines randomly what happens, using the following table. | d100 | Result | |---|---| | 01-50 | The sphere is destroyed. | | 51-85 | The sphere moves through the portal or into the extradimensional space. | | 86-00 | A spatial rift sends each creature and object within 180 feet of the sphere, including the sphere, to a random plane of existence. |

display.attunementNote: by a bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
display.description: While holding this staff, you can use an action to expend 1 of its 10 charges to cast charm person, command, or comprehend languages from it using your spell save DC. The staff can also be used as a magic quarterstaff. If you are holding the staff and fail a saving throw against an enchantment spell that targets only you, you can turn your failed save into a successful one. You can't use this property of the staff again until the next dawn. If you succeed on a save against an enchantment spell that targets only you, with or without the staff's intervention, you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge from the staff and turn the spell back on its caster as if you had cast the spell. The staff regains 1d8 + 2 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the staff becomes a nonmagical quarterstaff.

display.attunementNote: by a druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
display.description: You have resistance to fire damage while you hold this staff. The staff has 10 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC: burning hands (1 charge), fireball (3 charges), or wall of fire (4 charges). The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the staff blackens, crumbles into cinders, and is destroyed.

display.attunementNote: by a druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
display.description: You have resistance to cold damage while you hold this staff. The staff has 10 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC: cone of cold (5 charges), fog cloud (1 charge), ice storm (4 charges), or wall of ice (4 charges). The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the staff turns to water and is destroyed.

display.attunementNote: by a bard, cleric, or druid
display.description: This staff has 10 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC and spellcasting ability modifier: cure wounds (1 charge per spell level, up to 4th), lesser restoration (2 charges), or mass cure wounds (5 charges). The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the staff vanishes in a flash of light, lost forever.

display.attunementNote: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
display.description: This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class, saving throws, and spell attack rolls. The staff has 20 charges for the following properties. The staff regains 2d8 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the staff retains its +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls but loses all other properties. On a 20, the staff regains 1d8 + 2 charges. ***Power Strike.*** When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can expend 1 charge to deal an extra 1d6 force damage to the target. ***Spells.*** While holding this staff, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC and spell attack bonus: cone of cold (5 charges), fireball (5th-level version, 5 charges), globe of invulnerability (6 charges), hold monster (5 charges), levitate (2 charges), lightning bolt (5th-level version, 5 charges), magic missile (1 charge), ray of enfeeblement (1 charge), or wall of force (5 charges). ***Retributive Strike.*** You can use an action to break the staff over your knee or against a solid surface, performing a retributive strike. The staff is destroyed and releases its remaining magic in an explosion that expands to fill a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on it. You have a 50 percent chance to instantly travel to a random plane of existence, avoiding the explosion. If you fail to avoid the effect, you take force damage equal to 16 × the number of charges in the staff. Every other creature in the area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes an amount of damage based on how far away it is from the point of origin, as shown in the following table. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. | Distance from Origin | Damage | |---|---| | 10 ft. away or closer | 8 × the number of charges in the staff | | 11 to 20 ft. away | 6 × the number of charges in the staff | | 21 to 30 ft. away | 4 × the number of charges in the staff |

This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. The staff has 10 charges. When you hit with a melee attack using it, you can expend up to 3 of its charges. For each charge you expend, the target takes an extra 1d6 force damage. The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the staff becomes a nonmagical quarterstaff.

display.attunementNote: by a bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
display.description: This staff has 10 charges and regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, a swarm of insects consumes and destroys the staff, then disperses. ***Spells.*** While holding the staff, you can use an action to expend some of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC: giant insect (4 charges) or insect plague (5 charges). ***Insect Cloud.*** While holding the staff, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to cause a swarm of harmless flying insects to spread out in a 30-foot radius from you. The insects remain for 10 minutes, making the area heavily obscured for creatures other than you. The swarm moves with you, remaining centered on you. A wind of at least 10 miles per hour disperses the swarm and ends the effect.

This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. It also has the following additional properties. When one of these properties is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn. ***Lightning.*** When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can cause the target to take an extra 2d6 lightning damage. ***Thunder.*** When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can cause the staff to emit a crack of thunder, audible out to 300 feet. The target you hit must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or become stunned until the end of your next turn. ***Lightning Strike.*** You can use an action to cause a bolt of lightning to leap from the staff's tip in a line that is 5 feet wide and 120 feet long. Each creature in that line must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 9d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. ***Thunderclap.*** You can use an action to cause the staff to issue a deafening thunderclap, audible out to 600 feet. Each creature within 60 feet of you (not including you) must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 thunder damage and becomes deafened for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isn't deafened. ***Thunder and Lightning.*** You can use an action to use the Lightning Strike and Thunderclap properties at the same time. Doing so doesn't expend the daily use of those properties, only the use of this one.

display.attunementNote: by a cleric, druid, or warlock
display.description: This staff has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. The staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff. On a hit, it deals damage as a normal quarterstaff, and you can expend 1 charge to deal an extra 2d10 necrotic damage to the target. In addition, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage for 1 hour on any ability check or saving throw that uses Strength or Constitution.

display.attunementNote: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
display.description: This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While you hold it, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls. The staff has 50 charges for the following properties. It regains 4d6 + 2 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 20, the staff regains 1d12 + 1 charges. ***Spell Absorption.*** While holding the staff, you have advantage on saving throws against spells. In addition, you can use your reaction when another creature casts a spell that targets only you. If you do, the staff absorbs the magic of the spell, canceling its effect and gaining a number of charges equal to the absorbed spell's level. However, if doing so brings the staff's total number of charges above 50, the staff explodes as if you activated its retributive strike (see below). ***Spells.*** While holding the staff, you can use an action to expend some of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC and spellcasting ability: conjure elemental (7 charges), dispel magic (3 charges), fireball (7th-level version, 7 charges), flaming sphere (2 charges), ice storm (4 charges), invisibility (2 charges), knock (2 charges), lightning bolt (7th-level version, 7 charges), passwall (5 charges), plane shift (7 charges), telekinesis (5 charges), wall of fire (4 charges), or web (2 charges). You can also use an action to cast one of the following spells from the staff without using any charges: arcane lock, detect magic, enlarge/reduce, light, mage hand, or protection from evil and good. ***Retributive Strike.*** You can use an action to break the staff over your knee or against a solid surface, performing a retributive strike. The staff is destroyed and releases its remaining magic in an explosion that expands to fill a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on it. You have a 50 percent chance to instantly travel to a random plane of existence, avoiding the explosion. If you fail to avoid the effect, you take force damage equal to 16 × the number of charges in the staff. Every other creature in the area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes an amount of damage based on how far away it is from the point of origin, as shown in the following table. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. | Distance from Origin | Damage | |---|---| | 10 ft. away or closer | 8 × the number of charges in the staff | | 11 to 20 ft. away | 6 × the number of charges in the staff | | 21 to 30 ft. away | 4 × the number of charges in the staff |

display.attunementNote: by a cleric, druid, or warlock
display.description: You can use an action to speak this staff's command word and throw the staff on the ground within 10 feet of you. The staff becomes a giant constrictor snake under your control and acts on its own initiative count. By using a bonus action to speak the command word again, you return the staff to its normal form in a space formerly occupied by the snake. On your turn, you can mentally command the snake if it is within 60 feet of you and you aren't incapacitated. You decide what action the snake takes and where it moves during its next turn, or you can issue it a general command, such as to attack your enemies or guard a location. If the snake is reduced to 0 hit points, it dies and reverts to its staff form. The staff then shatters and is destroyed. If the snake reverts to staff form before losing all its hit points, it regains all of them.

This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you have a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls. The staff has 10 charges for the following properties. It regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the staff loses its properties and becomes a nonmagical quarterstaff. ***Spells.*** You can use an action to expend 1 or more of the staff's charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC: animal friendship (1 charge), awaken (5 charges), barkskin (2 charges), locate animals or plants (2 charges), speak with animals (1 charge), speak with plants (3 charges), or wall of thorns (6 charges). You can also use an action to cast the pass without trace spell from the staff without using any charges. Tree Form. You can use an action to plant one end of the staff in fertile earth and expend 1 charge to transform the staff into a healthy tree. The tree is 60 feet tall and has a 5-foot-diameter trunk, and its branches at the top spread out in a 20-foot radius. The tree appears ordinary but radiates a faint aura of transmutation magic if targeted by detect magic. While touching the tree and using another action to speak its command word, you return the staff to its normal form. Any creature in the tree falls when it reverts to a staff.

If the stone is touching the ground, you can use an action to speak its command word and summon an earth elemental, as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell. The stone can't be used this way again until the next dawn. The stone weighs 5 pounds.
While this polished agate is on your person, you gain a +1 bonus to ability checks and saving throws.

This item appears to be a longsword hilt. While grasping the hilt, you can use a bonus action to cause a blade of pure radiance to spring into existence, or make the blade disappear. While the blade exists, this magic longsword has the finesse property. If you are proficient with shortswords or longswords, you are proficient with the sun blade. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon, which deals radiant damage instead of slashing damage. When you hit an undead with it, that target takes an extra 1d8 radiant damage. The sword's luminous blade emits bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet. The light is sunlight. While the blade persists, you can use an action to expand or reduce its radius of bright and dim light by 5 feet each, to a maximum of 30 feet each or a minimum of 10 feet each.

This tiny object looks like a feather. You can use an action to touch the token to a body of water at least 60 feet in diameter. The token disappears, and a 50-foot-long, 20-foot wide boat shaped like a swan takes its place. The boat is self-propelled and moves across water at a speed of 6 miles per hour. You can use an action while on the boat to command it to move or to turn up to 90 degrees. The boat can carry up to thirty-two Medium or smaller creatures. A Large creature counts as four Medium creatures, while a Huge creature counts as nine. The boat remains for 24 hours and then disappears. You can dismiss the boat as an action.

When you attack a creature with this magic weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, that target takes an extra 3d6 necrotic damage, provided that the target isn't a construct or an undead. You gain temporary hit points equal to the extra damage dealt.

When you attack an object with this magic sword and hit, maximize your weapon damage dice against the target. When you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, that target takes an extra 4d6 slashing damage. Then roll another d20. If you roll a 20, you lop off one of the target's limbs, with the effect of such loss determined by the GM. If the creature has no limb to sever, you lop off a portion of its body instead. In addition, you can speak the sword's command word to cause the blade to shed bright light in a 10 foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. Speaking the command word again or sheathing the sword puts out the light.

Hit points lost to this weapon's damage can be regained only through a short or long rest, rather than by regeneration, magic, or any other means. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack using this magic weapon, you can wound the target. At the start of each of the wounded creature's turns, it takes 1d4 necrotic damage for each time you've wounded it, and it can then make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, ending the effect of all such wounds on itself on a success. Alternatively, the wounded creature, or a creature within 5 feet of it, can use an action to make a DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check, ending the effect of such wounds on it on a success.

display.attunementNote: by a creature of good alignment
display.description: This talisman is a mighty symbol of goodness. A creature that is neither good nor evil in alignment takes 6d6 radiant damage upon touching the talisman. An evil creature takes 8d6 radiant damage upon touching the talisman. Either sort of creature takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman. If you are a good cleric or paladin, you can use the talisman as a holy symbol, and you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls while you wear or hold it. The talisman has 7 charges. If you are wearing or holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 charge from it and choose one creature you can see on the ground within 120 feet of you. If the target is of evil alignment, a flaming fissure opens under it. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or fall into the fissure and be destroyed, leaving no remains. The fissure then closes, leaving no trace of its existence. When you expend the last charge, the talisman disperses into motes of golden light and is destroyed.

display.attunementNote: by a creature of evil alignment
display.description: This item symbolizes unrepentant evil. A creature that is neither good nor evil in alignment takes 6d6 necrotic damage upon touching the talisman. A good creature takes 8d6 necrotic damage upon touching the talisman. Either sort of creature takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman. If you are an evil cleric or paladin, you can use the talisman as a holy symbol, and you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls while you wear or hold it. The talisman has 6 charges. If you are wearing or holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 charge from the talisman and choose one creature you can see on the ground within 120 feet of you. If the target is of good alignment, a flaming fissure opens under it. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or fall into the fissure and be destroyed, leaving no remains. The fissure then closes, leaving no trace of its existence. When you expend the last charge, the talisman dissolves into foul-smelling slime and is destroyed.

When you make an Intelligence (Arcana) check to control a sphere of annihilation while you are holding this talisman, you double your proficiency bonus on the check. In addition, when you start your turn with control over a sphere of annihilation, you can use an action to levitate it 10 feet plus a number of additional feet equal to 10 × your Intelligence modifier.

This ordinary bag, made from tan cloth, appears empty. Reaching inside the bag, however, reveals the presence of a small, fuzzy object. The bag weighs 1/2 pound. You can use an action to pull the fuzzy object from the bag and throw it up to 20 feet. When the object lands, it transforms into a creature you determine by rolling a d8 and consulting the table that corresponds to the bag's color. The creature vanishes at the next dawn or when it is reduced to 0 Hit Points. The creature is friendly to you and your companions, and it acts on Your Turn. You can use a Bonus Action to Command how the creature moves and what action it takes on its next turn, or to give it general orders, such as to Attack your enemies. In the absence of such orders, the creature acts in a fashion appropriate to its Nature. Once three fuzzy Objects have been pulled from the bag, the bag can't be used again until the next dawn. Tan Bag: | d8 | Creature | |---|---| | 01 | Jackal | | 02 | Ape | | 03 | Baboon | | 04 | Axe Beak | | 05 | Black Bear | | 06 | Giant Weasel | | 07 | Giant Hyena | | 08 | Tiger |

This book contains memory and logic exercises, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Intelligence score increases by 2, as does your maximum for that score. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

This book contains guidelines for influencing and charming others, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Charisma score increases by 2, as does your maximum for that score. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

This book contains intuition and insight exercises, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Wisdom score increases by 2, as does your maximum for that score. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

This tiny object looks like a feather. You must be outdoors to use this token. You can use an action to touch it to an unoccupied space on the ground. The token disappears, and in its place a nonmagical oak tree springs into existence. The tree is 60 feet tall and has a 5-foot-diameter trunk, and its branches at the top spread out in a 20-foot radius.

This trident is a magic weapon. It has 3 charges. While you carry it, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to cast dominate beast (save DC 15) from it on a beast that has an innate swimming speed. The trident regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

This tube holds milky liquid with a strong alcohol smell. You can use an action to pour the contents of the tube onto a surface within reach. The liquid instantly dissolves up to 1 square foot of adhesive it touches, including sovereign glue.
When you roll a 20 on your attack roll with this magic weapon, your critical hit deals an extra 2d6 damage of the weapon's type.

You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, the weapon ignores resistance to slashing damage. When you attack a creature that has at least one head with this weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, you cut off one of the creature's heads. The creature dies if it can't survive without the lost head. A creature is immune to this effect if it is immune to slashing damage, doesn't have or need a head, has legendary actions, or the GM decides that the creature is too big for its head to be cut off with this weapon. Such a creature instead takes an extra 6d8 slashing damage from the hit.

This wand has 7 charges for the following properties. It regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed. ***Spells.*** While holding the wand, you can use an action to expend some of its charges to cast one of the following spells (save DC 17): hold monster (5 charges) or hold person (2 charges). ***Assisted Escape.*** While holding the wand, you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge and gain advantage on a saving throw you make to avoid being paralyzed or restrained, or you can expend 1 charge and gain advantage on any check you make to escape a grapple.

This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to speak its command word. For the next minute, you know the direction of the nearest creature hostile to you within 60 feet, but not its distance from you. The wand can sense the presence of hostile creatures that are ethereal, invisible, disguised, or hidden, as well as those in plain sight. The effect ends if you stop holding the wand. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

This wand has 7 charges for the following properties. It regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed. ***Command.*** While holding the wand, you can use an action to expend 1 charge and command another creature to flee or grovel, as with the command spell (save DC 15). ***Cone of Fear.*** While holding the wand, you can use an action to expend 2 charges, causing the wand's tip to emit a 60-foot cone of amber light. Each creature in the cone must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you for 1 minute. While it is frightened in this way, a creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If it has nowhere it can move, the creature can use the Dodge action. At the end of each of its turns, a creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast the fireball spell (save DC 15) from it. For 1 charge, you cast the 3rd-level version of the spell. You can increase the spell slot level by one for each additional charge you expend. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast the lightning bolt spell (save DC 15) from it. For 1 charge, you cast the 3rd-level version of the spell. You can increase the spell slot level by one for each additional charge you expend. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.
This wand has 3 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge as an action to cast the detect magic spell from it. The wand regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast the magic missile spell from it. For 1 charge, you cast the 1st-level version of the spell. You can increase the spell slot level by one for each additional charge you expend. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cause a thin blue ray to streak from the tip toward a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. At the end of each of the target's turns, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cast the polymorph spell (save DC 15) from it. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

The wand has 3 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges, and if a secret door or trap is within 30 feet of you, the wand pulses and points at the one nearest to you. The wand regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cast the web spell (save DC 15) from it. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges and choose a target within 120 feet of you. The target can be a creature, an object, or a point in space. Roll d100 and consult the following table to discover what happens. If the effect causes you to cast a spell from the wand, the spell's save DC is 15. If the spell normally has a range expressed in feet, its range becomes 120 feet if it isn't already. If an effect covers an area, you must center the spell on and include the target. If an effect has multiple possible subjects, the GM randomly determines which ones are affected. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. While holding this wand, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls. In addition, you ignore half cover when making a spell attack.

name: Wand of the War Mage, +1, +2, or +3 (legacy)
spoken: wand of the war mage 1 2 or 3

display.description: While holding this wand, you gain a bonus to spell attack rolls determined by the wand's rarity. In addition, you ignore half cover when making a spell attack.
While holding this wand, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls. In addition, you ignore half cover when making a spell attack.
While holding this wand, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls. In addition, you ignore half cover when making a spell attack.
This emerald contains a mote of elemental energy. When you use an action to break the gem, a water elemental is summoned as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell, and the gem's magic is lost.
You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
You have a bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity.
You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

This fine black cloth, soft as silk, is folded up to the dimensions of a handkerchief. It unfolds into a circular sheet 6 feet in diameter. You can use an action to unfold and place the well of many worlds on a solid surface, whereupon it creates a two-way portal to another world or plane of existence. Each time the item opens a portal, the GM decides where it leads. You can use an action to close an open portal by taking hold of the edges of the cloth and folding it up. Once well of many worlds has opened a portal, it can't do so again for 1d8 hours.

This tiny object looks like a feather. You can use an action to throw the token to a point within 10 feet of you. The token disappears, and a floating whip takes its place. You can then use a bonus action to make a melee spell attack against a creature within 10 feet of the whip, with an attack bonus of +9. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 + 5 force damage. As a bonus action on your turn, you can direct the whip to fly up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 10 feet of it. The whip disappears after 1 hour, when you use an action to dismiss it, or when you are incapacitated or die.

Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of a white dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids. Other times, hunters carefully skin and preserve the hide of a dead dragon. In either case, dragon scale mail is highly valued. While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC, you have advantage on saving throws against the Frightful Presence and breath weapons of dragons, and you have resistance to cold damage. Additionally, you can focus your senses as an action to magically discern the distance and direction to the closest white dragon within 30 miles of you. This special action can't be used again until the next dawn.

While holding this fan, you can use an action to cast the gust of wind spell (save DC 13) from it. Once used, the fan shouldn't be used again until the next dawn. Each time it is used again before then, it has a cumulative 20 percent chance of not working and tearing into useless, nonmagical tatters.

While you wear these boots, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can use the boots to fly for up to 4 hours, all at once or in several shorter flights, each one using a minimum of 1 minute from the duration. If you are flying when the duration expires, you descend at a rate of 30 feet per round until you land. The boots regain 2 hours of flying capability for every 12 hours they aren't in use.

While wearing this cloak, you can use an action to speak its command word. This turns the cloak into a pair of bat wings or bird wings on your back for 1 hour or until you repeat the command word as an action. The wings give you a flying speed of 60 feet. When they disappear, you can't use them again for 1d12 hours.
Medium or heavy armor that never gets dirty.
Dissolves on the tongue and nourishes like 1 day of rations.
Dropped in up to a pint of liquid, turns it into fresh, cold drinking water; no effect on magical liquids or poison.
Humanoid wearer only. You can make your tracks look like those of another kind of humanoid of your size.
Its flame stays lit underwater, giving normal candle light and heat.
Light, medium or heavy armor you can doff as an action.
A six-sided die that rolls whatever number you choose.
Bonus action: the cloak billows dramatically.
Bonus action: change its style, color and apparent quality; it stays a cloak and copies no magic cloak's properties.
When you make an attack roll, you can take a 10 instead of rolling the d20. Once per dawn.
Traveler's clothes that repair everyday wear; destroyed pieces can't be restored.
Warlock spellcasting focus. Once per long rest, try a warlock cantrip you don't know with a DC 10 Arcana check; on a failure the spell and action are wasted.
A steel helm that makes your eyes glow red and shadows the rest of your face.
Held to your ear, it suppresses the deafened condition on you.
Its pages and writing are proof against fire, water and age.
Replaces a lost eye and sees normally; only you can remove it.
3 charges, regained at dawn. Action, 1 charge: a bat, frog or rat appears in the hat, uncontrolled and fleeing, for 1 hour or until it drops to 0 HP.
Wizard spellcasting focus. Once per long rest, try a wizard cantrip you don't know with a DC 10 Arcana check; on a failure the spell and action are wasted.
10 charges, 1d6 + 4 regained at dawn. Action, 1 charge: pull out a pinch of any nonmagical seasoning you name.
4 charges, 1d4 regained at dawn. Action: blow it so only one chosen creature within 600 feet that isn't deafened hears it.
While played, harmless obvious silent illusions fill a 5-foot-radius sphere (15 feet for a bard).

3 charges, regained at dawn. While playing, action, 1 charge: write a message of up to six words (thirteen and optionally glowing for a bard) on a nonmagical surface within 30 feet; it fades after 24 hours or to dispel magic.
An ordinary-looking lock with one key; Dexterity checks to pick it have disadvantage.
Any sword. Unsheathed in darkness, it sheds bright light 15 feet and dim light 15 feet more.
5 percent chance to open any lock it's put in; it vanishes once it does.
Action: learn which way is north. Material Plane only.
Action: learn whether it is morning, afternoon, evening or night outside. Material Plane only.
One use, action to apply, 1 hour: advantage on Charisma checks against humanoids of CR 1 or lower, who don't notice the magic.
While smoking it, action: puff out smoke shaped like a creature that fits in a 1-foot cube for a few seconds.
Command word turns this 10-foot pole into a fishing pole with hook, line and reel, and back.
Action and command word: collapse this 10-foot pole to a 1-foot rod (same weight), or extend it as far as space allows.
A shrub grown in it for 30 days becomes a friendly awakened shrub, breaking the pot.
50 feet of hempen rope. Action and command word: cut pieces in contact knit back together. Lost sections shorten it for good.
Pressed onto a simple or martial weapon for 10 minutes, makes it your spellcasting focus; it stays on until you remove it as an action, the weapon is destroyed, or your attunement ends.
A shield with a face; bonus action to change its expression.
Any armor. Harmless, odorless smoke rises from it while worn.
Up to three objects of 1 pound or less float above its tip while you hold it, and you can make them spin.
10 charges, 1d6 + 4 regained at dawn. Action, 1 charge: make one of ten bird calls audible to 60 feet. Spending the last charge, roll a d20; on a 1 it bursts into feathers and is lost.

10 charges, 1d6 + 4 regained at dawn. Action, 1 charge: a harmless flower (a daisy unless you choose) sprouts from soil within 5 feet or from the staff. Spending the last charge, roll a d20; on a 1 it turns to petals and is lost.
During a short rest within 5 feet, teach it up to six phrases of six words or fewer, each with a trigger within 5 feet of it. Phrases are lost when attunement ends.
Nonmagical alcohol drunk from it doesn't intoxicate; no effect on magical liquids or poison.
An arrow that can't be broken except inside an antimagic field.
Bonus action and command word: becomes an ordinary longsword and stops being magical.
Any ammunition. A creature it hits makes a DC 10 Strength save or falls prone.
3 charges, regained at dawn. Action, 1 charge: orchestral music audible to 60 feet while you wave it. Spending the last charge, roll a d20; on a 1 it crumbles to dust.

7 charges, 1d6 + 1 regained at dawn. Action, 1 charge: a harmless, torch-bright burst of colored light at a point within 60 feet, with a crackle audible to 300 feet. Spending the last charge, roll a d20; on a 1 it is destroyed.
3 charges, regained at dawn. Action, 1 charge: a humanoid within 30 feet makes a DC 10 Charisma save or scowls for 1 minute. Spending the last charge, roll a d20; on a 1 it becomes a wand of smiles.
3 charges, regained at dawn. Action, 1 charge: a humanoid within 30 feet makes a DC 10 Charisma save or smiles for 1 minute. Spending the last charge, roll a d20; on a 1 it becomes a wand of scowls.

Tattoo: attune by holding its needle to your skin, which becomes the tattoo; it vanishes and the needle returns if attunement ends. Resistance to one damage type set by its color (d10: acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant, thunder). Once per dawn, reaction when you take that type: immunity to that instance and regain half the damage as HP.

Spellbook holding enlarge/reduce, feather fall, flesh to stone, gaseous form, magic weapon and polymorph; wizard focus. 3 charges, 1d3 at dawn: 1 minute and 1 charge to swap a prepared wizard spell for a transmutation spell in it; action, charges to transform an unattended nonmagical object (1 foot per side for 1 charge, +2 feet per extra charge) into another of equal or lower value.

+1 (uncommon), +2 (rare) or +3 (very rare) to artificer spell attacks and save DCs. Action: becomes any artisan's tool, which you're proficient with. Once per dawn, action: pick a cantrip from any class to cast as an artificer cantrip for 8 hours.
Holy symbol giving +1 (uncommon), +2 (rare) or +3 (very rare) to spell attacks and save DCs. Once per dawn, use Channel Divinity without spending a use.
Wizard focus and spellbook giving +1 (uncommon), +2 (rare) or +3 (very rare) to wizard spell attacks and save DCs; Arcane Recovery regains 1 extra slot level.
Attach to or detach from a Tiny object as an action; spellcasting focus. Right after you cast a spell using Metamagic, teleport up to 30 feet.

Spellbook holding augury, divination, find the path, foresight, locate creature and locate object; wizard focus. 3 charges, 1d3 at dawn: 1 minute and 1 charge to swap a prepared wizard spell for a divination spell in it; reaction and 1 charge to make a creature within 30 feet add or subtract 1d4 to an attack, check or save after seeing the roll.

Spellbook holding arcane gate, dimension door, gate, misty step, plane shift, teleportation circle and word of recall; wizard focus. 3 charges, 1d3 at dawn: 1 minute and 1 charge to swap a prepared wizard spell for a conjuration spell in it; reaction when hit, 1 charge to teleport 10 feet, and the attack misses if you're now out of its range.

name: Baba Yaga's Mortar and Pestle
spoken: baba yaga s mortar and pestle

display.description: A single artifact (random properties: 2 minor beneficial, 1 major beneficial, 1 minor detrimental). The mortar grows to hold up to a Large creature. The pestle becomes a +3 quarterstaff with 12 charges (up to 3 per hit for +1d8 force each, regained at dawn). Once per short or long rest, fill the mortar with up to 10 gp of a named nonmagical material; it serves as five sets of tools with advantage. It can grind its contents (4d10 force per turn), and while you hold the pestle inside it, it flies you to a named place within 1,000 miles (1 hour, or 1 minute at night), or to another plane or world using ground remains of a creature native there.

Tattoo: attune by holding its needle to your skin, which becomes the tattoo; it vanishes and the needle returns if attunement ends. While unarmored (shield allowed), AC 12 + Dex (uncommon), 15 + Dex max 2 (rare), or 18 (very rare).

Spellcasting focus. 3 charges, 1d3 at dawn: bonus action, 1 charge to sense aberrations, celestials, constructs, elementals, fey, fiends or undead within 60 feet; action, 1 charge to cast protection from evil and good.

Tattoo: attune by holding its needle to your skin, which becomes the tattoo; it vanishes and the needle returns if attunement ends. 10 charges, regained at dawn. On a weapon hit, 1 charge for +4d6 necrotic and heal that much. Reaction when a creature you can see damages you, 1 charge for a melee attack against it with advantage.

Holds a few drops of your blood. Focus giving +1 (uncommon), +2 (rare) or +3 (very rare) to sorcerer spell attacks and save DCs. Once per dawn, when you roll Hit Dice to heal, regain 5 sorcery points.

Tiny pot that is a spellcasting focus and a scrying component. After a long rest, brew a potion of greater healing that lasts 24 hours. Action: grow to fit a crouching Medium creature, or shrink. A humanoid corpse covered in 200 pounds of salt inside for 8 hours returns as if by raise dead at dawn; once per 7 days.

Tattoo: attune by holding its needle to your skin, which becomes the tattoo; it vanishes and the needle returns if attunement ends. Action: a creature within 15 feet makes a DC 14 Str save or takes 3d6 force and is grappled by you (escape DC 14 Athletics or Acrobatics; ends beyond 15 feet).

Random properties: 2 minor beneficial, 1 major beneficial, 1 minor detrimental. 6 charges, 1d6 at dawn, spells at save DC 18: aura of life (2), aura of purity (2), banishment (1), beacon of hope (1), mass cure wounds (3). Absolute Banishment: 10 minutes to banish every fiend under CR 19 within 1 mile for 100 years. Using that or its last charge rolls on a d100 reversal table that can open portals, summon fiends, or trigger Iggwilv's curse, which destroys it into a gate.

Crystal spellbook holding detect thoughts, intellect fortress, Rary's telepathic bond, sending, telekinesis, Tasha's mind whip and Tenser's floating disk; wizard focus; you know mage hand, mind sliver and message. 3 charges, 1d3 at dawn: 1 minute and 1 charge to swap a prepared wizard spell for one in it; 1 charge to cast a wizard spell without verbal, somatic or up to 100 gp material components.

Random properties: 2 minor beneficial, 1 minor detrimental, 1 major detrimental. Cast Tasha's hideous laughter at will; 8 charges, 1d8 at dawn, spells at save DC 20: magic circle (1), magic jar (3), planar ally (3), planar binding (2), plane shift to the Abyss (3), summon fiend (3). Double proficiency on demon lore and Abyss Survival checks; spell damage against fiends is maximized; magic circle against fiends and planar binding on a fiend cast at 9th level with disadvantage on its save. Once per dawn, trap a fiend held in a magic circle in its pages (DC 20 Cha save with disadvantage); trapped fiends may try to possess you after long rests (DC 20 Cha save).

Flail that counts as your holy symbol and deals +1d8 radiant on a hit. Once per dawn, bonus action: a 10-foot cloud of incense for 1 minute; you and others in it regain 1d4 HP at the start of each of your turns.

Looks like a romance novel to others (action to change its look and plot). Spellbook holding hallucinatory terrain, major image, mirror image, mislead, Nystul's magic aura, phantasmal force and silent image; wizard focus. 3 charges, 1d3 at dawn: 1 minute and 1 charge to swap a prepared wizard spell for a illusion spell in it; reaction and 1 charge to give disadvantage on an Investigation check or save against your illusion spell.

Tattoo: attune by holding its needle to your skin, which becomes the tattoo; it vanishes and the needle returns if attunement ends. Unarmed strikes are magical with +1 to attack and damage. Once per dawn, bonus action for 1 minute: melee attacks reach 15 feet and deal +1d6 force.

Attach to or detach from a Tiny object as an action; spellcasting focus. When you use Metamagic, its essence (d4) triggers: Air, fly 60 feet without provoking; Earth, resistance to a damage type until your next turn; Fire, a target catches fire and takes 2d10 fire at the start of its next turn; Water, chosen creatures within 10 feet take 2d6 cold and make a Str save or are pushed 10 feet and knocked prone.

Attach to or detach from a Tiny object as an action; spellcasting focus. When you use Metamagic, a creature within 30 feet makes a Cha save against your spell DC or takes 3d6 psychic and is frightened until your next turn.

Attach to or detach from a Tiny object as an action; spellcasting focus. When you use Metamagic, you can roll on the Wild Magic Surge table (a resulting spell ignores Metamagic and concentration). Without the Wild Magic origin, once per dawn.

Spellbook holding contingency, fireball, gust of wind, Leomund's tiny hut, magic missile, thunderwave and wall of force; wizard focus. 3 charges, 1d3 at dawn: 1 minute and 1 charge to swap a prepared wizard spell for a evocation spell in it; reaction and 1 charge when your evocation spell damages a creature: +2d6 force and knock it prone if Large or smaller.

Tattoo: attune by holding its needle to your skin, which becomes the tattoo; it vanishes and the needle returns if attunement ends. 3 charges, regained at dawn. Bonus action, 1 charge: incorporeal until the end of your next turn, with resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing, immunity to grapple and restraint, and movement through creatures and objects (1d10 force if you end inside one).
Holy symbol attached to armor or a shield as an action. 3 charges, regained at dawn: reaction and 1 charge to turn a critical hit on you or a creature within 30 feet into a normal hit.

Spellbook holding antipathy/sympathy, charm person, dominate person, enthrall, hypnotic pattern, modify memory and suggestion; wizard focus. 3 charges, 1d3 at dawn: 1 minute and 1 charge to swap a prepared wizard spell for a enchantment spell in it; 1 charge when casting an enchantment spell to give one target disadvantage on its first save.

Tattoo: attune by holding its needle to your skin, which becomes the tattoo; it vanishes and the needle returns if attunement ends. Write with your fingertip as an endless pen. Once per dawn, action: a page of writing becomes invisible to all but you and one named creature for 24 hours.

Spellbook holding animate dead, circle of death, false life, finger of death, speak with dead, summon undead and vampiric touch; wizard focus. 3 charges, 1d3 at dawn: 1 minute and 1 charge to swap a prepared wizard spell for a necromancy spell in it; action and 1 charge to seem undead for 10 minutes (undead ignore you unless harmed; ends if you deal damage or force a save).

Tattoo: attune by holding its needle to your skin, which becomes the tattoo; it vanishes and the needle returns if attunement ends. Resistance to necrotic. Once per dawn, when reduced to 0 HP you drop to 1 instead.

Random properties: 2 minor beneficial, 2 minor detrimental. Action, each once per dawn (save DC 18): comprehend languages, detect evil and good, detect magic, detect poison and disease, locate object, scrying. Concentration on divination spells always holds. Twist of Fate, twice per dawn: a creature within 15 feet has advantage (Weal) or disadvantage (Woe) on attacks, checks and saves for 1 hour; each use rolls d100 and on 1-14 frees a trapped undead soul that gets Weal while you and the target get Woe until it is destroyed. Attunement ends after 7 days without a Twist of Fate.

Cast mending at will as an action. Reaction when an object or structure within 300 feet takes damage: it is immune to that damage type until your next turn. Action, each once per dawn: fabricate, move earth, passwall or summon construct.

Tattoo: attune by holding its needle to your skin, which becomes the tattoo; it vanishes and the needle returns if attunement ends. Bonus action: change its color, pattern, size and place on your skin. Once per dawn, action: cast disguise self (DC 13).

A 10-foot black construct piloted by up to two attuned creatures (2-hour attunement inside, during which nearby targets risk a stray fist). Its hatch costs 10 feet of movement; the crew has total cover. Crew can move it and command its actions, or a Destructive Fist reaction for opportunity attacks. Huge construct, AC 22, HP 310. Leuk-o's ghost can act once per 24 hours unbidden, and below half HP the crew make a DC 20 Wis save or are charmed for 24 hours into a rampage. A secret 3-round code self-destructs it: DC 25 Dex save in a 100-foot radius, 25d6 each of force, lightning and thunder (half on success), and its parts land within 1,000 miles 2d6 days later.

Sickle giving +1 (uncommon), +2 (rare) or +3 (very rare) to its attack and damage and to druid and ranger spell attacks and save DCs; druid and ranger focus. Your healing spells restore an extra 1d4 while you hold it.
Druid and ranger focus. In a lightly obscured area, you can Hide as a bonus action even while observed.

Attach to or detach from a Tiny object as an action; spellcasting focus. When you use Metamagic, its essence (d4) triggers: Lawful, end charmed, blinded, deafened, frightened, poisoned or stunned on you or a creature within 30 feet; Chaotic, a damaged target has disadvantage on attacks and checks until your next turn; Good, you or a creature within 30 feet gains 3d6 temporary HP; Evil, a damaged target takes +3d6 necrotic.

Spellbook holding banishment, find familiar, gate, magic circle, planar binding and summon elemental; wizard focus. 3 charges, 1d3 at dawn: 1 minute and 1 charge to swap a prepared wizard spell for a conjuration spell in it; 1 charge when a conjuration spell summons or creates one creature to give it advantage on attacks for 1 minute.
Replaces a lost limb and works like it; attach or detach as an action, can't be removed against your will, detaches when you die.

Iron-locked (DC 20); action to arcane-lock it. Spellbook holding arcane lock, dispel magic, globe of invulnerability, glyph of warding, Mordenkainen's private sanctum, protection from evil and good and symbol; wizard focus. 3 charges, 1d3 at dawn: 1 minute and 1 charge to swap a prepared wizard spell for a abjuration spell in it; 1 charge when casting an abjuration spell to give a creature within 30 feet 2d10 temporary HP.
+2 to your bard spell save DCs. Once per dawn, action: cast Otto's irresistible dance from it.
+1 (uncommon), +2 (rare) or +3 (very rare) to bard spell attacks and save DCs. Once per dawn, action: regain one Bardic Inspiration use.

Tattoo: attune by holding its needle to your skin, which becomes the tattoo; it vanishes and the needle returns if attunement ends. Darkvision 60 feet and advantage on Stealth. Once per sunset, reaction when you take damage: halve it.

Attach to or detach from a Tiny object as an action; spellcasting focus. When you use Metamagic, curse one target of the spell: disadvantage on checks and saves with one chosen ability until the end of your next turn.

Holds one spell of up to 5th level; applying it with its needle lets you cast that spell once with no material components, then it fades. Cantrip and 1st: common, +3 ability, DC 13, +5 attack; 2nd: uncommon, same; 3rd: uncommon, +4, DC 15, +7; 4th: rare, same; 5th: rare, +5, DC 17, +9.

A pouch of 20 story teeth. Action: draw one (d20; used teeth fall to the next lowest unused) and either sow it to summon its tale's creatures as allies for 10 minutes, or implant it to replace one of your teeth for a lasting power and drawback (up to 1 + Con mod implanted, min 2). If you do neither, at the end of the turn it either summons them as hostile or implants itself. Effects range from revivify charges and telepathy to fire breath, dominate monster and divine intervention. Each tooth is destroyed only by sowing it where its tale began.
+1 dagger. On a hit with a roll of 19 or 20, the target makes a DC 15 Con save, taking 6d6 necrotic (half on a success); a creature reduced to 0 HP by it turns to dust.

4 charges, regains 1d4 at dawn. Equalize: reaction and 1 charge when you or a creature you see within 60 ft. is about to roll a d20 with advantage or disadvantage; the roll is made straight. Expunge Imbalance: bonus action and 2 charges to cast lesser restoration.

6 charges, regains 1d6 at dawn. Star Flight: bonus action, 1 charge, fly speed equal to walking (hover) for 10 minutes. Starlight Strike: action, any number of charges, one bolt per charge that automatically hits creatures you see within 120 ft. for 2d4 cold each. Whirling Hail: action, 3 charges, ice storm (save DC 16).

On attuning, attach it to a nonmagical melee weapon, which becomes +1 until attunement ends. While wielding it: advantage on saves against being sent to an extradimensional space, demiplane or other plane; once per dawn on a hit, the target makes a DC 16 Cha save or is banished to a harmless demiplane until the end of its next turn.

While wielding: resistance to poison and immunity to petrified. Once per dawn, bonus action: a creature you see within 30 ft. makes a DC 20 Con save or is restrained, repeating the save at the start of its next turn (failure: petrified for 24 hours; success: ends). Action: cast lesser restoration, locate creature or transport via plants, each once per dawn.

Once per dawn, action: create up to 100 gp of coins within 10 ft. that vanish after 1 hour. Bonus action: change the apparent style, color and quality of your clothing and armor (fails physical inspection).

+2 weapon. Once per dawn, bonus action: feint against a creature within 5 ft., gaining advantage on attacks against it until your next turn. Once per dawn, reaction when a creature within 60 ft. attacks you: it makes a DC 15 Int save or the attack targets another creature of your choice in its reach.

+1 bow; ranged hits deal an extra 1d6 radiant. Unloaded, it creates a vanishing magic arrow for each shot. Once per dawn, bonus action: become semi-incorporeal until your next turn, with resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing.

display.attunementNote: by a bard, sorcerer, or warlock
display.description: Spellcasting focus; +3 to Charisma-based spell attack rolls and save DCs. Once per dawn, reaction when hit by an attack roll: take no damage and teleport up to 30 ft. Once per dawn, treat a natural 1 on a d20 as a 20.

Once per dawn, bonus action: summon a spirit using the knight stat block within 30 ft. for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 HP. It acts right after you, obeys your commands (no action), and Dodges if not commanded.
3 charges, regains 1d4 - 1 at dawn. Spend 1 charge to gain advantage on an Intelligence check.

Arcane focus. Resistance to fire and necrotic. Once per dawn, cast hellish rebuke at 4th level (save DC 16). Once per dawn, when you cast a spell that deals fire or necrotic damage, deal maximum damage instead of rolling.

Darkvision 60 ft. (or +60 ft. if you have it). Bonus action in dim light or darkness: teleport up to 30 ft. to dim light or darkness you can see, then have advantage on your first melee attack this turn. Once per dawn, cast antagonize (save DC 15).

+1 flail; double damage to objects and structures. Once per dawn on a hit, the target makes a DC 15 Con save or is poisoned for 1 minute, taking 2d4 necrotic at the start of each of its turns (repeat the save each turn end).

Action: cast augury once per dawn. Each signet also casts two spells once per dawn each, using your Intelligence: Bear (very rare) enlarge/reduce, polymorph; Hart (very rare) aura of vitality, mass cure wounds; Lion (very rare) destructive wave, fireball; Serpent (rare) fear, hex; Songbird (rare) charm person, hypnotic pattern; Wolf (very rare) freedom of movement, pass without trace.
Resistance to cold, poison and necrotic. Once per dawn, cast spirit of death without material components.

6 charges, regains 1d6 at dawn. Battle Foreknowledge: 1 charge when you roll initiative to add or subtract your proficiency bonus. Doom Foretold: action, 2 charges, a creature within 30 ft. for 1 hour: you sense its direction and movement on the same plane, and once per turn add 1d6 to damage you deal it. Twist of Fate: reaction, 3 charges, when a creature within 60 ft. makes a save or attack roll, flip the result (failure to success, miss to hit, or the reverse).

Ignores loading; unloaded, it creates a vanishing magic bolt for each shot. 3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn; bonus action and 1 charge to invoke a constellation: Balance (your next ranged hit before the end of your next turn lets you or a creature within 30 ft. regain 1d8 + proficiency bonus HP), Flames (until the end of your next turn, ranged hits deal an extra 2d8 fire), or Rogue (you and your gear are invisible until the end of your next turn).

display.attunementNote: by a cleric, druid, or wizard
display.description: +1 quarterstaff; hits deal an extra 1d8 fire. Spellcasting focus; once per dawn, when you cast a slot spell dealing fire or radiant damage, reroll up to your proficiency bonus in damage dice and use the new rolls. Bonus action: glow with sunlight, bright 15 ft. and dim 15 ft. beyond, until you douse it.

Once per dawn, bonus action: an invulnerable, condition-immune projection of you appears within 30 ft. until the end of your turn; you can attack and cast non-self spells from its space. Cursed: you won't part with it, removing it doesn't end the curse, and after each long rest you make a DC 11 Cha save or your soul is trapped in an object on another plane (your body inert and ageless) until the object is destroyed or wish restores you.

Action in key form: cast knock. Bonus action: become a +1 longsword you are proficient with, dealing 1d10 force on a hit, until it leaves your grasp or you revert it as a bonus action. Ending attunement reverts it.

+1 weapon; grants proficiency in Intimidation and Persuasion. 5 charges, regains 1d4 at dawn; bonus action to cast (save DC 16) command (1), zone of truth (2), compulsion (4), banishment (4) or dominate person (5).
Action: throw a spectral card as a ranged spell attack using Dex, range 120 ft., 1d8 force. Once per dawn, action: cast spray of cards at 3rd level (save DC 15).

6 charges, regains 1d6 at dawn. Marked Card: bonus action, 1 charge, place a card within 5 ft.; once within 24 hours, action to teleport to it (it returns to the deck after use or 8 hours). Riffling Portal: action, 3 charges, cast arcane gate (the deck returns when the spell ends). Shuffling Stride: bonus action, 1 charge, throw a card up to 60 ft. and teleport to it.

32 cards, each depicting mundane gear (rations, tools, rope, weapons, coins and the like, plus a see-through window for a wall up to 5 ft. thick). Action: draw the card you choose and throw it within 5 ft.; it permanently becomes the pictured item or items.

Action: draw a random card and throw it as a ranged spell attack using Dex, range 30 ft., 1d4 slashing plus a suit effect (DC 15): Rods, target and creatures within 5 ft. make a Dex save or take 2d8 fire; Coins, target makes a Dex save or is blinded until the end of your next turn and creatures within 10 ft. of it take 1d6 lightning; Cups, target takes 1d10 cold and makes a Con save or is restrained until the end of your next turn; Swords, target and creatures within 5 ft. take 1d6 force and make a Str save or fall prone. The card returns.

44 extra cards in the style of the Deck of Many Things, often combined with it into a 66-card deck. Declare a number of draws first and make each within an hour of the last; unmade draws all take effect at once. Most cards return to the deck after taking effect. Effects range from boons (ability score increases, languages, telepathy, a loyal wyrmling, gate or true resurrection castings, treasure, a bound deity's aid) to dangers (dropping to 0 HP, exhaustion, petrification, imprisonment in force chains, a hostile monstrosity or gelatinous cube, transformation into a beast, a vengeful revenant). About a third are harmful.

A 13-card deck (or 22 cards, 25% of the time) of minor boons and banes. Declare draws first, each within an hour of the last. Cards include temporary HP, +1 to weapon attacks or saves, resistances for 1d12 days, darkvision 300 ft., spell uses (augury, friends, knock), treasure, an uncommon magic weapon or wondrous item, and drawbacks such as initiative disadvantage, a 1d4 penalty to saves, reduced HP maximum, a stolen item, or a brief trip to an extradimensional space.

After a long rest, spend 10 minutes to roll and record a d20. Once in the next 8 hours, reaction right after a creature within 60 ft. makes a check, attack roll or save: it uses your recorded number instead. Once per dawn, cast divination from the deck.
Magic dagger; hits deal an extra 1d6 force. Once per dawn on a hit: until the target finishes a long rest, attacks against it are critical hits on 19 or 20.

Rare +1, very rare +2, legendary +3. Spellcasting focus that adds its bonus to spell attack rolls and save DCs. Action: expend and roll a Hit Die, add the bonus, and a creature you see within 30 ft. takes that much radiant damage or regains that many HP (your choice).

Once per dawn, action: the deck forms a shelter of your design within a 40-ft. cube centered within 30 ft., with one door and up to four windows only you can open, floor, roof and comfortable temperature. It has AC 15, 50 HP and immunity to poison and psychic, and lasts 24 hours, until dismissed as an action, or until destroyed.
Once per dawn, reaction: advantage on a save against a spell. Once per dawn, cast antimagic field without components.
Once per dawn, bonus action: spores fill a 10-ft. sphere around you; creatures there make a DC 15 Con save or are poisoned until the end of your next turn.
Cast speak with dead or animate dead, one of them once per dawn. If you die while attuned, the armor is destroyed.
5 charges, regains 1d4 + 1 at dawn. Bonus action: cast jump (1 charge) or levitate (2 charges) on yourself.
+2 to attack and damage rolls while you are at half HP or less.
Ranged attack rolls with it have advantage against a creature missing any HP.
Ranged weapon attack with the shield (20/60 ft., Str or Dex, proficient if proficient with shields), 1d6 slashing; it returns to your hand after the attack.
Hits deal an extra 1d6 fire; a flammable nonmagical object hit catches fire, taking 1d6 fire at the start of each of your turns until someone uses an action to put it out.
Before a ranged attack, play one melody: Precision (+1 to the roll if proficient in Performance, +2 with expertise) or Reverberation (on a hit, extra thunder damage equal to your Cha modifier).
4 charges, regains 1d4 at dawn. Spend 1 charge to turn a d20 you roll into a 10.

On a ranged hit, the leech latches on and deals 1d4 piercing at the start of each of the target's turns until it has dealt 10 damage, the target dies, or a creature uses an action to remove it; then it dies and loses its magic.
Advantage on saves to avoid or end being charmed. 3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn; action and 1 charge to cast compulsion (save DC 15).
+2 weapon. Striking a Large or smaller structure of magical force (forcecage, wall of force) shatters it; against a Huge or larger one it shatters a 20-ft. cube.
Advantage on saves to avoid or end being frightened. 3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn; spend 1 charge to cast calm emotions (save DC 15).
+1 whip. On hitting a Large or smaller creature or object, you can pull it 5 ft. toward you instead of dealing damage.

3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn. Bonus action and 1 charge: a 15-ft.-radius rune circle at the impact point for 1 minute (or until replaced or dismissed as a bonus action); while inside it, +3 to attack and damage rolls with the hammer.
+1 AC on top of the shield's normal bonus. Cursed until remove curse or similar: you can't discard it, your speed is halved, and your initiative d20 always counts as a 1 and can't be changed.
A Giant hit by a ranged attack with it makes a DC 18 Con save or falls prone.
+1 war pick. Once per dawn, cast meld into stone. 1d6 + 1 charges (not regained): on a critical hit against a creature under 100 HP, spend 1 to force a DC 15 Con save or it is petrified for 8 hours.

+3 sword. Once per dawn, action: slice a rift up to 10 by 10 ft. within 5 ft. to another plane for 1 minute, opening at or near a destination you name (DM's discretion); anything entering it arrives on that plane.
+2 trident; advantage on attacks with it underwater. 3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn: control water (1 charge) or tsunami (3 charges), save DC 15.
Ranged attacks with it ignore half and three-quarters cover, and long range doesn't impose disadvantage.
Uncommon +1, rare +2, very rare +3. Your unarmed strikes count as magical against resistance and immunity and gain the bonus to attack and damage rolls.

After 1 hour calibrating, make a DC 17 Arcana check to teleport you and up to eight willing creatures touching it to the celestial body it points at. On a failure, a mishap (d6): adrift in the Astral Sea, a different plane, the telescope explodes (8d6 necrotic within 60 ft., surviving Humanoids reincarnated), an Astral creature appears, a different body in the nearest Wildspace system, or arrival coated in harmless slime.

3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn. Action and 1 charge: a creature you see within 120 ft. makes a DC 15 Dex save or takes 3d6 fire. Cursed until remove curse: you can't remove them, and if a target rolls a 20 on the save you are blinded for 24 hours.

3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn. Bonus action and 1 charge: +30 ft. walking speed and advantage on Dex saves for 1 minute. Cursed until remove curse: you can't remove them, you have disadvantage on saves against being frightened, and starting a turn frightened makes them scream; you and creatures within 10 ft. make a DC 15 Con save, 9 (2d8) thunder, half on a success.

display.attunementNote: by a creature missing a hand or an arm
display.description: Attaches as a prosthetic that works as a normal limb and can't be removed against your will. It is a magic melee weapon you're proficient with: 1d8 force, thrown (20/60), flying back and reattaching after a throw.
Attaches to your forearm while attuned; bonus action to extend or retract it. Extended, you wield it as if held but can't use that hand otherwise.

Darkvision 120 ft. that sees through magical darkness. 10 charges (regains 1d6 + 3 at dawn), action to cast (save DC 16): charm person (1), sleep (1), hold person (2), ray of enfeeblement (2), fear (3), slow (3), telekinesis (5), disintegrate (6), flesh to stone (6), finger of death (7). Symbiotic: can't be removed or unattuned except by a spell that ends a curse. Belashyrra can see through it.
Action while touching it: removes dirt and grime from you and your clothes.

Sentient sphere embedded in your body (Int 16, Wis 14, Cha 14, telepathic). Stabilizes you with a +6 Medicine check when you end your turn at 0 HP. Knows Common, Giant and 1d4 more languages (learns more up to six), has +7 in Arcana, History, Investigation or Nature (d4), and casts detect evil and good or detect magic at will (d6).

+2 to attack and damage, disadvantage on attacks against aberrations, +1d6 psychic on a hit, and a natural 20 stuns the target until the end of its next turn. Bonus action to retract into or draw from your arm. Symbiotic: can't be removed or unattuned except by a spell that ends a curse.

You speak, read and write Deep Speech. 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn): detect thoughts (2) or dissonant whispers (1), save DC 15; detect thoughts reports to the nearest daelkyr. Symbiotic: can't be removed or unattuned except by a spell that ends a curse.
Bullseye lantern lit like continual flame: 120-foot cone, bright for the first 60 feet and dim for the rest.

display.attunementNote: by a creature with the Mark of Finding
display.description: Add 1d4 to Wisdom (Insight) checks. Once per dawn, action: Insight check (DC 13 + days since contact) on an object to learn the type of the last creature that touched it, then cast locate creature to find it.
Common: bonus action to animate an illusory pattern in the cloth. Uncommon: the illusion can rise from the cloth, and once per dawn add 1d4 to a Performance or Persuasion check.

Spellcasting focus; +1 to one damage roll of a spell cast through it that deals its wood's type: Fernian ash (fire), Irian rosewood (radiant), Kythrian manchineel (acid or poison), Lamannian oak (lightning or thunder), Mabaran ebony (necrotic), Risian pine (cold), Shavarran birch (force), Xorian wenge (psychic).

display.attunementNote: by a creature with the Mark of Warding
display.description: Tie up to three of your alarm, arcane lock or glyph of warding spells to it; its holder gets the alarm, bypasses the lock or avoids the glyph, and with your command word can end one tied spell as an action.

Drunk to attune. Resistance to acid and poison and immunity to poisoned. Once per dawn each: become amorphous for 1 minute (squeeze through 1 inch), and exhale a 30-foot line 5 feet wide of acid (DC 15 Dex, 36 (8d8) acid, half on success). Symbiotic: can't be removed or unattuned except by a spell that ends a curse; if you die with it inside, your corpse becomes a black pudding.

+1 AC and resistance to necrotic, poison and psychic. After each long rest, feed it half your remaining Hit Dice (round up) or gain 1 exhaustion. Symbiotic: can't be removed or unattuned except by a spell that ends a curse.

Choose proficiency with Sleight of Hand, thieves' tools, one artisan's tools or one instrument when attuning; double your proficiency bonus on checks with it. Symbiotic: can't be removed or unattuned except by a spell that ends a curse.

Spellcasting focus. Reaction while holding it: reduce damage of its material's type by 1d4: Fernian basalt (fire), Irian quartz (radiant), Kythrian skarn (acid and poison), Lamannian flint (lightning and thunder), Mabaran obsidian (necrotic), Risian shale (cold), Shavarran chert (force), Xorian marble (psychic).

display.attunementNote: by a creature with the Mark of Scribing
display.description: Writes on any surface, visibly or invisibly; Mark of Scribing bearers always see it and can reveal it with an action. Writing on a non-construct creature fades in 7 days.
Holds up to five outfits; bonus action command word switches between them (clothing only, no magical properties copied).

A gnome with the Mark of Scribing can touch it and use an action to cast sending to another speaking stone whose location or symbols they know; creatures within 5 feet of the receiving stone hear the message.
Stores up to a 320-page book, optionally passphrase-locked. Action to open your mind to it; reading or writing then takes concentration and normal time. A wizard can use it as a spellbook.

Replace your lungs: breathe normally anywhere (even in a vacuum or antimagic field), advantage on saves against harmful gases, and once per dawn exhale gust of wind (save DC 15) as an action. Your lungs return if attunement ends.
Clamps to your arm and can't be removed while attuned. Insert a wand as an action; extend or retract it as a bonus action and use it with a free hand. Sheath and wand share one attunement slot.
Mounted on an elemental vessel's helm, lets a Mark of Storm bearer telepathically control its bound elemental; on a mundane ship, raises its speed by 5 mph.

display.rarity: Uncommon, Rare, or Very Rare (by guild)
display.attunementNote: by a member of the relevant guild
display.description: Action: set it down within 5 feet and it becomes a creature friendly to you and your guild that obeys you (Dodging if uncommanded), reverting at the end of its duration, at 0 HP, or when you speak the command word again; it can't transform again for 36 hours. Azorius (rare): giant eagle, 1 hour, telepathy within 1 mile and you can use its senses as an action. Boros (rare): veteran, 8 hours. Dimir (very rare): intellect devourer, 24 hours, pursuing one mission. Golgari (very rare): giant scorpion (Int 4), 6 hours, telepathy within 60 feet. Gruul (rare): ceratok (rhinoceros), 1 hour. Izzet (rare): galvanice weird, 3 hours. Orzhov (rare): winged thrull, 2 hours. Rakdos (uncommon): cackler, 1 hour. Selesnya (rare): dire wolf (Int 6), 8 hours, telepathy within 1 mile. Simic (uncommon): category 1 krasis with Grabber and Stabilizing Legs, 5 hours.

3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn); spend 1 to cast your guild's spell (save DC 13): Azorius ensnaring strike, Boros heroism, Dimir disguise self, Golgari entangle, Gruul compelled duel, Izzet chaos bolt, Orzhov command, Rakdos hellish rebuke, Selesnya charm person, Simic expeditious retreat.
When you cast a cantrip, you can cast it again as a bonus action that turn.

display.attunementNote: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
display.description: Arcane focus. You can try to cast a class-list spell you don't know or haven't prepared, using a slot and its components: Intelligence (Arcana) check DC 10 + twice the slot level (DC 10 for cantrips, which simply fail). On a failure you cast a random spell of that slot level instead: 1st burning hands, chaos bolt, color spray, faerie fire, fog cloud, thunderwave; 2nd blur, gust of wind, heat metal, Melf's acid arrow, scorching ray, shatter; 3rd fear, feign death, fireball, gaseous form, sleet storm, stinking cloud; 4th confusion, conjure minor elementals, Evard's black tentacles, ice storm; 5th+ animate objects, cloudkill, cone of cold, flame strike.

display.type: Armor (medium or heavy, but not hide)
display.description: Critical hits against you become normal hits, and on a successful Str or Con save against a magical half-damage effect you take no damage.

4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn). Molten Spray (1 charge, action): 30-foot cone, DC 15 Dex save, 5d4 fire, half on success. Mizzium Bombard (3 charges, action): 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder within 60 feet, DC 15 Dex save, 5d8 fire, half on success.
Applied in 1 minute; for 8 hours a creature that sees you and passes a DC 10 Insight check (advantage for dark elves) learns your current emotion and its main source.
+1 AC per two allies within 5 feet (max +3) on top of the shield. Reaction: take the damage dealt to a creature you can see within 5 feet instead, as force damage.
Flying speed 60 feet and advantage on initiative rolls.
Action: 10-foot cone, DC 13 Dex save, 4d6 fire, half on success. Each use roll d10 plus uses since your last long rest; on 11+ it malfunctions, dealing 4d6 fire to you, unusable until a long rest.

+1 to attack and damage. A creature it kills has its soul trapped (up to five; revival only by wish), each adding 1d4 necrotic to its hits. Bonus action: release souls to regain 1d10 HP each. With five souls, reaction after a damaging hit: release them all, and a target under 75 HP makes a DC 15 Con save or dies (once per long rest if it kills).

+1 to attack and damage, and +1 to spell attack rolls while held. Reaction when a flying creature within 30 feet attacks you: it has disadvantage and makes a DC 15 Con save or is blinded until the start of its next turn.
Telepathy with a known wearer of another spies' murmur within 1 mile. Bonus action: let that creature hear what you hear for 1 hour (ends as a bonus action or if you're incapacitated).

+2 to attack and damage. Action: hurl it up to 120 feet to explode in a 20-foot sphere, DC 15 Dex save, 6d6 fire, half on success; recall it to your hand with an action. Once per short or long rest; uncalled, it returns after 24 hours or when attunement ends.

+1 to attack and damage. Once per turn, right after you Attack with it, Dash or Dodge, a creature within 60 feet can use its reaction to make one weapon attack, move up to its speed, or Dodge, respectively.

+1 to attack and damage, and +1 to spell attack rolls while held. 10 charges (regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn; on the last charge roll d20, vanishing on a 1): banishment (4), blink (3), misty step (2), passwall (5), teleport (7).

Riders and the creatures pulling it gain +1 AC, and it flies if pulled by flying creatures. Chariot rules: mounting or dismounting costs 5 feet, riders have half cover, speed equals the slowest puller, and multiple pullers share initiative and actions.

Senses the location of celestials and fiends within 30 feet not behind total cover.
