After a long rest, pray to a god to store its spell (save DC 13): Athreos protection from evil and good, Ephara sanctuary, Erebos inflict wounds, Heliod guiding bolt, Iroas heroism, Karametra goodberry, Keranos thunderous smite, Klothys entangle, Kruphix dissonant whispers, Mogis hellish rebuke, Nylea faerie fire, Pharika lesser restoration, Phenax charm person, Purphoros searing smite, Thassa identify. 3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn), 1 per cast.
Adheres to your skin, wearable under clothes and removable only by choice. Resistance to fire, and no disadvantage on Stealth checks.

For 10 minutes (or until incapacitated or dead) you become a pool of water: swim 30 feet, move through liquids, occupy creatures' spaces, pass through Tiny openings, douse nonmagical flames, resistance to nonmagical damage, and advantage on Str, Dex and Con saves. You can't talk, attack, cast spells or use magic items; gear melds into you.

Touching it for 1 minute grants a short rest and bless until your next rest (once per long rest), but you make a DC 17 Wis save or are charmed for 1 hour and try to open it. Opened, roll d8 (save DC 17): berserk fury within 60 feet, harm on all within 30 feet, tsunami, flesh to stone within 30 feet, maze within 30 feet, 1d4 hostile shadow demons, insect plague, or Otto's irresistible dance within 30 feet. It then vanishes for 24 hours.
Action: cast animal friendship, charm person, enthrall or suggestion (save DC 13), each once per dawn.

A pouch of 1d4 + 4 bullets with +2 to attack and damage; a miss teleports back to the pouch, a hit spends the bullet. Each has one property (d4): Banishment (DC 15 Cha save or banished), Fulguration (+2d8 lightning, and others within 10 feet make a DC 15 Con save or take 1d8 thunder), Stunning (+1d10 force and stunned until the end of your next turn), Tracking (marked for 24 hours; you know its direction).
+1 to attack and damage. On a hit, the shot can ricochet to make a ranged attack against a second target within 10 feet of the first.

+3 to attack and damage, +3d10 fire on a hit. Resistance to fire, immunity to exhaustion, proficiency and advantage with smith's tools. Once per dusk each, cast animate objects, fabricate, heat metal, magic weapon, mending or shatter (DC 18). Piety with Purphoros adds random beneficial properties (10+ minor, 25+ major, 50+ another major); non-worshipers get 2 minor detrimental properties.

+3 to attack and damage, +2d10 cold on a hit. Once per dusk each: whip up or calm the sea within 1 mile for 1 hour, cast dominate monster (DC 18) on swimming beasts or monstrosities, and cast true polymorph (DC 18) into a swimming creature. Piety with Thassa: 10+ water breathing and swim 60, 25+ minor, 50+ major property; non-worshipers get 1 minor and 1 major detrimental property.

+3 to attack and damage, no disadvantage at long range, crits on 19-20. Four season arrows return each dusk (DC 18): Spring awakens a beast or plant for 8 hours, Summer summons a Nyxborn lynx (tiger) for 1 hour, Autumn casts wall of thorns, Winter casts ice storm. Piety with Nylea: 10+ minor, 25+ major property; non-worshipers get 1 major detrimental property.

+3 to attack and damage, +2d8 radiant on a hit; sheds sunlight 30 feet bright and 30 dim. Once per dawn, reaction when damaged by a creature within 5 feet: attack it, blinding it on a hit. 10 charges (regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn, DC 18): guiding bolt (1), daylight (3), sunbeam (6). Piety with Heliod: 3+ 15 temporary HP each dawn, 10+ and 25+ minor, 50+ major property; non-worshipers get 2 major detrimental properties.

+3 to attack and damage, +2d8 necrotic on a hit and you heal half of it; once per dusk an attack can reach 300 feet. Once per dusk each, cast circle of death or dominate monster (undead only), DC 18. Piety with Erebos: 1+ a minor detrimental property, 25+ and 50+ a major beneficial property each; non-worshipers get 2 major detrimental properties.
Always holds warm coffee (and nothing else); poured coffee vanishes. Each drink roll d20: on a 1 it gives no coffee for an hour.
Action: stick it to your arm, shoulder or leg for 1 hour. Once per long rest (if the save succeeds), give yourself advantage on a save to avoid or end frightened while carrying it.

3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn): add 1d4 to a History or Religion check. Studying it at the end of a long rest lets you cast one chosen 1st-level cleric or wizard spell once without a slot before your next long rest (Int, Wis or Cha).

3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn): add 1d4 to an Acrobatics or Performance check. Studying it at the end of a long rest lets you cast one chosen 1st-level bard or sorcerer spell once without a slot before your next long rest (Int, Wis or Cha).

3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn): add 1d4 to an Arcana or Nature check. Studying it at the end of a long rest lets you cast one chosen 1st-level druid or wizard spell once without a slot before your next long rest (Int, Wis or Cha).

3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn): add 1d4 to an Intimidation or Persuasion check. Studying it at the end of a long rest lets you cast one chosen 1st-level bard or cleric spell once without a slot before your next long rest (Int, Wis or Cha).
While waved, its college symbol glitters and it sheds bright light 10 feet and dim light 10 more.

3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn): add 1d4 to a Nature or Survival check. Studying it at the end of a long rest lets you cast one chosen 1st-level druid or wizard spell once without a slot before your next long rest (Int, Wis or Cha).

A bulky full-body suit that takes 1 minute to don or doff. While worn you can breathe in an airless environment and are immune to harmful effects of surrounding gases, and you gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed underwater, or a flying speed equal to it in zero gravity.

An ornate chair that propels and steers a ship of 1 ton or more through space, air or water (if built for it). While attuned, seated and concentrating, you move the ship up to its speed (in space with no other 1-ton object within 1 mile, up to 100 million miles in 24 hours), steer it clumsily, and see and hear from any point aboard. Transfer Attunement: as an action, touch a willing spellcaster to pass your attunement to them.

Inside a Wildspace system, this portable device tracks every sun, planet, moon and comet in the system and projects a display of them above itself, with a pulsing white point marking the orrery's own location.

+3 to attack and damage rolls. When you hit a Dragon with it, the Dragon takes an extra 3d6 force damage, and any Dragon of your choice you can see within 30 feet can immediately make a melee attack with its reaction.

An ornate chair (AC 15, 18 HP, immune to poison and psychic) that drives the flying citadel it is installed in. While attuned, seated and concentrating, you move the citadel up to 80 feet per round (8 mph), steer it clumsily, and see and hear from its highest outside point; with no one concentrating it hangs motionless. Transfer Attunement: as an action or bonus action, touch a willing spellcaster to pass your attunement to them. Crash: if the helm is destroyed, the citadel crumbles and descends 30 feet per round; creatures on it or within 120 feet of where it lands make a DC 20 Dex save, 39 (6d12) bludgeoning, half on success.

A cloak of woven autumn leaves. While worn you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Once per dawn, as a bonus action, teleport with your gear to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet and gain advantage on your next attack roll before the end of the turn.

A 3-foot elven mirror (25 lb.; AC 11, 10 HP, vulnerable to bludgeoning). Held upright, speak its command word as an action to make it hover in place (it can't be moved) until you speak the word again or your attunement ends; once deactivated it can't be reactivated until the next dawn. A non-Construct creature other than you that sees its reflection within 30 feet makes a DC 15 Wis save or is paralyzed, lost in idealized memories, until the mirror is deactivated or it can no longer see the mirror (repeat save each turn end). A creature that saves or is freed is immune for 24 hours.

A 5-pound skull-shaped device etched with planar sigils. As a bonus action toss it into the air to float 1d3 feet from you (counts as worn; AC 22, 25 HP, immune to poison and psychic, resistant to all other damage); another creature can snatch it as an action with an unarmed strike against AC 22 or a DC 22 Dex (Acrobatics) check, and you can stow it as a bonus action. While it floats: once per dawn, cast legend lore from it as an action, the mimir speaking the lore aloud; and it answers questions from you or those you designate about the planes and the Outlands' gate-towns.
Its needle points toward the last portal it passed through while both are on the same plane; if that portal no longer exists, the needle stays still until the compass passes through a new one.

Holds one recorded experience. As an action, you or a willing creature you choose touches it to relive the sensation harmlessly. Record Sensation: as a reaction, store a sensation of up to 6 seconds experienced by a creature within 30 feet, replacing any stored one. Siphon Sensation: as a bonus action, end the charmed or frightened condition on yourself, destroying the stone.

Annam's world-shaping adze; resizes to its wielder as a greataxe. Random properties: 2 minor beneficial, 1 major beneficial, 2 minor detrimental. +3 to attack and damage rolls, an extra 3d12 force on a hit, and double damage to objects and structures. Divine Mattock: once per dawn, as an action, cast move earth or fabricate.

Bears a citrine with the shield rune. While worn, your HP maximum increases by 10 + your level. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as an action, cast beacon of hope lasting 1 minute without concentration.

Bigby's jeweled bracelet. Random properties: 1 minor beneficial, 1 major beneficial, 1 minor detrimental. Dexterous Fingers: cast mage hand at will. Force Sculpture: three times per dawn, 1 minute of focus creates a translucent force copy of a Large or smaller nonmagical object within 10 feet, immune to damage and dispelling (disintegrate destroys it), lasting 8 hours or until dismissed as an action. Helpful Hand: once per dawn, as an action, cast Bigby's hand at 9th level (+13 spell attack) without concentration.

Add your Constitution modifier (minimum +1) to its damage rolls. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, when you attack a creature with it (even after rolling), spend and roll one Hit Die and add it to the attack roll; on a hit, you can spend and roll any number of Hit Dice and add them to the damage.

An iron circlet bearing enemy runes. When you hit a creature with an attack while wearing it, you can spend and roll one Hit Die to deal that much extra psychic damage. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as an action, cast fear (save DC 15) lasting 1 minute without concentration.

A clawed glove bearing the mountain rune; it is a simple melee weapon (finesse, light) dealing 1d4 slashing. While attuned you have a burrowing speed equal to your walking speed and blindsight 15 feet. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as an action, spend and roll Hit Dice up to your proficiency bonus and regain the total plus your Constitution modifier in HP.

1d4 + 2 pots of luminous paint, one rune each. Spend 10 minutes to paint one rune on a creature for 8 hours (or until wiped off as an action; one rune at a time). Journey: difficult terrain costs no extra movement. Life: 10 temporary HP and advantage on death saves. Light: darkvision 30 feet, or +30 feet to existing darkvision. Mountain: can't be knocked prone; advantage on Str and Con saves. Shield: advantage on Dex saves against damaging effects.

A sentient golden harp of Iallanis (chaotic good; Int 13, Wis 15, Cha 20; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; speaks Common and Giant and telepathy with its wielder; pompous). To attune you must pass a DC 15 Cha (Performance) or DC 20 Cha (Persuasion) check, retrying the next dawn on a failure. Stalwart Song: treat a 9 or lower on a Charisma check's d20 as a 10. Feast of Plenty: after 10 minutes of playing, cast heroes' feast; usable again after 1d10 + 10 days. Soothing Melody: five times per dawn, as an action, cast calm emotions (save DC 19) lasting up to 1 hour with concentration.

Annam's helm for Diancastra, holding a shard of the Elemental Chaos. Random properties: 2 minor beneficial, 1 major beneficial, 1 minor detrimental. Master of Guile: advantage on Cha (Deception) and Wis (Insight) checks. Arrow of Elemental Havoc: as a bonus action, a creature you can see within 90 feet makes a DC 20 Dex save, taking 4d6 acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder (your choice), half on success. Spellcasting: 6 charges (regains 1d6 at dawn), save DC 20: elemental weapon (1), call lightning (2), wall of fire (3), conjure elemental (4), tsunami (5).

+1 to attack and damage rolls and an extra 1d6 fire on a hit; on a critical hit the target is restrained until the start of your next turn. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, when you hit with it, use your reaction to make the extra fire damage 2d6.

+3 to attack and damage rolls; with no ammunition loaded it makes its own vanishing magic arrow. 8 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn. Curative Arrow: once per turn when you Attack, spend 1 charge to replace an attack with an arrow that automatically hits a creature within 150 feet, which can spend and roll one Hit Die to regain that much HP plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1). Spellcasting (save DC 18): create food and water (1), warding bond (2), guardian of faith (3).

A triple-barreled bronze musket: +1 to attack and damage rolls, needs no ammunition, deals radiant damage, and lacks the loading property. Cast dancing lights from it at will. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as an action, cast sunbeam (save DC 17).

A fur cloak stitched with the frost rune. While worn you resist cold, and when you move within 5 feet of a creature it makes a DC 14 Dex save or takes 1d6 cold and falls prone (once per turn per creature). Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as an action, cast sleet storm (save DC 14); its area isn't difficult terrain for you and you see through it normally.

A bronze circlet bearing the cloud rune. While worn you take no falling damage, and as a bonus action you can teleport with your gear up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as an action, take a cloud form for 1 minute (until incapacitated or dismissed): fly speed 60 feet and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing.

An 8-pound crystal-veined stone orb. While holding it, it is a spellcasting focus and: Abundant Components, 3 charges (regained at dawn), each spent ignores up to 300 gp of a spell's costed material components; Astute Mind, +2 to Con saves to maintain concentration; Divine Sight, see normally in magical and nonmagical darkness to 120 feet.

Rough dinosaur statuettes. As an action, throw one to a point within 60 feet and speak its command word to turn it into a friendly creature that understands your languages and obeys you (defending itself if uncommanded), if there is room. It reverts at the end of its duration, at 0 HP, or when you touch it and repeat the word as an action, then needs time to recharge. Carnelian Triceratops (very rare): triceratops mount up to 6 hours, every 10 days. Jasper Tyrannosaurus Rex (legendary): tyrannosaurus rex up to 1 hour, every 14 days; whenever you command it, roll a d20, and on a 1 it turns hostile until reduced to 0 HP. Kyanite Pteranodon (rare): pteranodon up to 8 hours, a mount for Medium or smaller riders, every 7 days. Pyrite Plesiosaurus (uncommon): plesiosaurus mount up to 12 hours, every 4 days; while riding it, cast water breathing at will.

+2 to attack and damage rolls, and it deals necrotic instead of piercing. When you roll a 20 to attack a creature with it, gain 10 temporary HP; while you have any of them, a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 10 necrotic. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as a bonus action, chosen creatures within 60 feet make a DC 15 Wis save or are stunned until the start of your next turn.

A hematite ring bearing the friend rune. On attuning, and after any long rest, bond with a willing creature you touch (one ring bond per creature): whenever magic restores your HP, it also heals them. The bond ends if either of you changes planes, you bond anew, or you sever it as a bonus action. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, when your bonded creature within 60 feet hits with an attack roll, use your reaction to make it a critical hit.

A black opal pendant bearing the sacred rune. While worn you resist necrotic damage and can cast spare the dying as an action or bonus action. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, when a creature you can see within 60 feet is reduced to 0 HP by damage, use your reaction to leave it at 1 HP instead.

Once per dawn, as a bonus action, activate it for 1 minute: you are immune to fire; as an action, end one disease or the blinded, charmed, deafened or poisoned condition on a creature you can see within 30 feet (yourself included); and once per turn when you Attack, replace one attack with a shield bash against a creature within 5 feet, which makes a Str save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Str modifier) or takes 3d6 bludgeoning plus 3d6 fire and falls prone (half damage only on a success).

Resizes to its wielder. A +1 quarterstaff; the first creature you hit with it each turn makes a DC 12 Str save or is restrained by spectral vines until the start of your next turn. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as an action, cast hold person (save DC 12) or speak with plants.

Granite armor no heavier than metal. While worn you resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage and can't be knocked prone. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as an action, cast wall of stone (save DC 14) with advantage on saves to maintain concentration on it.

+1 to attack and damage rolls, needs no ammunition, deals thunder damage, and lacks the loading property. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as a bonus action, a ball of energy bursts in a 10-foot-radius sphere on a point within 30 feet: DC 14 Con save, 3d6 thunder and no reactions until the end of your next turn, or half damage only on a success.

Blow it as a bonus action to end the frightened condition on yourself and gain advantage on saves against being frightened until the start of your next turn. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn when you blow it, you and chosen creatures within 30 feet gain +1 AC until the start of your next turn.
While worn, +10 feet walking speed and advantage on Wis (Survival) checks. Invoking the Runes: once per dawn, as a bonus action, cast expeditious retreat.

While worn, your unarmed strikes deal an extra 1d6 force, and after each long rest you choose resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison until the next. Invoking the Runes: once per dawn, as a bonus action, spectral fists envelop them for 1 minute (until incapacitated): your unarmed strikes on your turn have 30-foot reach, and a creature you hit with an unarmed opportunity attack makes a Str save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Str modifier) or falls prone.
While worn you have advantage on Dex (Acrobatics) checks and Dex saves. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as an action, cast wind wall (save DC 15).

While carrying it you have advantage on Strength saves. 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn, usable while holding it. Flight: as a bonus action, 1 charge gives a fly speed equal to your walking speed (hover) for 10 minutes. Gravitational Thrust: as an action, 1 charge forces a creature you can see within 60 feet to make a DC 18 Str save or be pushed up to 20 feet in a direction you choose. Reverse Gravity: as an action, 3 charges cast reverse gravity (save DC 18).

Hits deal an extra 1d8 radiant. 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn: when you hit a creature, spend 1 charge to regain HP equal to that extra radiant damage. As a bonus action while holding it, it sheds bright light 30 feet (and dim 30 more), dim light 10 feet, or none.
While worn, your ki feature save DCs gain the belt's bonus. Once per dawn, as an action, regain ki points equal to a roll of your Martial Arts die.

Infused with one dragon breath type (acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant or thunder); hits deal an extra 1d6 of that type. With no ammunition loaded, it creates a vanishing magic arrow when drawn.
Writes without ink. While holding it you can cast illusory script at will without material components.

+3 to attack and damage rolls, and hits deal an extra 5d4 acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison (your choice). Once per dawn, as an action, its five heads breathe a 90-foot cone: DC 18 Dex save, 14d6 acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison (your choice), half on success.

name: Gold Canary Figurine of Wondrous Power
spoken: gold canary figurine of wondrous power

display.description: As an action, speak its command word and throw it within 60 feet to become a friendly creature that obeys you. Giant Canary form: a rideable giant canary for up to 8 hours, once per dawn. Gold Dragon form (only while you are at half HP or less, with a second command word): an adult gold dragon without legendary or lair actions for up to 1 hour, once per year. It reverts at the end of its duration, at 0 HP, or when you touch it and repeat the word as an action.

As an action, pull a scale and speak a command word (three per dawn; an unused scale vanishes after 1 minute). Breath of Life: you or a creature you touch regains 10d4 HP. Platinum Shield: for 1 hour the scale is a +1 shield granting its wielder immunity to radiant damage. Radiant Hammer: for 1 hour the scale is a magic light hammer dealing 2d4 radiant, plus 2d4 radiant against chromatic dragons.

Liquid gold holding a dragon scale. Drinking it turns you into an adult dragon of that kind for 1 hour, using its statistics but keeping your languages, personality and memories; your gear melds in or drops (your choice). You can't use the dragon's Change Shape, legendary actions or lair actions.

While holding it, it is a spellcasting focus. 3 charges (regained at dawn): each spent when casting ignores up to 500 gp of costed material components. After each long rest, choose a spell of a level you can cast from any class list; you know it and can cast it with your slots until your next long rest.

While wielding it you resist psychic and thunder damage, and when a creature within 5 feet damages you, you can use your reaction to deal 2d6 thunder to it. Once per dawn, as an action, it hums if any Aberrations are within 1 mile, and you learn their directions.

A musket powered by a topaz dragon scale: range 100/300, two-handed, 2d6 necrotic, no ammunition. A creature or object reduced to 0 HP by it turns to dust (restored only by true resurrection or wish). Once per dawn, as an action, cast disintegrate (save DC 18).

A hoard item that takes the damage type of the dragon breath it steeped in. Slumbering (uncommon): on a 20 on the attack roll, chosen creatures within 5 feet of the target take 5 damage of that type. Stirring (rare): also +1 to attack and damage rolls and an extra 1d6 of that type on a hit. Wakened (very rare): +2 and 2d6, and once per dawn, as an action, a 30-foot cone, DC 16 Dex save, 8d6 of that type, half on success. Ascendant (legendary): +3 and 3d6, and the cone is 60 feet, DC 18, 12d6.

A hoard item. Slumbering (uncommon): advantage on initiative rolls, and it is a spellcasting focus for all your spells. Stirring (rare): by dragon family, Chromatic adds 1d6 to one damage roll of a slotted spell dealing acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison; Gem lets you teleport 15 feet when you cast a slotted spell; Metallic lets you use your reaction to give a creature within 30 feet advantage on a save. Wakened (very rare): cast each family spell once per dawn: Chromatic hold monster and Rime's binding ice, Gem Rary's telepathic bond and Raulothim's psychic lance, Metallic Fizban's platinum shield and legend lore. Ascendant (legendary): once per dawn, cast a 1st-level or higher spell as if with a 9th-level slot.

A hoard item. Once per dawn, as a bonus action, fill it while empty (potions lose magic after 24 hours). Slumbering (uncommon): ale, olive oil, potion of healing or potion of climbing. Stirring (rare): also mead, potion of fire breath or potion of greater healing. Wakened (very rare): also wine, potion of flying or potion of superior healing. Ascendant (legendary): also whiskey, potion of supreme healing or potion of dragon's majesty.

A hoard item. Slumbering (uncommon): advantage on saves to avoid or end charmed and frightened. Stirring (rare): +1 AC, immunity to charmed and frightened, and chosen creatures within 30 feet gain advantage on saves to avoid or end those conditions. Wakened (very rare): also, once per dawn, when you would take damage of its dragon's breath type, use your reaction to take none and regain that many HP. Ascendant (legendary): also a fly speed equal to your walking speed (hover) on spectral wings.

+1 to attack and damage rolls; while it is on your person you are immune to effects that turn undead. Dark Blessing: once per dusk, as an action while holding it, gain 1d4 + 4 temporary HP. Disheartening Strike: once per dusk, when you hit a creature with it, that creature has disadvantage on its next save before the end of your next turn (unless immune to frightened).
Once per dawn while wearing it, regain 4d4 + 4 HP when you drink a pint of beer, ale, mead or wine.

A Large cannon needing no ammunition or loading: one action to aim, one to fire, then 5 minutes to recharge. The firer picks: Acid Jet, 300-foot line, DC 15 Dex save, 4d10 acid, half on success, plus 2d10 acid each turn on a failure until washed off as an action; Fire Jet, 300-foot line, DC 15 Dex save, 6d10 fire, half on success, igniting unattended flammables; Frost Shot, 30-foot-radius sphere within 1,200 feet, DC 15 Con save, 4d10 cold and -10 feet speed for 1 minute (repeat save each turn end), half and no slow on a success; Lightning Shot, 20-foot-radius sphere within 1,200 feet, DC 15 Dex save (disadvantage in metal armor), 6d10 lightning, half on success; Poison Spray, 60-foot cone, DC 15 Con save, 4d10 poison and poisoned for 1 minute (repeat save each turn end), half and not poisoned on a success.

An iron tower shield granting +1 AC beyond its normal bonus. 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn: when you push a creature within reach at least 5 feet, spend 1 to push it 10 more feet, knock it prone, or both.
+2 to attack and damage rolls and an extra 1d6 necrotic against creatures that aren't Constructs or Undead; reducing such a creature to 0 HP with it grants you 10 temporary HP.
Worn over the head like a helmet, it holds 1 hour of breathable air, refilling at dawn.
While worn, magic that detects your creature type reads you as Humanoid, and magic that reveals alignment reads you as neutral.
A perpetually bloody apron. While worn, once per turn you can reroll a melee weapon attack's damage dice (using the new total), and your slashing weapon attacks score critical hits on 19 or 20.
A copper coin shedding dim light 5 feet. Dropped more than 5 feet, it chimes on landing, and anyone who hears it can tell how far it fell.
+1 to attack and damage rolls. Hits against Undead deal an extra 1d8 of the weapon's type, and the target has disadvantage on saves against turn undead effects until the start of your next turn.
Thrown up to 30 feet, it shatters in a 10-foot-radius burst that ends every spell of 5th level or lower in the area.

A leather-wrapped rod; as a bonus action a radiant warhammer head appears (an action dismisses it), shedding sunlight 15 feet bright and 15 dim. While active: +2 to attack and damage rolls, radiant damage instead of bludgeoning, an extra 1d8 radiant against Undead, and once per dawn, as an action, cast sunbeam (save DC 15).
Six servings of seasoning that make food delicious, but anyone who eats it has disadvantage on Wisdom checks and saves for 1 hour.
While worn, advantage on Int (Arcana) checks to learn about a creature or object you can see, and once per dawn you can cast identify with them.
+1 AC. 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn: when you hit a creature that is missing any HP, spend 1 to deal an extra 1d10 necrotic.
+1 AC. If you die while wearing it, it is destroyed, and each Celestial, Fey and Fiend within 30 feet makes a DC 15 Cha save or is banished to its home plane.

A glowing crystal dodecahedron. Once per dawn, a creature that touches it and concentrates for 1 minute gains a Fragment of Possibility for 8 hours (one at a time from any source): spend it to roll an extra d20 on an attack roll, check or save, or when attacked, and choose which die to use (rolled after advantage or disadvantage). Soul Snare: a consecrated follower of the Luxon who dies within 100 miles has their soul drawn in and reincarnated in a developing humanoid baby within 100 miles.
A sewing needle that becomes a +1 dagger (or back) when you speak its command word as a bonus action. While holding it, you can cast mending as an action.
A cold black orb. After 10 minutes of activation, everything within 10 miles becomes night for 24 hours, until you end it as an action or lose attunement; usable again after 24 hours.

While on your person: +2 Wisdom (and maximum), darkvision 60 feet (or +60 feet), and advantage on Wisdom checks to find hidden doors and paths. Curse: you won't part with it, nonmagical flames within 30 feet go out, and your fire damage is halved.
The first damaging spell of 4th level or lower you cast within 1 minute of drinking it deals maximum damage on every die instead of rolling.

Grants two Fragments of Possibility lasting 8 hours each (no others while you have them): spend one to roll an extra d20 on an attack roll, check or save, or when attacked, and choose which die to use (rolled after advantage or disadvantage).
Sprinkled on a dead Humanoid's remains, it returns a willing soul to life in a new body as if by reincarnate.
3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn: as an action, spend 1 to cast fog cloud centered on yourself, lasting 1 minute without concentration.
If you die while wearing it, you reappear within 5 feet with 3d6 + your Constitution modifier HP (raising your HP maximum if needed) and one less level of exhaustion; the ring then turns to dust.
3 charges, regained at dawn: when a creature you can see within 60 feet damages you while you hold it, use your reaction and 1 charge to force a DC 13 Dex save, 2d10 lightning, half on success.

Stores one spell of 1st to 5th level (found with a d6 - 1 level spell of the DM's choice, 0 meaning empty). Anyone can cast a spell into it while touching it; while holding it you can cast the stored spell using the original caster's slot level, DC, attack bonus and ability, emptying it. While empty, as a reaction when a creature within 60 feet casts a spell, you can trap a spell of 3rd level or lower, or one of higher level with a successful Int check (DC 10 + spell level).

10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn (spending the last: on a d20 roll of 1 it crumbles). As an action, cast with your DC and attack bonus: fortune's favor (2), pulse wave (3), gravity sinkhole (4). New Possibility: once per dawn while holding it, turn a failed save against a spell that targets only you into a success.
While holding it, +1 to spell attack rolls, and critical hits with spell attacks deal an extra 3d6 radiant.
A plate-sized clockwork crab. Each action spent winding it runs it for 1 minute (up to 10); while running it is a DM-controlled vox seeker that hunts the nearest voice, and it is destroyed at 0 HP.
A creature damaged by an attack with it can't regain HP until the start of your next turn.

A Vestige of Divergence (dormant, awakened around level 9, exalted around level 16; benefits stack). Dormant: see normally in magical and nonmagical darkness to 60 feet, and advantage on sight-based Int (Investigation) and Wis (Perception) checks. Awakened: see invisible things and into the Ethereal Plane within 60 feet; once per dawn, as a bonus action, see through up to 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal or 3 feet of wood or dirt within 60 feet for 1 minute (lead blocks it); as a bonus action, toggle 2x magnification. Exalted: automatically detect and succeed on saves against illusions you can see, and see an aura around shapechanged creatures; once per dawn, as an action, cast antimagic field.

A Vestige of Divergence: an endless, 3-pound spellbook. Dormant: it holds alarm, antimagic field, Bigby's hand, blight, charm person, confusion, control weather, create undead, detect thoughts, enlarge/reduce, fear, foresight, gaseous form, glyph of warding, legend lore, Leomund's tiny hut, mass suggestion, mislead, misty step, Mordenkainen's faithful hound, prismatic spray, ray of enfeeblement, silent image, teleport and thunderwave; used as your spellbook, you prepare one extra wizard spell. Awakened: advantage on saves against spells and magical effects while carrying it, and one more prepared spell. Exalted: Arcane Recovery twice between long rests, and one more prepared spell.

A Vestige of Divergence. Dormant: +1 AC; while transformed by an effect that replaces your statistics you keep the armor's benefits and gain +1 to melee attack and damage rolls; once per dawn, as an action, polymorph yourself into a giant owl, keeping your Int, Wis and Cha. Awakened: +2 AC and +2 to those rolls, and the polymorph can make you a cave bear (polar bear statistics). Exalted: +3 AC and +3 to those rolls, and the polymorph can make you a guardian wolf.

A Vestige of Divergence. Dormant: works as thieves' tools for locks with proficiency and advantage, and advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks to move silently while holding it. Awakened: as a bonus action it becomes a +1 dagger that returns after ranged attacks (or a key again); once per dawn each, as an action, cast alter self, invisibility, knock or pass without trace. Exalted: once per dawn, as a bonus action, open a passage up to 10 by 10 feet through a surface up to 5 feet thick, closing once the key passes through (shunting anyone inside safely); once per dawn each, cast dimension door, gaseous form or mislead.

A Vestige of Divergence of Kord. Dormant: resistance to lightning and thunder and Strength 21; once per dawn, as an action, become a Storm Avatar for 1 minute: immune to lightning and thunder, bludgeoning weapon hits deal thunder and piercing or slashing hits deal lightning, and as a bonus action a creature within 30 feet makes a DC 15 Dex save, 3d6 lightning, half on success. Awakened: Strength 23, the strike deals 4d6, and the avatar flies 30 feet (hover). Exalted: Strength 25, the strike deals 5d6, and once per dawn you can cast control weather.

A Vestige of Divergence. Dormant: advantage on smell-based Wis (Perception) checks, immunity to disease, darkvision 60 feet (or +60); once per dawn, as an action, polymorph into a rat or giant rat keeping your Int, Wis, Cha and the cloak's benefits. Awakened: resistance to poison; once per dawn cast insect plague (save DC 15, no material components); the polymorph can make you a giant wasp. Exalted: climb speed equal to walking speed; a bite natural weapon (1d6 + Str piercing, usable as a bonus action) whose damage forces a DC 17 Con save or poisoned for 1 minute (repeat save each turn end); the polymorph can make you a giant scorpion.

A Vestige of Divergence: a crown of golden thorns set with Tiamat's five colors. Dormant: darkvision 60 feet (or +60); when you hit or grapple a Beast, Dragon or Monstrosity of CR 5 or lower, you can cast dominate monster on it (save DC 13); a success grants it 24-hour immunity, a failure marks it with a golden collar or crown while charmed, charming a second creature ends the first, and it knows you charmed it. Awakened: CR 10 or lower, DC 15. Exalted: CR 15 or lower, DC 17.

An Arm of the Betrayers holding the glabrezu Ragazuu (sentient chaotic evil; Int 21, Wis 24, Cha 24; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Abyssal and Common), who urges reckless revolution. Artifact properties: 1 minor beneficial and 1 minor detrimental when dormant, plus one of each when awakened and 1 major beneficial when exalted. Dormant: you know Abyssal; +1 dagger that returns after ranged attacks; it remembers Humanoids it kills (forgotten on a new attunement), and as an action you can take any remembered form (statistics unchanged except size), reverting as an action or on death. Awakened: +2, and once per dawn each, as an action, cast fabricate, hallucinatory terrain, major image or phantasmal killer (save DC 15). Exalted: +3, spell DC 17, and as an action turn invisible with your gear until you let go of it, attack, force a save, or end it as a bonus action.

An Arm of the Betrayers holding the ultroloth Ciria (sentient neutral evil; Int 18, Wis 15, Cha 19; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Abyssal, Common and Infernal), who loves treasure and pain. Artifact properties as the Arms of the Betrayers. Dormant: you know Abyssal and Infernal; +1; on a hit you can deal an extra 2d6 bludgeoning and take 1d6 psychic; double damage to objects; advantage on Wis (Insight) checks to spot lies in languages you know. Awakened: +2; burrow speed equal to walking speed through sand, earth, mud or ice; once per dawn, when a creature within 30 feet hits you, use your reaction to deal it psychic damage equal to the damage you took. Exalted: +3; an extra 2d6 bludgeoning on hits while below half HP; burrow through rock at half speed leaving a 5-foot tunnel; once per dawn each, cast earthquake, meld into stone or stone shape (save DC 17).

An Arm of the Betrayers holding the marilith Sizlifeth (sentient chaotic evil; Int 18, Wis 16, Cha 20; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Abyssal, Common and Draconic), short-tempered and fond of harm. Artifact properties as the Arms of the Betrayers. Dormant: you know Abyssal and Draconic; +1; a creature it hits makes a DC 13 Con save against a poison of your choice (each other than Serpent Venom once per dawn): Dead Eyes, poisoned and blinded for 1 hour; Serpent Venom, 3d6 poison, half on success. Awakened: +2, DC 15, and Ghoul's Blood: poisoned and paralyzed for 1 minute (repeat save each turn end). Exalted: +3, DC 17, and Cockatrice Tears: restrained as it turns to stone, repeating the save at the end of its next turn: success ends it, failure petrifies it for 24 hours.

An Arm of the Betrayers holding the erinyes Xartaza (sentient lawful evil; Int 20, Wis 12, Cha 18; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Common and Infernal), who pushes its wielder toward Asmodeus. Artifact properties as the Arms of the Betrayers. Dormant: you know Infernal; +1; as a bonus action, ignite or douse its head (bright light 40 feet, dim 40 more), dealing an extra 1d6 fire while lit; once per dawn, as an action, summon a friendly imp that obeys you for 10 minutes. Awakened: +2, 2d6 fire, the summon can be a bearded devil, and resistance to poison while holding it. Exalted: +3, 3d6 fire that ignores fire resistance, the summon can be a barbed devil, and resistance to fire while holding it.

An Arm of the Betrayers holding the balor Yarrowish (sentient chaotic evil; Int 20, Wis 16, Cha 22; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Abyssal, Common and Orc), hungry for violence. Artifact properties as the Arms of the Betrayers. Dormant: you know Abyssal and Orc; +1 and an extra 1d8 piercing on hits; it returns after ranged attacks; once per short or long rest, when hit by a melee attack, use your reaction to attack the attacker with advantage. Awakened: +2 and 2d8; once per dawn, hurl it as a lightning bolt in a 5-foot line to a creature within 120 feet: DC 15 Dex save, 8d6 lightning, half on success, then it returns. Exalted: +3; once per dawn, as a bonus action, chosen creatures within 30 feet gain advantage on attacks until your next turn; once per dawn, when it drops a creature to 0 HP, regain HP equal to that attack's damage.

An Arm of the Betrayers holding the yochlol Sinnafex (sentient chaotic evil; Int 13, Wis 15, Cha 15; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Abyssal, Common, Elvish and Undercommon), who whispers distrust. Artifact properties as the Arms of the Betrayers. Dormant: you know Abyssal, Elvish and Undercommon; darkvision 60 feet (or +60); +1; as an action, coat it in poison for 1 minute or one hit: DC 13 Con save or poisoned for 1 hour, and unconscious meanwhile if it fails by 5 or more (woken by damage or a shake); spider climb with a climb speed equal to your walking speed, and webs can't hold you. Awakened: +2, DC 15, and once per dawn each, cast cloudkill, darkness, levitate or web (save DC 15). Exalted: +3, DC 17, magical darkness doesn't hinder your darkvision, and once per dawn, as a bonus action in dim light or darkness, teleport up to 60 feet to another such space you can see.

An Arm of the Betrayers holding the pit fiend Izeelzee (sentient lawful evil; Int 22, Wis 18, Cha 24; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Common and Infernal), who demands fealty. Artifact properties as the Arms of the Betrayers. Dormant: you know Infernal; +1; once per dawn each, cast charm person, dominate person or fear (save DC 13); advantage on Cha (Intimidation) checks. Awakened: +2, DC 15; once per dawn, when it drops a creature to 0 HP, chosen creatures within 15 feet make a DC 15 Wis save or are frightened until the end of your next turn; when a creature hits you in melee, use your reaction to deal it 1d6 psychic. Exalted: +3, dominate monster added, DCs 17, and the reaction deals 2d6.

An Arm of the Betrayers holding the bone devil Ashtyrlon (sentient lawful evil; Int 14, Wis 15, Cha 19; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Common, Draconic and Infernal), greedy and demanding. Artifact properties as the Arms of the Betrayers. Dormant: you know Draconic and Infernal; +1; once per dawn, as a bonus action, Frightful Presence: chosen aware creatures within 30 feet make a DC 13 Wis save or are frightened for 1 minute (repeat save each turn end; 24-hour immunity after); as an action, breathe 3d6 damage (half on a save), each type once per dawn: acid (30-foot line, Dex), cold (15-foot cone, Con), fire (15-foot cone, Dex), lightning (30-foot line, Dex), poison (15-foot cone, Con), DC 13. Awakened: +2, breath DC 15 and 4d6, Frightful Presence DC 15, and resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning and poison while carrying it. Exalted: +3, breath DC 17 and 5d6, Frightful Presence DC 17.

A 2-foot clockwork orrery powered by six component relics. Random properties: 2 minor beneficial, 1 major beneficial, 1 major detrimental (perhaps only with all components installed). Components can be attuned separately (held to use) or together through the orrery, where installed components don't count against your attunement limit. Future Echoes: +1 AC while it is within 30 feet. Into the Void: your alignment drifts to chaotic neutral and you feel driven toward dangerous planes. Master of Travel (all six installed): 7 charges, regaining 1d4 + 4 at dawn; while touching it, as an action, cast (save DC 17) contact other plane (3), demiplane (6), gate (7), plane shift (5) or teleportation circle (3).

An Orrery of the Wanderer component (may misbehave when not installed). +1 to Int saves, and you learn one new language on first attuning. Time Bandit (once per dawn): at the start of your turn roll a d6: on 1-3 gain an extra action and double speed this turn; on 4-6 you can reroll your next failed save, attack roll or check and take either result. Fate Swap (once per dawn): as a reaction when a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, it gains an extra action on its turn or acts immediately.

An Orrery of the Wanderer component (may misbehave when not installed). +1 to Str saves and darkvision 60 feet (or +30 feet). Dimensional Cloak (once per dawn): as a bonus action, for 1 minute gain advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks to hide, and attacks against you have disadvantage. Fold Space (once per dawn): a space you can see within 60 feet counts as within 5 feet of you until the end of your turn, letting you move there without provoking or reach into it.

An Orrery of the Wanderer component (may misbehave when not installed). +1 to Cha saves and advantage on Cha (Intimidation) checks. Aberrant Ally (once per dawn): as conjure celestial without concentration, summoning an Aberration of CR 4 or lower. Unnatural Bane (once per dawn): cast bane (save DC 15) on any number of creatures in range for 1 minute.

An Orrery of the Wanderer component (may misbehave when not installed). +1 to Con saves, and you perfectly recall events from the last 30 days. Borrow Object (once per dawn): a generic mundane item worth 50 gp or less appears with you for 10 minutes. Recall Code: as an action, set a return point; once per dawn, as a bonus action within 500 feet of it, teleport there.

An Orrery of the Wanderer component (may misbehave when not installed). +1 to Dex saves, you always know north, and you can cast longstrider on yourself at will. Turn-by-Turn Directions (once per dawn): a voice only you hear guides you by the safest direct route to a place within 10 miles known to some creature within 10 miles of it (it knows terrain, not monsters, traps or locks). Get Away From It All (once per dawn): as an action, cast teleport.

An Orrery of the Wanderer component (may misbehave when not installed). +1 to Wis saves, and as an action cast dancing lights, guidance or message. Portent of the Stars (once per dawn): as a reaction when a creature you can see within 60 feet makes an attack roll, save or check, it adds or subtracts (your choice) 1d10. Alter Gravity (once per dawn): as an action, cast fly on yourself or levitate (save DC 15).

4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn. As an action spend 1 to fire a 60-foot by 5-foot line of lightning: Dex save (DC PB + Dex mod) for 6d6 lightning, half on success. When the last charge is spent, roll a d20; on a 1 it burns out for good.

+3 battleaxe dealing +3d10 necrotic on a hit. While held you are immune to charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, and stunned. Bonus action: let it hover nearby, and command it (bonus action) to fly 50 feet and attack or return. Once each per dawn cast bane, banishment, bestow curse, branding smite, or incendiary cloud (DC 18). Only its twin Zeal can harm it (AC 21, 300 HP).
Summon an elemental arrow when you shoot (no action), dissolving after 1 minute: air 2d8 lightning, earth 2d8 magical bludgeoning, fire 2d8 fire, or water 2d8 cold.
Its color shifts to hide you: Perception checks to see you have disadvantage and you have advantage on Stealth checks to hide from sight.
+1 AC. 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn: when you hit a creature that isn't at full HP, spend 1 for +1d10 fire.
Advantage on hearing-based Perception. Once per long rest, activate it for 1 minute: fly 30 feet, blindsight 120 feet, and advantage on Dex saves while airborne.
As an action throw it up to 30 feet: the target makes a DC 10 Dex save or is vulnerable to fire for 1 minute, overriding any resistance or immunity.

+2 longsword dealing cold instead of slashing. Darkvision 60 feet that sees through magical darkness. Bonus action: emit magical darkness 15 feet (dim 15 more), resizable as an action between 10 and 30 feet; only antimagic field suppresses it.

Three times per day (recharging at midnight), as an action learn a creature's darkest desire unless it passes a DC 13 Wis save, which makes it immune for 24 hours. No effect on Intelligence 3 or lower.
Its reflection shows every creature's true form as with true seeing. It shatters if turned on a vampire.
Advantage on saves against being frightened, and a DC 15 Wis save against frighten effects that allow none. Once per long rest, listen to it for advantage on an Intelligence check.

+3 warhammer dealing +3d10 radiant on a hit. While held you are immune to charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, and stunned. Bonus action: let it hover nearby, and command it (bonus action) to fly 50 feet and attack or return. Once each per dawn cast banishment, branding smite, beacon of hope, earthquake, or heroism (DC 18). Only its twin Ardor can harm it (AC 21, 300 HP).
Water Breathing cast on you lasts twice as long, the antenna can shed bright light 20 feet and dim light 20 more, and once per dawn you can cast Charm Person (3rd level) from it.
While lit, the creature holding it is invisible. It burns for 1d4 + 3 minutes, then is destroyed.
Once per dawn, ring it as an action: creatures wielding metal weapons within 30 feet make a DC 14 Strength save or drop them.
When you Dash, you move an additional 15 feet.
7 charges, regaining 1d6 + 1 at dawn. As an action cast Burning Hands (1), Gust of Wind (2), or Cone of Cold (5).
Lifting the lid of this battered teapot raises three bickering elderly spirit faces; each answers one question, then can't be asked again for 7 days.
A +1 warhammer. Once per dawn, when a hostile creature misses you with a ranged spell attack, use your reaction to redirect it at another creature within 30 feet using the bat's attack bonus.
On a hit you can make the target succeed on a DC 12 Strength save or fall prone.
Flipped into the air, it permanently becomes a mundane dagger.

Once per dawn as an action, regain a third of your hit point maximum, but you can't benefit from a short rest until the next dawn. Recharging it afterward takes a 1-hour ritual consuming three common ingredients.
Once per dawn, set it as an action for 11 minutes 14 seconds; meanwhile its screen shows a fuzzy view of the 10-foot sphere around it.
Once per dawn, solve a side as an action to cast a random spell (d6): Water Bullet, Forest Guard, Cure Wounds, Enlarge/Reduce, Flaming Sphere, or Pacify Person (spellcasting +4, attack +7, DC 15).
While flying it, as an action see downward through it with your own visual senses.
Cast Control Animal at will on a friendly beast wearing the collar.
When used with alchemist's supplies to brew an uncommon or rarer potion, you also brew a random common potion.
Melee attacks can extend to reach targets up to 15 feet away, at -1 to hit per 5 feet beyond normal reach.
Thought-controlled broom with a 60-foot flying speed carrying up to 1,000 pounds; it returns to you from within 100 feet on command and can leave a cosmetic trail.
While attuned with a cartridge inserted, you are proficient in the cartridge's skill; swap cartridges as an action. Comes with one random-skill cartridge.
A set of 1d4 + 1 floating spheres, each with 5 hit points that it automatically spends to reduce damage from attacks on you; spent spheres go inert and recover at dawn.
+3 to Wisdom (Insight and Perception). 6 charges (1d4 + 2 at dawn): Dispel Magic (3), Find Traps (2), See Invisibility (2), Shared Vision (2), Spell Signature (2).
Inflated on command, these balloons halve your falling damage and let your standing long and high jumps reach your Strength or Dexterity score in feet.
+2 damage with thrown weapons and +15 feet to their ranges.
Photos show magical creatures and objects with a school-of-magic aura. Comes with 1d12 + 4 film cards.
A creature holding it becomes as light as a feather.
50 charges; spend 1 as an action to cast Sand Structure. Becomes a knickknack when empty.
During a minute-long performance, pick a lock within 15 feet with a Charisma (Performance) check against its DC; after a failure you can't retry that lock for 24 hours.
Once a month, brew six cursed portions; drinkers suffer a Bestow Curse effect the brewer chooses for 1 year or until removed.
At night, hits deal an extra 1d8 radiant.

Spin it and set it down as an action: hostile creatures within 120 feet that see it make a DC 15 Wisdom save or are stunned while it spins (1 minute, or indefinitely in strong wind; save each turn). Afterward its magic jumps to another pinwheel.
As an action, take on an illusory disguise of a humanoid set by the enchanter until you remove it (DC 14 Investigation to see through).
Placed down as an action with its command word, it hovers and projects an immobile illusion of a humanoid you know wearing it (DC 10 Investigation).
A set of four, six, or eight; each wearer always knows the direction of the others.
A hole is punched each time its carrier is hit by an attack (starts with 1d6). The tenth hole reduces that attack's damage to 0, and the magic fades.
Once, as an action, a spirit within 30 feet that sees or hears you makes a DC 13 Wisdom save (CR 3+ succeed) or is sealed in timeless slumber until the urn is broken.
A bicycle with a 70-foot speed. Once per dawn, after riding 60 feet in a turn, use an action to raise a Wall of Fire along your path.
Three times per dawn, throw it as an action at a creature within 60 feet: DC 14 Dexterity save or it can't speak until it or another creature pulls it off (DC 14 Strength check as an action).
Touch to light or snuff (bright 30 feet, dim 30 more). While lit, command it to scuttle 20 feet each turn along any surface or have it follow you; it goes out beyond 500 feet.
Two pouches holding 5 pounds each; an object placed in one can teleport into the other if it is within 20 feet and has room.
Melon Soda grants a random common combat potion, Cola Soda a random common utility potion, and Fish Sauce Soda a random common whimsical potion.
Regain 3 extra hit points whenever a spell or magical effect heals you.
Split a shot between two creatures within 10 feet of each other with one attack roll; each target hit takes half the rolled damage.
While holding it you can cast Retrieve.
As a bonus action roll a d4: on 1 to 3 regain an expended slot of that level (or the next higher expended), once per dawn; on a 4 you teleport 30 feet in a random direction.
1d4 charges: spend one to turn a failed death save into a success. When empty it burns up and reforms elsewhere.
A +1 frying pan dealing an extra 1d4 fire. Once per dawn, food cooked in it gives eaters 1d6 temporary hit points for 1 hour.
A +1 umbrella; when targeted by a ranged weapon attack, use your reaction for +5 AC against it.

name: Weapon of the Sun and Moon
spoken: weapon of the sun and moon

display.description: Formed by a ritual combining a Lunar Weapon and Solar Amulet: a +1 weapon with both items' properties that can cast a 60-foot Darkness once per day and Daylight once per night.
While worn, your creature type is Spirit and you speak and understand Torum.

A 5-by-3-foot war banner (an action to furl or unfurl). Mark of Courage: once per short or long rest as a bonus action, you and allies within 20 ft. of the unfurled banner are immune to frightened for 10 minutes. Sentinel Standard: you see invisible creatures within 20 ft. of it. Standard's Shield: once per short or long rest as a bonus action, ranged attacks against you and allies within 20 ft. of it have disadvantage for 1 minute. Gift of Battle: 8 hours of work destroys the banner to fix a 500-ft.-radius sphere where creatures you chose are immune to frightened and gain +1 to attack rolls and AC.
A diamond holding a creature's blood. As an action, sense the distance and direction to the nearest non-Undead creature related to that blood (the creature itself or a blood relative).

Wyrmslayer: three times per dawn as an action, a Dragon within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Con save or is vulnerable to all damage until the end of your next turn. Wyrm Shield: resistance to Dragon breath weapons while displayed. Wyrm Ward: 8 hours of work destroys it to fix a 100-ft.-radius sphere where Dragons have disadvantage on saves and fly no faster than 10 ft.
Once per dawn as an action, blow it to cast teleport to the single destination set by its maker, with no chance of mishap or being off target.

Arbiter's Shield: attacks against you have disadvantage before your first turn in each combat. Bond of Amity: once per long rest as an action, strike a surface; the first creature within 60 ft. to deal damage with a hit in the next minute takes psychic damage equal to half of it. Gift of Truth: 8 hours of work destroys it to fix a 30-ft.-radius sphere where anyone who lies takes 5 psychic and flinches.

A +1 frost-giant-sized greataxe (325 lb.) dealing 3d12 slashing, plus 2d12 slashing against humans. Sheds torchlight below 0 degrees Fahrenheit. Once per dawn as an action, cast heat metal (DC 13) dealing cold instead of fire. Uthgardt attack any giant wielding it.

Runic Shield: +1 AC while carried. Shield Bond: once per short or long rest as a bonus action, a creature within 30 ft. takes only 1 from each damage until the end of your next turn, and you take half the prevented damage (unreducible). Shield Ward: 8 hours of work destroys it to enchant a nonmagical shield (rare, attunement: +1 AC and once per long rest drop to 1 HP instead of 0) or two-handed melee weapon (uncommon: +1 AC while held).

One of the Ruling Scepters of Shanatar: a +3 magic club that lets you use the Wyrmskull Throne. 10 charges (regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn): 1 to learn the distance to the surface when underground or underwater, 2 to cast sending, 3 to cast teleport (no mishap within 60 ft. of the throne).

A 7-ft. mithral sphere keyed to one cloud castle. Touching it, use an action to move the castle 1 mph in a chosen direction, stop it, or turn it 90 degrees; you always know the castle's altitude. Removing or destroying it fixes the castle in place.

Ignite: as an action, set a flammable object within 10 ft. alight. Fire's Friend: resistance to cold. Fire Tamer: as an action, put out any amount of open flame within 10 ft. Gift of Flame: 8 hours of work destroys it to enchant a nonmagical weapon (uncommon: +1d6 fire on hits) or armor (rare, attunement: resistance to cold).

Indomitable Stand: as an action, for 1 minute or until you move, advantage on checks and saves against forced movement, and enemies moving within 10 ft. make a DC 12 Str save or stop. Stone Soul: you can't be petrified. Earthen Step: once per short or long rest, cast meld into stone as a bonus action. Gift of Stone: 8 hours of work destroys it to enchant a shield (rare, attunement: resistance to ranged weapon damage) or boots (uncommon, attunement: advantage on Str saves and a reaction to avoid being knocked prone).

Wind Step: as an action, fly up to 20 ft. Comforting Wind: you can't suffocate. Wind's Grasp: once per short or long rest, as a reaction take no falling damage. Wind Walker: once per short or long rest, cast levitate as a bonus action. Gift of Wind: 8 hours of work destroys it to enchant armor (uncommon, attunement: +5 ft. speed and no Stealth disadvantage) or boots or a cloak (rare, attunement: turn up to 20 ft. of movement each turn into flight and cast feather fall once per short or long rest).

For 24 hours, a Medium or smaller drinker becomes Huge, Strength 25 (if lower), double HP maximum and current HP, +5 ft. melee reach; enlarged weapons roll triple damage dice. Excess HP at the end become temporary HP.

Bears 1d4 + 3 serpents. As a bonus action, detach one as a giant poisonous snake that acts on your initiative, attacks your foes, and vanishes after 1 hour, at 0 HP, or when dismissed. With no serpents left, the robe is mundane.
A 100-pound adamantine rod with 10 charges (regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn). As an action, spend 1 to cast locate object; against adamantine objects the range is 10 miles.

Frigid Touch: once per short or long rest as an action, freeze water in a 10-ft.-radius sphere. Frost Friend: resistance to fire. Icy Mantle: once per short or long rest as an action, a touched creature's next bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage within 1 minute is reduced to 0. Winter's Howl: once per short or long rest, cast sleet storm (DC 17). Gift of Frost: 8 hours of work destroys it to enchant a cloak (rare, attunement: resistance to fire and advantage on Stealth in snow) or boots (rare, attunement: ignore difficult terrain and walk on water).

A hovering obsidian throne on four blue dragon skulls; only a creature attuned to and holding a Ruling Scepter can use it, and anyone else who sits is paralyzed in a force field. 9 charges (all regained at dawn): fly 30 ft. and pass through earth and stone (free), lightning bolt as a 9th-level spell (DC 19, 49 (14d6)) for 1, globe of invulnerability around throne and rider for 2, or a spectral ancient blue dragon for 1 minute that makes a bite and two claw attacks each turn for 3. Destroyed only by breaking five Ruling Scepters on it at once (30-ft. burst, DC 21 Dex, 70 (20d6) slashing, half on success).
Advantage on saves against turn undead effects, and three times per dawn you can turn a failed one into a success. It glows silvery blue when such an effect targets you.

Cast detect evil and good as a ritual by setting it on a solid surface and sprinkling the pans with holy water (or placing a 100 gp transparent gem in each). It tips toward good or evil or wavers for neither; touching it then reveals what the spell would.

Immunity to being petrified. As an action, cast flesh to stone (DC 15) three times total, then stone shape thirteen times, after which it turns to lead. Curse: earth-linked creatures (stone giants, dwarves) have advantage on the save, and if one succeeds the spell rebounds on you (you save with disadvantage; failure petrifies instantly) and your attunement ends.

While you blow it continuously you fly at twice your walking speed, for up to 5 + five times your Con modifier rounds (minimum 1) or until you speak, hold your breath, suffocate, or land; stop while aloft and you fall. Three uses per dawn.

As an action, become a hell hound for up to 1 hour (as polymorph; revert as a bonus action). Curse: you won't part with it, and from the sixth use on a failed DC 15 Cha save locks you in form until dispelled or 0 HP; 6 hours in form makes it permanent (remove curse to reverse, wish after 6 days).

+2 to attack and damage; thrown ranges +30 ft., one extra damage die, and it returns to your hand. Curse: you won't part with it and have disadvantage with other weapons; on a natural 1 it strikes you (new attack with advantage against your own AC).

Looks like a 150 gp gem and hides from detect magic (identify reveals it). Curse: using Dash or Disengage while carrying it reduces your speed by 5 ft. and halves your carrying and lifting capacity, and you won't part with it, until remove curse.
Once per dawn as an action, think of a creature or object while gazing in to see up to 1 minute of accurate but random, cryptic scenes from its past.

A duergar crystal whistle. Blown in darkness or under the night sky, it casts animate dead, reaching through up to 10 ft. of soft earth (the undead digs out in 1 minute); once per 7 days. Once per 24 hours it can reassert control over one or two undead it animated.

1d4 pots with a brush. Paint inanimate objects or terrain (doors, pits, trees, weapons) up to 10,000 cubic feet per pot (1,000 sq. ft. of surface, 10 minutes per 100 sq. ft.) and they become real and nonmagical. Nothing created is worth more than 25 gp; painted energy dissipates harmlessly.

Before the end of your next turn, cast dominate beast or dominate person (rare) or dominate monster (very rare) at DC 15; on a failed save it lasts 1 hour without concentration and the target saves against it with disadvantage.
Resistance to cold, and you're comfortable and unaffected by extreme temperatures.
+1 to attack and damage. Hits against objects are automatically critical and can deal bludgeoning or slashing; nonmagical damage can't harm it.

+2 to attack and damage; thrown ranges +30 ft., one extra damage die, and it returns to your hand. Curse: you won't part with it and have disadvantage with other weapons; on a natural 1 it strikes you (new attack with advantage against your own AC).
Identifies as a stone of good luck. Curse: -2 to ability checks and saves while carried (applied secretly), and you won't part with it until remove curse.
7 charges (regains 1d6 + 1 at dawn; 1 in 20 to crumble when emptied). As an action, spend 1 to cast entangle (DC 13).
Adds its bonus to your spell attack rolls, and your spell attacks ignore half cover.

Sentient +1 greatsword (NG; Int 12, Wis 2, Cha 14; hearing and darkvision 120 ft.; speaks Giant and Common, telepathic). Giants it hits take +2d6 slashing and make a DC 15 Str save or fall prone. It also works as a wand of enemy detection that recharges fully at dawn and never crumbles. Good characters attune in 1 minute; it urges bold action.

A gem-studded chest with a 1.5-ft. cubic compartment and 20 charges (regains 1d20 at dawn; 1 in 20 to lose its magic when emptied). As an action, touch the closed lid and spend 1 to conjure named nonmagical objects worth up to 1 gp total that fit inside an empty chest. Food spoils after 24 hours; gems and precious metals vanish after 1 minute.
A 30-gallon copper cauldron. Stirring water in it for 1 minute turns it into hot stew, one meal for up to four people per gallon; three uses per dawn.
Tied to a line in at least a 10-ft. cube of water, each uninterrupted hour roll a d6; on a 6 a random magical fish appears on the hook. Once per dawn.
A hooded lantern (6 hours per pint of oil, bright light 30 ft., dim 30 ft. more) attuned to one random creature type; its flame turns green while such a creature is within 300 ft.
As an action, summon an orc war chief spirit within 30 ft. that obeys you and understands your languages for 10 minutes or until it drops to 0 HP. After three uses it turns to dust.

A drow spider-silk cloak of elvenkind: hood up, Perception to see you has disadvantage and you have advantage on Stealth to hide (an action to raise or lower). An hour of unbroken sunlight ruins its magic.

A sentient quartz sphere (Int 18, random Wis and Cha and alignment) that speaks four languages, sees and hears 60 ft., and knows four narrow academic subjects (+9 to recall lore in them). It casts mage hand at will only to move itself and never conflicts with its owner.
A lawful good, chatty, condescending professor orb (Wis 11, Cha 9) speaking Common, Draconic, Elvish, and Loross, expert in Netheril's history, vampires, Elverquisst rituals, and the tarrasque.

display.attunementNote: by a creature with Intelligence 3 or higher
display.description: Grants telepathy while attuned and glows purple; higher Intelligence means brighter light and longer telepathy range.
As an action, read it to summon the tarrasque within 1 mile, hostile to everything, vanishing at 0 HP.

Outdoors, as an action, call a comet to a point within 1 mile: a 50-ft.-deep, 500-ft.-radius crater; creatures in it make a DC 20 Dex save, 30d10 force or half, and unattended nonmagical objects and structures are destroyed.

Linked to one shield guardian, which protects and obeys the wearer; you know its distance and direction on the same plane. Within 10 ft., an action and a DC 20 Arcana check reactivates it. Unattended amulet: AC 10, 10 HP, immune to poison and psychic; a new one costs 1,000 gp and a week.
Auril's fur-bound primer of rites: carrying it grants resistance to cold. It holds the spell frost fingers and the incantation poem Rime of the Frostmaiden, which can split a glacier.
A 3-inch brimstone cube that keeps everything within 15 ft. at 95 degrees Fahrenheit.

A 50-ft. Netherese crystal globe (bright light 300 ft., dim 300 ft. more); up to eight attune by a short rest within 30 ft., and all must agree to each use. Fly it 30 ft. per action carrying everything within 500 ft.; recharge a held magic item within 30 ft.; cast control weather (50-mile radius) without components. Touching the globe: DC 22 Con save, 180 (20d10 + 70) radiant or half (undead at disadvantage); objects that touch it disintegrate.

Sentient gilded hilt (NG; Int 12, Wis 15, Cha 14; hearing and darkvision 120 ft.; speaks Common plus your languages, telepathic). Works as a sun blade, its radiant blade summoned or dismissed as a bonus action. Once per dawn, touch a creature to cast lesser restoration. It fears darkness and abandonment and wants to stay lit and close to you.

A drow cloak of elvenkind that also grants resistance to fire: hood up (an action), Perception to see you has disadvantage and you have advantage on Stealth to hide. An hour of unbroken sunlight ruins its magic.

display.attunementNote: by a spellcaster, only to imbue it
display.description: Holds one spell; if you know it or it's on your class list, cast it from the gem as an action without components (no attunement needed), emptying it. Spells above your level need a spellcasting check (DC 10 + spell level). The gem type sets its maximum spell level, rarity, save DC, and attack bonus. Attuned, cast a 1-action or 1-minute-plus spell into an empty gem to store it (consumed abjuration components at half cost), once per dawn.

Advantage on Investigation checks. 10 charges (regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn; 1 in 20 to vanish when emptied): speak with animals (2), speak with dead (4), or speak with plants (3). It can replace a consumed material component of a divination spell for 1 charge per spell level.

7 charges (regains 1d6 + 1 at midnight; 1 in 20 to melt when emptied). As an action, spend 1 for a ranged attack (spellcasting or Int modifier + proficiency) within 60 ft.; on a hit the target is restrained for 1 hour, ended by a pint of alcohol, oil of etherealness, universal solvent, or sunlight. An hour of unbroken sunlight destroys the wand.

display.attunementNote: by a creature proficient in Arcana
display.description: After attuning, you make a DC 20 Wis save at the end of your next long rest or gain a random long-term madness. As an action, cast eyebite or gate (its portal reaching only the Far Realm) from the tablet; it then can't be used again until the next dawn.
Works as an arcane focus. While attuned you have resistance to fire and lightning, and as an action you can cast thunderwave at 4th level (DC 16) from it without a slot.
A 25-lb. chest, 2.5 ft. by 1.5 ft. by 1 ft. with a rounded lid. Food and other perishables stored inside don't age or spoil.

While worn, you look like an attractive human of average build whose features (age, gender, coloring, voice) the circlet picks. Your statistics, racial traits, and gear are unchanged except for size. Taking it off ends the effect.
A saw-toothed dagger with a black pearl in its pommel. While attuned, you have blindsight 30 ft.

A 12-inch, twelve-sided clockwork metal die. As an action, hurl it up to 60 ft.; if it rolls at least 10 ft. before stopping, roll a d12 on its table for a random magical effect (the table is in the adventure). Effects that need a target do nothing without one in range, and spells it casts need no components.

As an action, blow it to summon 3d4 + 3 minotaur-like Abyssal spirits within 60 ft. that use berserker stats and leave after 1 hour or at 0 HP. If you are proficient with all simple weapons they obey you and are friendly to your allies; otherwise they attack you. Usable once every 7 days.
Lets the attuned wearer ignore Undermountain's magical restrictions.
A hollow 5-inch, 5-lb. orb of notched bronze rings. Spend an action lining up the notches and it gongs loudly every 6 seconds, audible 600 ft. away, until they are knocked out of line.
A sweet amber brew. For 8 hours magic can't put you to sleep, and you can stay awake through a long rest and still gain its benefits. It does nothing for creatures that don't sleep.
While worn, use an action to cast levitate with no components; the propeller whirs loudly until the spell ends. Each time the spell ends, there is a 50 percent chance the helm turns nonmagical.

An ancient white dragon scale bearing the uven (enemy) rune, recognizable with a DC 20 Intelligence (History) check. While holding it you are immune to cold; right after a melee hit on you, use your reaction to deal 3d6 necrotic to the attacker; and once per short or long rest you can cast bane (DC 17) from it, lasting 1 minute without concentration. Tracing the rune onto a nonmagical weapon over 8 hours (both within 5 ft.) destroys the shield and makes the weapon a rare +1 weapon requiring attunement, rising to +3 against one creature type you choose: aberrations, celestials, constructs, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, giants, or undead.

A sentient neutral good sword of sharpness with an emerald blade and jeweled hilt, its powers dormant until it is pulled from Valdemar's skull. Hits on objects deal maximum weapon dice. On a natural 20 against a creature it deals 14 extra slashing; roll another d20, and on a 20 it severs a limb (or a chunk of a limbless body). A command word sheds bright light 10 ft. and dim light 10 ft. beyond until repeated or sheathed. An evil creature trying to attune takes 20 psychic. The blade can't be damaged or dulled, and it can't be teleported without its attuned wielder. It has 6 charges (regaining 1d4 + 2 at dawn) to cast fly (2), polymorph (3), or transport via plants (4) without material components. Int 17, Wis 12, Cha 20; hearing and truesight 120 ft.; telepathic with its wielder; speaks Common, Draconic, Elvish, and Sylvan; knows any gem's true value within 5 ft. Vain and beauty-loving, it craves finer gems and longs to return to the forests of Myth Drannor, trying to take over a wielder whose goals oppose that.

A fist-sized bundle of dried stems bound in silver thread, worn on a thong. It has 3 charges, regaining all at dawn. As an action, spend 1 to cast speak with plants, also gaining advantage on Charisma checks to influence plants for the duration.

A cool gray-and-black river stone etched with an unknown sigil. Once per dawn while carrying it, gain advantage on one ability check. Curse: attuning curses you until remove curse or similar magic; you can't get rid of the stone (it teleports back to your pack), and after each use your next two ability checks have disadvantage.
While wearing this brass helmet you can breathe underwater and gain darkvision 60 ft. and a swim speed of 30 ft.
A long wooden pipe with a river-stone bowl. Once per dawn, its smoke lingers around you and after 10 minutes forms moving figures that replay your greatest deeds for 5 minutes before fading.
A small capsule of beeswax, sand, and enchanted water plants. A creature that eats one ignores the effects of swimming deeper than 100 ft.
A 1-ft. sandstone shark with gaping jaws. When a Tiny sea creature comes within 1 inch of its mouth, the shark snaps to life and deals it 1 piercing, at most once per hour.

An obsidian screaming skull with ruby eyes and emerald teeth on an iron chain. It has 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn. As an action, spend 1 to teleport with your gear to a familiar spot within 100 ft. on the same plane, sight not required; it ignores the Tomb of the Nine Gods' magic restrictions. A non-undead user makes a DC 16 Con save each time or arrives transformed, rolling percentile dice on the Black Skull Transformation table (in the adventure).

Artus Cimber's +3 dagger. With it drawn, use a bonus action to make its blue pommel gem shed bright light 20 ft. and dim light 20 ft. beyond (or go dark), or turn it into a north-pointing compass on your palm. Once per dawn each, cast dimension door from it, or compulsion (DC 15, range 90 ft., affecting only spiders that are beasts).

A restless spirit is bound inside. Holding it, command the spirit as a bonus action to shed bright light 30 ft. and dim light 30 ft. beyond, or as an action send it out to act as mage hand until the spell ends. If you fall unconscious within 10 ft., it emerges, stabilizes you, and returns. The spirit can't be harmed, turned, or raised; dispel evil and good frees it to the afterlife and leaves the lantern nonmagical.
A carved wooden beast mask with 3 charges, regaining all at dawn. While wearing it, spend 1 charge to cast animal friendship as an action.

A frost-rimed gold band that sizes itself and numbs the hand until you attune. Sentient chaotic evil (Int 14, Wis 14, Cha 17; hearing and sight 60 ft.; communicates by emotion), it craves destruction and tries to dominate its wearer into reckless cruelty. Neither ring nor wearer can be targeted by divination or seen through scrying. You don't age while wearing it (age doesn't catch up later), though magical aging still affects you. Attuned, you are immune to cold and extreme cold. 12 charges, regaining all at dawn: 1 as an action to chill a 120-ft.-radius sphere within 300 ft. by 20 degrees per minute down to -30 F, icing surfaces, until you end it as an action; spells (DC 17): sleet storm (1), ice spike growth (1), Bigby's hand of ice dealing bludgeoning as a fist and immune to cold (2), cone of cold (2), ice storm (2), wall of ice (2), flesh to ice as flesh to stone (3), Otiluke's freezing sphere (3); or as an action create within 60 ft. a motionless ice object fitting a 10-ft. cube, hard as metal or stone (2), or an ice copy of a beast of CR 2 or lower (4) that is a construct vulnerable to fire, immune to cold and poison and to charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned, and obeys only you; either melts after 24 hours or at 0 HP, losing 5 (1d10) HP per minute in extreme heat. Rumors claim deeper powers for an evil master it can't break, such as freezing worlds or commanding white dragons and the ice primordial Cryonax. It resists all heat and is destroyed only on the finger of the Summer Queen.

Plate made from giant scorpion chitin. While worn, you gain +5 to initiative unless incapacitated, and it imposes no disadvantage on Stealth or on saves against extreme heat. Curse: each time you don or doff it, make a DC 15 Con save, taking 100 (10d10 + 45) poison on a failure or half on a success. Only wish lifts the curse.

display.attunementNote: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
display.description: A crooked bone staff topped by the skull of an archmage Acererak destroyed, marked with his death rune. While you carry it: double proficiency on Arcana and History checks; you can't be blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, petrified, or stunned; undead of CR 2 or lower won't threaten or attack you unless harmed; and it works as a +3 quarterstaff dealing an extra 10 (3d6) necrotic. 7 charges, regaining 1d4 + 3 at dawn: as an action spend 1 to curse a creature within 60 ft. you can see (Con save against your spell DC), which can't regain HP and is vulnerable to necrotic until greater restoration, remove curse, or similar. Whenever anyone but Acererak spends charges, 50 percent chance the trapped archmage tries to possess the wielder (DC 20 Cha save or become a DM-controlled NPC that seeks to destroy the staff; dispel evil and good traps it again). Breaking it as an action unleashes a 30-ft.-radius blast: DC 18 Dex save, 132 (24d10) force, half on success, freeing the spirit. Thrown into a sphere of annihilation, staff, spirit, and sphere are all destroyed without exploding.
+1 to attack and damage rolls with this magic yklwa, the Chultan short spear: a simple melee weapon dealing 1d8 piercing, thrown at range 10/30 ft.
+2 to attack and damage rolls with this magic yklwa, the Chultan short spear: a simple melee weapon dealing 1d8 piercing, thrown at range 10/30 ft.
+3 to attack and damage rolls with this magic yklwa, the Chultan short spear: a simple melee weapon dealing 1d8 piercing, thrown at range 10/30 ft.

The chieftain Kavan's blood-stained spear. When your melee attack with it drops a target to 0 HP, you gain 2d6 temporary HP. Anyone can wield it, but only the one Kavan chose gets +2 to attack and damage rolls with it.

display.attunementNote: by a lawful good creature (takes 1 minute)
