A Medium or smaller beast of CR 1/4 or lower; add your proficiency bonus to its AC, attacks, damage and proficient saves and skills; HP is the higher of its own or 4 x ranger level. It acts on your initiative and Dodges unless you use your action to command Attack, Dash, Disengage or Help (with Extra Attack you also make one weapon attack when commanding Attack). Replace it with 8 hours of bonding.
On a turn it doesn't attack, bonus action to command Dash, Disengage or Help; its attacks count as magical.
When commanded to Attack, it makes two attacks or uses Multiattack.
A spell you cast targeting yourself can also affect your companion within 30 feet.
Advantage on attacks against creatures that haven't taken a turn yet in the combat, and hits against surprised creatures are critical hits.
Spend seven days and 25 gp to build a false identity that others believe while you wear it, until given obvious reason not to.
After 3 hours of study, mimic a person's speech, writing and behavior; advantage on Deception to avoid detection by wary observers.
When you hit a surprised creature, it makes a Con save (DC 8 + Dex + proficiency) or the attack's damage is doubled.

Your mage hand can be invisible, stow or retrieve objects in another creature's container, and use thieves' tools at range; Sleight of Hand vs Perception to go unnoticed. Control it with your Cunning Action bonus action.
If you are hidden from a creature when you cast a spell on it, it has disadvantage on its saves against the spell this turn.
Bonus action: advantage on attacks this turn against a creature within 5 feet of your mage hand.

Reaction right after a creature casts a spell targeting or including you: it saves with its casting ability against your spell DC; on a failure the spell doesn't affect you and, if it is 1st level or higher and of a level you can cast, you know it for 8 hours while the caster can't cast it. Once per long rest.

Once per turn after you cast a 1st-level or higher sorcerer spell, the DM can have you roll a d20; on a 1, roll on the d100 Wild Magic Surge table (spells it produces ignore Metamagic and concentration).
Advantage on one attack, check or save; regained after a long rest, or when the DM has you roll on the surge table after a 1st-level or higher sorcerer spell.
Reaction, 2 sorcery points: add or subtract 1d4 to another visible creature's attack, check or save after the roll.
Roll twice on the surge table and choose.
Once per turn, when a spell damage die rolls its maximum, roll one such die again and add it.
Action: creatures in a 10-foot cube from you make a Wis save or are charmed or frightened (your choice) until the end of your next turn. Once per short or long rest.
Reaction when you take damage: invisible and teleport up to 60 feet, until your next turn or until you attack or cast. Once per short or long rest.
Immune to charm; reaction when a creature tries to charm you: it makes a Wis save or is charmed by you for 1 minute or until damaged.
Action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Wis save or is charmed or frightened for 1 minute (concentration, ends if damaged), lost in an illusory realm seeing only you. Once per short or long rest.
Speak telepathically to any creature within 30 feet that understands a language.
Reaction when attacked: impose disadvantage; if it misses, your next attack against it before the end of your next turn has advantage. Once per short or long rest.
Your thoughts can't be read unless you allow it; resistance to psychic, and a creature that deals you psychic damage takes the same amount.
Action: touch an incapacitated humanoid to charm it until remove curse, the condition is removed, or you use this again; telepathy with it on the same plane.
Copying abjuration spells costs half the gold and time.

When you cast a 1st-level or higher abjuration spell, create a ward (HP 2 x wizard level + Int, once per long rest) that takes damage for you; each later 1st-level or higher abjuration spell restores 2 x spell level HP to it.
Reaction when a creature within 30 feet takes damage: your ward absorbs it.
Add your proficiency bonus to ability checks made as part of abjuration spells (counterspell, dispel magic).
Advantage on saves against spells and resistance to spell damage.
Copying conjuration spells costs half the gold and time.
Action: conjure a nonmagical object you've seen (up to 3 feet per side and 10 pounds) within 10 feet, glowing dimly; it lasts 1 hour or until it deals or takes damage.
Action: teleport 30 feet, or swap places with a willing Small or Medium creature. Once per long rest, or after you cast a 1st-level or higher conjuration spell.
Damage can't break your concentration on conjuration spells.
Creatures you summon or create with conjuration spells have 30 temporary HP.
Copying divination spells costs half the gold and time.
After a long rest roll two d20s; before a roll by you or a creature you can see, replace it with one of them (once per turn). Unused ones are lost at the next long rest.
When you cast a 2nd-level or higher divination spell with a slot, regain a slot of a lower level (max 5th).
Action, until incapacitated or a rest: darkvision 60 feet, see into the Ethereal Plane within 60 feet, read any language, or see invisible things within 10 feet. Once per rest.
Portent rolls three d20s.
Copying enchantment spells costs half the gold and time.

Action, a creature within 5 feet that sees or hears you makes a Wis save or is charmed, speed 0 and incapacitated until the end of your next turn; extend it with your action each turn. Ends if you move away, it loses sight and sound of you, or it takes damage. Once per long rest per creature.
Reaction when a creature within 30 feet attacks you and another creature is in range: Wis save or it attacks the creature closest to it instead (a success makes it immune until a long rest).
A 1st-level or higher enchantment spell that targets one creature can target a second.
A creature you charm with an enchantment can be left unaware of it; once before the spell ends, action: Int save or it forgets up to 1 + Cha mod hours of the charmed time.
Copying illusion spells costs half the gold and time.
Learn minor illusion (or another wizard cantrip if you know it), not counted; it can make a sound and an image at once.
Action: change an illusion of 1 minute or longer that you can see, within its normal parameters.
Reaction when attacked: the attack automatically misses. Once per short or long rest.
Bonus action while a 1st-level or higher illusion spell lasts: make one inanimate, nonmagical object in it real for 1 minute (it can't directly harm anyone).
Copying necromancy spells costs half the gold and time.
Once per turn, when your 1st-level or higher spell kills creatures (not constructs or undead), regain 2 x spell level HP (3 x for necromancy).
Add animate dead to your book; it targets one extra corpse, and your undead gain HP equal to your wizard level and add your proficiency bonus to weapon damage.
Resistance to necrotic, and your hit point maximum can't be reduced.
Action, an undead within 60 feet makes a Cha save or obeys you until you use this again (Int 8+ has advantage; Int 12+ repeats the save each hour). A success makes it immune.
Copying transmutation spells costs half the gold and time.
Transform wood, stone (not gems), iron, copper or silver into another of those, 1 cubic foot per 10 minutes, for 1 hour or until your concentration ends.

8 hours to make a stone granting its holder one of: darkvision 60 feet, +10 feet speed while unencumbered, Con save proficiency, or resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder. Change it when you cast a 1st-level or higher transmutation spell; a new stone ends the old.
Add polymorph to your book; cast it on yourself without a slot into a beast of CR 1 or lower, once per short or long rest.

Action, destroy your stone (remake after a long rest) for one: transmute a nonmagical object up to a 5-foot cube into one of equal or lesser value (10 minutes); remove curses, diseases and poisons and restore all HP to a creature you touch; raise dead without a slot; or reduce a willing creature's apparent age by 3d10 years (minimum 13).

Dwarves only (DM may lift). Spiked armor (medium, AC 14 + Dex max 2, 75 gp) is a weapon for you: while raging, a bonus-action spike attack for 1d4 + Str piercing, and a successful grapple from the Attack action deals 3 piercing.
Reckless Attack while raging gives temporary HP equal to your Con mod (min 1), lost when the rage ends.
Dash as a bonus action while raging.
While raging in spiked armor and not incapacitated, a creature within 5 feet that hits you with a melee attack takes 3 piercing.
When you use Second Wind, up to three allies within 60 feet who see or hear you regain HP equal to your fighter level.
Persuasion proficiency (or one of Animal Handling, Insight, Intimidation, Performance) and double proficiency on Persuasion.
When you Action Surge, an ally within 60 feet who sees or hears you can use its reaction for one weapon attack (two allies at 18th).
When you use Indomitable on an Int, Wis or Cha save, an ally within 60 feet who failed against the same effect and sees or hears you also rerolls.
When you reduce a creature within 5 feet to 0 HP, gain temporary HP equal to Wis mod + monk level (min 1).
Action: creatures within 30 feet that see you make a Wis save or are frightened until the end of your next turn.
When reduced to 0 HP, spend 1 ki to drop to 1 instead.
Action, spend 1 to 10 ki: a creature within 5 feet makes a Con save, 2d10 necrotic per ki, half on a success.
Reaction when a creature within 5 feet takes damage: you take it instead; it can't be reduced.
Advantage on saves against paralyzed and stunned.
Action, 1 hour: resistance to nonmagical weapon damage; allies within 30 feet have advantage on death saves, and you and they have advantage on Wis saves. Once per long rest.

Learn spare the dying; advantage on saves against disease. An undead that targets you directly makes a Wis save or must pick another target (a success, or your attacking it, makes it immune for 24 hours).
When you succeed on a death save or stabilize a creature with spare the dying, regain 1d8 + Con mod HP. Once per long rest.
Hold your breath indefinitely; no need for food, water or sleep; age one year per ten and immune to magical aging.
Bonus action: regain 1d8 + warlock level HP and reattach a severed part you hold in place. Once per short or long rest.
Learn one necromancy cantrip from any list. A necromancy cantrip that targets one creature can target two within range and within 5 feet of each other.
When you hit with a melee attack, spend Channel Divinity for extra necrotic damage equal to 5 + twice your cleric level.
Necrotic damage from your cleric spells and Channel Divinity ignores necrotic resistance.
A 1st to 5th level necromancy spell that targets one creature can target two within range and within 5 feet of each other (consumed components needed for each).
You and fiends and undead within 10 feet add your Cha mod (min +1) to melee weapon damage; 30 feet at 18th. One paladin's aura per creature.
Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical weapons.

Action, 1 minute, once per long rest: bright light within 30 feet becomes dim; enemies frightened of you that start a turn in it take 4d10 psychic; attacks relying on sight have disadvantage against you and chosen allies in it; bonus action for a melee spell attack dealing 3d10 + Cha mod necrotic.
Learn Giant (or another language if you know it) and druidcraft or thaumaturgy (Wis).
While raging: add Rage Damage to Strength-based thrown weapon hits, reach +5 feet, and become Large if smaller and space allows.

On entering rage, infuse a held weapon with acid, cold, fire, thunder or lightning: damage becomes that type, +1d6 of it, and it gains thrown (20/60) and returns after a throw. Bonus action to swap the type.
Bonus action while raging: move a Medium or smaller creature in reach to a space within 30 feet; unwilling targets make a Str save (DC 8 + PB + Str). Unsupported targets fall prone.
Raging reach +10 feet and you can become Large or Huge; Mighty Impel works on Large or smaller; Elemental Cleaver extra damage becomes 2d6.
Learn guidance (not counted against cantrips known); range 60 feet for you.
A candle, crystal ball, skull, spirit board or tarokka deck works as your focus. From 6th, damage or healing bard spells cast through it add 1d6 to one roll.

Bonus action holding your focus, spend Bardic Inspiration and roll it on the Spirit Tales table; action to bestow the tale on a creature within 30 feet (or you). One tale held at a time, saves use your spell DC. Tales by roll: 1 Clever Animal (add your die to Int, Wis, Cha checks for 10 minutes), 2 Renowned Duelist (melee spell attack, two dice + Cha force), 3 Beloved Friends (target and one ally gain die + Cha temp HP), 4 Runaway (reaction teleport 30 feet, plus up to Cha mod others), 5 Avenger (1 minute, melee attackers take die force), 6 Traveler (die + bard level temp HP, +10 speed and +1 AC while they last), 7 Beguiler (Wis save or two dice psychic and incapacitated), 8 Phantom (invisible; first hit adds die necrotic and frightens), 9 Brute (Str save in 30 feet, three dice thunder and prone, half on success), 10 Dragon (30-foot cone, Dex save, four dice fire), 11 Angel (heal two dice + Cha and end blinded, deafened, paralyzed, petrified or poisoned), 12 Mind-Bender (Int save or three dice psychic and stunned).

Hour-long ritual (can be during a rest) with up to PB willing creatures: temporarily learn a divination or necromancy spell from any class of level up to the number of participants and that you can cast. Once per long rest; known until your next long rest.
Roll twice on Spirit Tales and choose; doubles let you choose any tale.

Bonus action, 1 minute, PB times per long rest: gain 1d10 + warlock level temp HP, immunity to frightened, and once per turn a hit can force a Wis save or the target is frightened until the end of your next turn.
No need to eat, drink or breathe. Once per turn change an attack's damage to necrotic; in Form of Dread roll one extra damage die.

Necrotic resistance (immunity in Form of Dread). Reaction when reduced to 0 HP: drop to 1 instead, chosen creatures within 30 feet take 2d10 + warlock level necrotic, and you gain a level of exhaustion. Recharges after 1d4 long rests.

Action, once per long rest, up to 1 hour (concentration): project your spirit, leaving your body unconscious. Gain BPS resistance, no V, S or costless M components for conjuration and necromancy, fly speed equal to walking (hover, move through objects), and in Form of Dread heal half the necrotic damage you deal once per turn.

Draconic Presence: reaction to reroll a failed Intimidation or Persuasion check (once per long rest if it succeeds). Draconic Strike: unarmed strikes can deal acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison. Tongue of Dragons: learn Draconic or another language.

Replace one attack of the Attack action with a 20-foot cone or 30-foot line: Dex save vs ki DC, two Martial Arts dice of a chosen element, half on success (three dice at 11th). PB uses per long rest, then 2 ki each.
When you use Step of the Wind, gain a fly speed equal to walking speed until the end of your turn. PB uses per long rest.
Bonus action, 10-foot aura for 1 minute: Frightful Presence (bonus action, Wis save or frightened, repeating) or Resistance to a chosen element for you and allies in it. Once per long rest or 3 ki.

Augment Breath: 1 ki for a 60-foot cone or 90-foot line dealing four dice. Blindsight 10 feet. Explosive Fury: activating Aspect of the Wyrm forces chosen creatures in the aura to make a Dex save or take 3d10 of a chosen element.
Learn thaumaturgy (ranger spell) and Draconic or another language.

Action: summon your Small dragon drake within 30 feet (AC 14 + PB, HP 5 + 5 x ranger level, speed 40, bite +3 + PB for 1d6 + PB piercing, reaction Infused Strikes adds 1d6 of its essence to an ally's weapon hit within 30 feet). Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison essence for its immunity. Acts on your turn; Dodges unless you spend a bonus action to command it. Once per long rest or a 1st-level slot.
Drake gains wings (fly speed equal to walking), grows to Medium and can be ridden (no flying while ridden), bite adds 1d6 of its essence, and you gain resistance to its essence type.
Action: you or the drake exhale a 30-foot cone of a chosen element, Dex save vs spell DC, 8d6 (10d6 at 15th), half on success. Once per long rest or a 3rd-level slot.
Bite adds another 1d6 (2d6 total); drake grows to Large and can fly while ridden; reaction PB times per long rest to give you or the drake resistance to one instance of damage while within 30 feet.

Bonus action: create an echo of yourself within 15 feet (AC 14 + PB, 1 HP, immune to conditions, uses your saves); it moves 30 feet on your turn for free and is destroyed beyond 30 feet. Bonus action and 15 feet of movement to swap places; Attack action attacks can originate from it; reaction opportunity attacks from its space.
When you take the Attack action, make one extra melee attack from the echo. Con mod uses (min 1) per long rest.
Action: see and hear through the echo for up to 10 minutes (you are blinded and deafened); it can be up to 1,000 feet away.
Reaction before an attack roll against a creature you see: teleport the echo within 5 feet of it and the attack targets the echo. Once per short or long rest.
When your echo is destroyed by damage, gain 2d6 + Con mod temp HP if you have none. Con mod uses (min 1) per long rest.
Manifest two coexisting echoes; and when you roll initiative with no Unleash Incarnation uses, regain one.
Reaction after you or a creature within 30 feet makes an attack roll, check or save: force a reroll (after seeing the result). Twice per long rest.
Add your Int mod to initiative.
Action: a Large or smaller creature within 60 feet makes a Con save or is incapacitated with speed 0 until the end of your next turn or until it takes damage. Int mod uses (min 1) per long rest.
When you cast a spell of 4th level or lower, store it in a bead for 1 hour (AC 15, 1 HP); a holder can release it as an action using your attack bonus and DC. Once per short or long rest.

Reaction when you or a creature within 60 feet makes an attack roll, check or save: set the roll to the minimum needed to succeed or one less. Gain a level of exhaustion, removable only by a long rest.

Action, concentration up to 1 minute: halve or double the weight of a Large or smaller creature or object within 30 feet (Huge at 10th). Halved: +10 speed, double jump, disadvantage on Str checks and saves. Doubled: -10 speed, advantage on Str checks and saves.
When a spell you cast hits a creature with an attack, it fails a save, or it is willing, move it 5 feet to an unoccupied space.
Reaction: a weapon hit by a creature within 60 feet deals an extra 1d10, or a fall within 60 feet deals an extra 2d10. Int mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

Action, concentration up to 1 minute: hostile creatures starting a turn within 30 feet make a Str save, taking 2d10 force and speed 0 on a failure, or half damage and 2 extra feet per foot moved on a success. Once per long rest or a 3rd-level slot.

Learn the Lunar Spells (not counted against spells known): shield, ray of sickness, color spray (1st); lesser restoration, blindness/deafness, alter self (3rd); dispel magic, vampiric touch, phantom steed (5th); death ward, confusion, hallucinatory terrain (7th); Rary's telepathic bond, hold monster, mislead (9th). After a long rest pick Full, New or Crescent Moon; cast that phase's 1st-level spell once free per long rest.
Learn sacred flame (not counted against cantrips); it can target two creatures within 5 feet of each other.
Metamagic on spells of your phase's schools costs 1 less sorcery point (Full: abjuration, divination; New: enchantment, necromancy; Crescent: illusion, transmutation). PB times per long rest.
Bonus action and 1 sorcery point to change phase. You can cast each phase's 1st-level spell once free per long rest while in that phase.

Full: bonus action to shed 10-foot bright light, advantage on Investigation and Perception for you and chosen creatures in it. New: advantage on Stealth, and attacks against you have disadvantage while you are in darkness. Crescent: resistance to necrotic and radiant.

Bonus action (or as part of changing phase), once per long rest each or 5 sorcery points. Full: chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Con save or are blinded until the end of their next turn, and one creature regains 3d8 HP. New: Dex save or 3d10 necrotic and speed 0, and you turn invisible until the end of your next turn. Crescent: teleport 60 feet with one willing creature, both gaining resistance to all damage until your next turn.

Learn three Carrion Raven maneuvers (one more at 6th, 10th, and 14th; swap one each time). Maneuver points equal twice your Barbarian level, regained on a long rest; one maneuver per turn; save DC 8 + PB + Con mod. Apex Dominance (5, action): Str save (Disadvantage if you grapple it) or 6d10 force, half on success; kills outright at 0 HP. Axolotl's Regeneration (2 or 6, bonus action): heal 1d12 + Con mod; at 6 points also regrow a limb or organ. Bestial Transformation (8, action): polymorph yourself into a beast of CR up to half your level, keeping mental scores. Call of the Beast Lord (5, action, concentration): summon a beast of CR up to your level for 10 minutes. Carrion Feast (4, action): melee attack with +5d6 necrotic and temp HP equal to it. Falcon's Glide (1, reaction): slow a fall to 60 feet per round, and 1 more point per bonus action for 30-foot flight that turn. Feral Fighting (1, bonus action): an unarmed strike dealing 1d8. Hibernating Bear Recuperation (5, action): a 10-minute sleep with resistance to non-psychic damage that counts as a short rest, ends poison, removes 1 exhaustion, and turns spent Hit Dice into temp HP. Pack Leader (1, reaction): when an adjacent enemy is attacked, give that attack advantage and attack it yourself. Predator's Howl (2, bonus action): two creatures within 30 feet make a Wis save or are frightened until your next turn, taking +1d6 psychic from weapon hits. Shape of the Behemoth (3, action, concentration, 1 minute): grow a size (max Large), +5 feet reach, +1d6 weapon damage, 1d6 temp HP each turn. Slippery Otter (1, bonus action): swim 30, hold breath for twice your Con score in minutes, bonus action Dash in water for an hour. Snout of the Bloodhound (1, 1 minute): for an hour, advantage on Perception and tracking, add PB to initiative, no disadvantage against invisible creatures. Stoic Oxen Spirit (2, reaction): end charmed or frightened and gain advantage against its source until the end of your next turn. Trampling Bull (3, bonus action): move your speed through creatures your size or smaller; each makes a Str save or falls prone and takes 1d8 + Str mod bludgeoning. Tusks of the Rampaging Mammoth (3, action): a melee attack dealing +3d12 and pushing a Huge or smaller target 15 feet. Woolly Beast's Hide (2+, reaction): reduce a hit's damage by 1d6 per 2 points and gain that much temp HP.
Make one weapon attack as part of the bonus action that starts your rage, and you can concentrate on maneuvers (not spells) while raging.
Proficiency in Animal Handling (or Athletics, Nature, or Survival if you have it), and you can cast speak with animals as a ritual.
When you rage, chosen creatures within 10 feet that can see you make a Wisdom save against your maneuver DC or are frightened of you until the end of their next turn.
Once per attack, when a weapon damage die rolls its maximum, spend 1 maneuver point to roll another of that die and add it.
Learn two necromancy cantrips from any list; they are bard spells and don't count against your cantrips known.

A creature holding your Bardic Inspiration die can spend it when dealing weapon damage to add the roll as necrotic damage, or as a reaction when a living creature drops to 0 hit points to drop to 1 instead.

Learn animate dead (a bard spell that doesn't count against spells known). When you give out Bardic Inspiration, up to PB undead you control within 60 feet each gain a Dirge die usable like Bardic Inspiration within 10 minutes, and you can command them with the same bonus action. An undead that spends a Dirge die on a hit also adds it to damage.
Once per short or long rest, a single-target necromancy spell you cast can target a second creature in range at no extra component cost.
Always prepared at cleric levels: 1st detect magic, identify; 3rd see invisibility, silence; 5th dispel magic, remove curse; 7th arcane eye, locate creature; 9th creation, hallow.

Wisdom modifier times (min 1) per long rest, a weapon hit deals +1d8 force (2d8 against a concentrating creature); at 14th level 2d8 and 3d8. If the target then fails its concentration save, gain temp HP equal to that extra damage.
As a bonus action, a creature within 30 feet (or you) gains 1d10 + cleric level temp HP for up to 1 hour; while they last it has resistance to spell damage and advantage on saves against spells.

Wisdom modifier times (min 1) per long rest, as a reaction when a creature within 60 feet casts a spell: Constitution save or 1d8 per slot level (cantrips count as 1st) + Wis mod force, half on success.
Spell Shield can target up to your Wisdom modifier (min 2) creatures.

Learn a stance (more at 7th, 10th, and 15th); enter one on initiative and switch as a bonus action. Adamantine Bull: reaction to push a same-size-or-smaller melee attacker 5 feet on a failed Str save (10 feet at 18th). Iron Punisher: advantage on your melee attacks but attacks against you have advantage (+2d6 damage at 18th). Steel Serpent: +5 feet reach on your turn (always at 18th). Weightless Mithral: advantage on Dex saves (bonus action Dodge at 18th).
Advantage on saving throws made during your turn.
As a bonus action, spend up to 3 maneuver points to deal 1d6 psychic per point to a creature you are grappling.
Second Wind also restores maneuver points equal to half your fighter level.
Below half your hit points, add a d10 to the first attack roll or save you make each turn, and maneuvers cost 1 point less (min 1).
You and friendly creatures within 10 feet can't be blinded while you are conscious, and chosen creatures and objects in range gain nothing from being invisible. 30 feet at 18th level.
Cast zone of truth without a slot; creatures that pass the save take 1d4 psychic at the start of each of their turns in the area.

Once per long rest, as an action for 1 minute: truesight 120 feet; creatures that start their turn or move within 5 feet of you make a Con save or are blinded until their next turn; and as a bonus action pick a creature within 60 feet that all attacks hit with advantage until your next turn.

As a bonus action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Cha save against your misfortune DC (8 + PB + Cha mod) or is marked for 1 minute (one at a time). You can Sneak Attack it without advantage, provided you don't have disadvantage.

Learn two misfortunes (one more at 9th, 13th, and 17th; swap one per long rest). You have 4 jinx points (6 at 13th), regained on a short or long rest. Befuddled (2, action): charmed 10 minutes. Clumsy (3, reaction when it moves 5 feet): prone and speed 0. Debilitated (1, reaction when it takes damage): +1d12 necrotic. Doomed (1, reaction after a miss): make another weapon attack. Fearful (2, action): frightened 1 minute (Wis save each turn). Inept (1, reaction): it rerolls a check or attack and keeps the lower. Insensate (3, action): blinded and deafened 1 minute (Con save each turn). Maimed (2, reaction): a hit on 18-19 becomes a crit. Marked (2, bonus action): the mark lasts 24 hours and you sense its direction. Plagued (1, reaction): halve its healing and block healing until your next turn. Ruined (2, reaction): it rerolls a save and keeps the lower. Somnolent (3, action): roll d10s equal to your rogue level + 15; if that meets its current HP it falls unconscious for 10 minutes. Unlucky (3, bonus action): subtract 1d4 from its attacks and saves while marked.
Once per short or long rest, as a reaction remove advantage from a roll by a creature within 30 feet and regain a jinx point.
Spend 3 jinx points and an action to cast bestow curse (Charisma).
Steal Luck works three times per short or long rest.

While raging one hand becomes a fiery claw: your first weapon hit each turn with that hand's weapon deals +1d6 fire, or if you dealt no such fire damage, a bonus action unarmed strike with the empty claw (bludgeoning or slashing) adds 1d6 fire. The fire die grows to 1d8 at 6th level, 1d10 at 10th, 1d12 at 14th.
Learn Abyssal or Infernal, and add Str mod to Intimidation and Persuasion checks with fiends (Intimidation with anyone from 10th level).
Resistance to fire damage. While raging, a successful grapple from the Attack action deals your claw's fire damage, and again at the end of each of the target's turns while grappled.
As an action spend 2 Hit Dice (without healing) to cast detect thoughts (DC 8 + PB + Con mod).
Twice per rage, when a creature you can see within 60 feet damages you, use your reaction for a 3rd-level hellish rebuke (DC 8 + PB + Con mod).

A creature using your Bardic Inspiration can flip a coin instead of rolling: heads it counts as the maximum; tails the GM keeps the die to boost a creature of their choice later (lost on your long rest).

Any coin is your spellcasting focus. As an action fling a coin within 60 feet (ranged spell attack using Charisma): 1 bludgeoning + 1d12 thunder (2d12 at 6th, 3d12 at 14th), then it returns; a natural 20 against a hostile creature with a real coin duplicates it.

Cha mod times (min 1) per long rest, as an action enchant a held coin for 10 minutes: whoever holds it and you understand each other's speech, and you have advantage on your first Persuasion check haggling with them; or as an action see and hear through it until your next turn.
Consumed material components, potions, and scrolls worth up to 500 gp have a 50 percent chance not to be used up, and you can Use an Object or drink a potion as a bonus action.

Domain spells at cleric levels: 1st goodberry, purify food and drink; 3rd heat metal, protection from poison; 5th create food and water, stinking cloud; 7th blight, control water; 9th cloudkill, contagion.
Wis mod times (min 1) per long rest, when a creature within 5 feet hits you, use your reaction: Con save or 1d12 poison and poisoned until the end of its next turn, or half damage only.
As an action create a potion; a creature that drinks it as a bonus action heals 2d6 + cleric level. It crumbles on your next short or long rest.

Advantage on saves against poison and resistance to acid and poison damage. Your create food and water is delicious and can include up to 5 gallons of ale or wine. Once per long rest, as an action suppress being drunk or poisoned for 1 minute.
Once per long rest, bless a meal for you and up to six others: after 10 minutes of eating, each gains 2d6 + 10 temp HP and immunity to being charmed or magically slept for 8 hours.
Learn Draconic, and add PB (double if proficient) to History checks about dragons.

As a bonus action spend a Wild Shape use to become a Medium dragon of a chosen color for up to half your druid level in hours, keeping your statistics: AC 13 + Dex mod (max 2), walk and climb 30, temp HP equal to your HP maximum. No spellcasting, but your bite is an unarmed strike using Wis for 1d12 + Str or Wis mod piercing, and a breath weapon (action, once per minute) deals 2d6 of your color's type in a 15-foot cone (Dex save, half on success), growing to 3d6/20 feet at 6th, 4d6/25 feet at 10th, 5d6/30 feet at 14th.
In dragon shape: AC 14 + Dex (max 2), claws (2d6 + Str or Wis slashing) so the Attack action gives a bite and a claw, attacks count as magical, and darkvision 60 feet (or +30).
In dragon shape you can cast druid spells of 3rd level or lower without material components; AC 15 + Dex (max 2), resistance to your color's damage type, fly 30.
Once per long rest use the breath weapon outside dragon shape. In dragon shape: AC 16 + Dex (max 2), fly 40, three attacks (bite and two claws), and you can be Large with a 10-foot bite reach.

Three times per short or long rest (four at 7th, five at 15th), as a bonus action leap up to 15 feet in any combination of directions (30 at 7th) without provoking, reducing any fall after by 30 feet. A melee attack right after or during the leap has advantage and deals +1d8 (1d10 at 10th, 1d12 at 18th).
Unmounted, a lance is versatile for you (1d8 one hand, 1d12 two; Launch attacks count as two-handed). After hitting an adjacent creature with a lance, step 5 feet away without provoking it.
Advantage on Animal Handling with flying beasts, and cast animal messenger as a ritual on flying beasts.
Armor never gives you Stealth disadvantage. When you make a Dex save you can Launch as a reaction, taking no damage on a success and half on a failure.
Your Launch attack crits on 19-20, and a flier it hits makes a Str save (DC 8 + PB + Str mod) or has speed 0 until its next turn. Perception proficiency, doubled for sight.
Advantage on initiative, and regain a Launch use if you have none when you roll it.

Launch attack hits knock the target prone on a failed Str save. Once per short or long rest you can leap up to 90 feet with no falling damage until you land, at the cost of a level of exhaustion (not usable at two or more levels).

Any unarmed strike can instead be a proficient melee spell attack with 30-foot reach using Wis for attack and damage, dealing your Martial Arts die of force. From 6th level it can deliver Stunning Strike.
Learn mage hand with no verbal or somatic components, cast and controlled as a bonus action.

You can't be possessed by ghosts or similar undead; spend 2 ki as an action to cast gentle repose or see invisibility without material components; learn spare the dying. Dismiss Undead: a Flurry of Blows hit forces an undead of low enough CR (1/2 at 6th, 1 at 8th, 2 at 11th, 3 at 14th, 4 at 17th) to make a Wis save against your ki DC or be put to rest.

Etherstep: 1 ki as a bonus action (or 1 extra ki with Step of the Wind, which also lets you pass through creatures and thin objects) makes you invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack or cast. Phase: Wis mod times (min 1) per long rest, a reaction reduces a hit's damage by your monk level.
Truesight and telepathy 60 feet, and once per long rest cast etherealness lasting 1 minute.

A hostile creature that ends its turn within 10 feet while concentrating makes a Con save against your spell DC or loses concentration. You and allies within 10 feet can't be perceived by scrying sensors. 30 feet at 18th level.
Damage can't break your concentration on paladin spells.

Once per long rest, as an action for 1 minute in a 30-foot radius: resistance to spell damage and advantage on saves against spells, melee attackers take force equal to Cha mod, and whenever you spend a spell slot allies in the field heal and enemies take force equal to Cha mod.
Bonus ranger spells known at ranger levels: 3rd feather fall, 5th gust of wind, 9th lightning bolt, 13th ice storm, 17th legend lore.
Once per turn either add 1d4 of the weapon's type to a weapon hit (1d8 at 11th), or redirect a miss to another target within 5 feet (15 at 11th) and in range, using the original roll + Wis mod.
Wis mod times (min 1) per long rest, 10 minutes of meditation grants a skill or tool proficiency until your next use or rest.
+5 feet walking speed, unaffected by strong wind, resistance to cold damage, and acclimated to high altitude.
Right after a running jump, a bonus action grows spectral wings until your next turn ends or you land, giving you a flying speed equal to your walking speed.

Once per short or long rest, when you take damage use your reaction for resistance (or ignore falling damage); creatures you choose within 15 feet make a Str save or take bludgeoning equal to your ranger level and fall prone (half and not prone on success), and the wind can carry you 30 feet without provoking.
Medicine proficiency with double PB. As a bonus action stabilize an unconscious creature within 5 feet, or spend a healer's kit use to heal 1d4 + PB (once per creature per short or long rest).
Once per turn when your Sneak Attack damages a creature that isn't a construct or undead, gain Wis mod (min 1) temp HP until your next turn (twice that at 13th).
At the start of a short rest pick a willing creature in reach; at its end it heals your Sneak Attack dice total (once per long rest per creature).
When Transfusion triggers, the target loses 10 feet of speed and has disadvantage on its next attack or check before the end of its next turn.
Once per short or long rest, after your Sneak Attack damages a beast or humanoid, it makes a Con save (DC 8 + PB + Wis mod) or falls under dominate beast or dominate person for 1 minute.
Sand difficult terrain doesn't slow you, and you tolerate heat up to 150 degrees Fahrenheit unprotected.

When you cast a 1st-level or higher spell on your turn, a bonus action raises a 5-foot twister within 30 feet: a Large or smaller creature there makes a Str save or is pushed 10 feet (5 if Large). From 6th level it also takes 1d8 bludgeoning or fire (2d8 at 14th, 3d8 at 18th).

Learn mirror image (or another sorcerer spell if known), not counted against spells known; cast it with 2 sorcery points or a slot. Cast with sorcery points, each destroyed duplicate deals fire equal to half your sorcerer level to creatures within 10 feet.
Right after Sandstorm pushes a creature (or lands in an empty space), spend 2 sorcery points to teleport into the twister's space, invisible until the end of your turn.

As a bonus action spend 5 sorcery points for 1 minute: you can't be grappled, slip through 1-inch gaps, move through any creature, and ignore difficult terrain. When hit, a reaction gives you resistance to all damage until the end of that turn.

You have PB invisible spectral heads, refreshed on a long rest (and once per long rest restore two as a bonus action). Expend one to: deal 1 + PB psychic on a hit (once per turn); gain advantage on Intimidation; or turn a failed death save into a success.
While you have a head left, you can't be surprised and allies' adjacency doesn't give attackers advantage against you.

Also expend a head to: gain 2d6 + Cha mod temp HP as a bonus action; take a second reaction in a round (not on the turn you used your normal one); or reroll a failed save against being charmed, frightened, or magically slept.
Add half your PB to Intelligence checks, Perception checks, and Intelligence saves.

Once per long rest, as an action regain all heads with a roar; up to that many creatures within 60 feet make an Int save or take 4d8 psychic and are incapacitated until the end of your next turn (half and not incapacitated on success).

Craft a personal wand that is your focus and can be summoned to your hand as a bonus action from anywhere (8 hours to remake). It holds up to 7 core charges, resetting to 1 on a long rest, and gains half a spell's level (min 1) whenever you cast a leveled spell with it. Spend charges to add that many to an attack roll or save (after rolling, before the result), or as a reaction to add that many to AC against a hit.

Copy wizard spells from staves and wands you hold into your spellbook as from scrolls. Touch-range wizard spells cast with your core wand can target a visible creature not behind cover up to 10 feet away (30 at 14th).
Arcane Recovery also restores 3 core charges. Spend up to 3 charges to raise the save DC of a single-target saving throw spell by that much.

On each long rest imbue up to Int mod (min 1) wizard spells (non-damaging cantrips or 1st-2nd level, action or bonus action, no concentration or costly components) into a stick that anyone can use with an action; it has Int mod charges (cantrip 0, 1st 1, 2nd 2) and uses your DC and attack bonus until your next long rest.

Bonus action: spend charges to fire that many force motes at different targets within 60 feet for 1d4 + Int mod each. Reaction: spend charges to reduce damage to you or a creature within 30 feet by three per charge. You never roll for a staff or wand's last charge, and crafting magic wands costs half the time and gold.

Wis mod times (min 1) per long rest, as a bonus action animate the shadow of a creature within 30 feet (shadow stat block) for up to 5 minutes: it acts on your initiative, moves to and attacks only that creature, and its hits deal no damage but give disadvantage on the target's next attack or save before the shadow's next turn.
In Umbral Form you also fly at your speed and hover, and resist nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing.

Once per short or long rest, as an action emit a moving 15-foot sphere of magical darkness for 1 minute that darkvision can't pierce (except creatures you choose); it dispels overlapping light spells of 7th level or lower and ends in sunlight.

As a bonus action spend a Bardic Inspiration for a 20-foot sphere of shadows around you for 1 minute: allies inside have half cover and outsiders have disadvantage on Perception into it (darkvision doesn't help). Dispels overlapping light spells of 2nd level or lower.
In dim light or darkness, you and allies who can see you have advantage against fear effects, and hostile creatures who can see you have disadvantage against them.
Right after a creature adds your Bardic Inspiration to a roll, it can teleport up to 30 feet without provoking.

Once per short or long rest, when you cast a spell, use your reaction so up to Cha mod creatures within 60 feet who saw and heard it make a Cha save or are frightened for 1 minute (repeat save each turn).
Wis mod times (min 1) per long rest, use your reaction to give disadvantage to an enemy's attack on an ally within 30 feet.
As an action, up to Wis mod creatures within 60 feet that can see you gain 5 temp HP (8 at 6th, 11 at 8th, 14 at 17th) and can each use their reaction to make one weapon attack.
Wis mod times (min 1) per long rest, as a reaction end charmed, frightened, paralyzed, or stunned on yourself or an ally within 30 feet.
Once per turn a weapon hit forces a Str save against your spell DC or the target is knocked prone (and from 14th level its speed is halved until your next turn).
Once per short or long rest, when an ally within 60 feet drops to 0 hit points but isn't killed, it stays conscious and regains half its hit point maximum.
See normally in magical and nonmagical darkness out to 60 feet.
Choose light-shifted or dark-shifted each long rest. As an action emit a 15-foot aura of bright light (or nonmagical darkness), resizable by 5 feet as a bonus action between 10 and 30 feet.
As a bonus action spend 3 sorcery points for a 10-minute shield: melee attackers within 5 feet that hit you take 2d8 radiant (light-shifted) or necrotic (dark-shifted).
Your aura becomes sunlight (light) or magical darkness (dark), dispelling overlapping light or darkness spells up to your highest slot level.
As an action spend 5 sorcery points: for 1 minute (concentration), hostile creatures starting their turn within 60 feet make a Con save or are blinded until the aura ends.
Your poison damage ignores resistance and immunity.

As a bonus action curse a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute: your spell attack hits on it deal +1d6 poison (once per spell). If it drops to 0, a later bonus action moves the curse. One target at a time.
Once per short or long rest, when you take damage, use your reaction: the attacker makes a Con save or is poisoned for 1 minute (repeat save each turn).
Immune to disease, poison damage, and the poisoned condition.
Once per short or long rest, when you hit with an attack the target makes a Wis save or is paralyzed and poisoned for 24 hours; the paralysis ends if it takes damage or stops being poisoned.
Darkvision 60 feet (or +60) and sight through magical darkness to 30 feet, but sunlight sensitivity (disadvantage on attacks and sight-based Perception in sunlight).
As a bonus action spend two spell slots to recover one slot of a level no higher than their combined levels.

When attacked, use your reaction (before knowing the result) to wrap yourself in a 10-foot sphere of magical darkness until your next turn. If that attacker still hits, you can't use this against it again until a long rest.
When you roll initiative in dim light or darkness, you are hidden from creatures at least 10 feet away until you move, attack, or cast.
In dim light or darkness, +2 AC and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing.
Stealth proficiency, darkvision 60 feet (or +30), and Hide as a bonus action in dim light or darkness.
Your shadow can deliver your touch cleric spells to a creature you see within 15 feet (30 at 10th level).
As an action a creature within 30 feet makes a Str save: restrained by its shadow until the end of your next turn on a failure, grappled on a success.
PB times per long rest, as a bonus action in dim light or darkness turn invisible for 1 minute (ends if you attack or cast).
Shadow Grasp can target up to PB creatures.
While raging, smoke fills 10 feet around you; other creatures starting their turn in it have disadvantage on their next attack roll.
As an action teleport up to 60 feet to a space you can see, making one melee attack before or after.
Once per short or long rest, while raging in dim light or darkness, a bonus action heals 1d12 + Con mod, and you regain 1 HP at the start of each turn for the rest of the rage.
Hostile creatures entering or starting their turn in your Shadow Smoke make a Con save (DC 8 + PB + Con mod) or are blinded until their next turn.
Darkvision 120 feet.

After an hour's meditation in darkness during a long rest, pick one boon for 24 hours: teleport up to half your speed between dim or dark spaces as part of your move with advantage on your next Stealth check; or gain half cover after moving at least half your speed in dim light or darkness; or once per turn add PB cold damage to a weapon hit.
You can Sneak Attack without advantage against a creature within 30 feet while you're in dim light or darkness, if you lack disadvantage.
Three times per long rest cast darkness as a bonus action without material components. As an action in dim light or darkness become invisible until you attack, cast, or enter bright light.
Once per short or long rest, when you deal Sneak Attack damage, the target makes a Dex save (DC 8 + PB + Dex mod) or is restrained for 1 minute (repeat save each turn).
Proficiency in Performance and Persuasion, and use Wis instead of Cha for Charisma-based skill checks.
As an action spend 1 ki to cast charm person or command, or 2 ki for suggestion.
Once per turn spend 1 ki when an unarmed strike hits to add radiant (good or neutral) or necrotic (evil) damage equal to PB.
When a creature first tries to attack you on a turn, use your reaction for a Performance or Persuasion check; if it beats the creature's Wisdom score, it must pick another target or waste the attack.

Proficiency with surgeon's tools, which can be your spellcasting focus. You know alter self (a bard spell for you, not counted against spells known) and can cast it over 1 minute without a slot, Change Appearance only and without concentration. Once per long rest, 10 minutes with surgeon's tools gives a willing creature the Change Appearance effect until it finishes a long rest.

You know spiritual weapon (a bard spell for you, not counted against spells known) and can cast it once per long rest without a slot; as a bard spell it is a giant needle and thread dealing piercing damage. Suture (3rd): as an action or bonus action, spend a Bardic Inspiration to move the weapon 20 feet and give a creature within 5 feet of it temporary hit points equal to one Bardic Inspiration roll, or stabilize it at 0. Unspool (5th): as an action, spend a Bardic Inspiration to move it 20 feet; a creature within 5 feet makes a Strength save or is restrained for 1 minute (action to repeat the save). Acupuncture (10th): as an action, spend a Bardic Inspiration to move it 20 feet and make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet: piercing equal to a Bardic Inspiration roll + Charisma modifier, and a Constitution save or paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

Over 10 minutes, give up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) creatures within 60 feet, including you, one shared adaptation for 1 hour. Bull's Buns: advantage on Strength checks and one size larger for carrying and lifting. Cactus Skin: grapplers make a Constitution save at the end of the target's turn or take piercing equal to your Bardic Inspiration die and release it (half and no release on a success). Cat's Paws: advantage on Dexterity checks and no damage from falls of 20 feet or less. Fish Form: breathe water and swim speed equal to walking speed. Owl's Sight: advantage on Wisdom checks and initiative. Rhino's Hide: advantage on Constitution checks and temporary hit points equal to a Bardic Inspiration roll + Charisma modifier. Once per long rest, or again by expending a 3rd-level or higher slot.

A creature that uses one of your Bardic Inspiration dice, or fails a save against Unspool or Acupuncture, is soulsewn to you for 1 minute by a thread visible only to you and truesight (it breaks beyond 100 feet). Spool: as a bonus action, teleport to the nearest unoccupied space to a soulsewn creature, or swap places with it (an unwilling creature contests with Charisma; you lose if there isn't room). Uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per long rest.
When you use Wild Shape you can become a swarm of creatures, within the normal CR and speed limits.

As a bonus action, rile your symbiotes for 1 minute. When a creature within 15 feet targets you with a melee attack on its turn, the swarm retaliates: Constitution save, 2d6 poison or half on a success (3d6 at 6th, 4d6 at 10th, 5d6 at 14th); once per round, until the start of your next turn. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) per long rest. You can also convey basic emotions and ideas to arthropods with pheromones.
While Symbiotic Biosphere is active, when you take damage from a source you can see, use your reaction to reduce it by your Wisdom modifier + half your druid level (applied before resistance).

As a bonus action, a willing creature you can see within 30 feet regains hit points equal to your druid level and can use its reaction to move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) per long rest.
Blindsight and tremorsense 10 feet, resistance to poison damage, immunity to the poisoned condition, advantage on concentration saves, and advantage on initiative.
Share Your Meal, Nurture Over Cure, Permit Prosperity.
Proficiency with cook's utensils.

Creatures of your choice within 10 feet that regain hit points from a spell, potion, magical effect, or food regain an extra 1d6. A creature spending most of a short rest within 10 feet regains 1 extra hit point per Hit Die spent. Lay on Hands doesn't trigger it. The aura grows to 30 feet at 18th level.

Over an hour (can be a short rest), with 25 gp of rare spices and 25 gp of diamond dust, augment a meal for you and up to nine others. For 8 hours each diner has advantage on Constitution saves, resistance to poison damage, immunity to being frightened, and 2d10 temporary hit points. Once per long rest.

As a bonus action, for 1 minute: at the start of each of your turns, creatures of your choice within 30 feet (including you) regain hit points and gain temporary hit points each equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1); you can cast revivify as a bonus action without preparing it or using a slot (components still needed); and you can use your reaction to give a creature within 30 feet resistance to damage it takes. Once per long rest, or again by expending a 5th-level slot.

Copying biomancy spells into your spellbook costs half the gold and time. Proficiency with surgeon's tools. These count as biomancy spells for you: false life, longstrider, alter self, darkvision, spider climb, haste, water breathing, stoneskin, flesh to stone, simulacrum, and shapechange (plus the book's biomancy spells).
When you use a slot to cast a biomancy spell of 1st level or higher, you or the target (your choice) regains hit points equal to twice the spell's level.

Over 1 hour (can be during a rest), give yourself one improvement: Amphibisprings (jump distance tripled); Extra Appendage (tail or arm, hold one more thing, advantage on climbing checks); Detachable Hand (action: it acts as unseen servant, visible); Firefly Skin (light on yourself at will; bonus action flash forces creatures within 5 feet to make a Constitution save or be blinded until the end of your next turn, once per short rest); Owl Eyes (darkvision 120 feet); Slime (checks to grapple you have disadvantage); Scales (+1 AC without armor); Spidersense (+1d4 initiative); Talon (unarmed strikes deal 1d8 + Strength slashing, bonus action automatic damage to a creature you grapple); Third Leg (+10 feet speed, advantage against being knocked prone); Trimorphism (enlarge/reduce on yourself at will, no components or concentration). You sustain one at a time, two at 10th level, and three at 14th.
When you cast a wizard spell that targets only one creature and doesn't have a range of self, you can also target yourself. Uses equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) per long rest.

Over 1 hour, implant a Brutish or Swift capsule; crack it as a bonus action for 1 minute of benefits. Brutish: become Large, Strength rises to your Intelligence, advantage on Strength and Constitution checks and saves, a 2d10 natural weapon (Strength-based), two attacks per Attack action, and temporary hit points equal to twice your Intelligence modifier at the start of each turn. Swift: Dexterity rises to your Intelligence, advantage on Dexterity checks and saves, 1-action cantrips can be cast as a bonus action, and the benefits of haste (can't be dispelled). Afterward you gain a level of exhaustion and can't move or act until the end of your next turn. You must craft a new capsule to use it again.

Proficiency with cook's utensils, which can be your spellcasting focus; double proficiency bonus on checks using them to prepare food. When you cook a dish you can add one extra ingredient, gaining its benefit on a successful Cooking check.

During a short or long rest, make treats equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) of one flavor; they stay magical until your next rest. Eating one (action or bonus action) grants a benefit until the end of the eater's next turn. Bitter: resistance to poison and advantage against being poisoned. Salty: advantage on Wisdom saves and immunity to being charmed. Sour: weapon attacks deal extra acid equal to a Bardic Inspiration roll. Sweet: temporary hit points equal to a Bardic Inspiration roll + Charisma modifier for 1 hour. Umami: +2 AC. As a bonus action, spend a Bardic Inspiration to teleport any number of your treats to creatures you can see within 60 feet; each can eat one with its reaction or as a bonus action on its next turn.

Choose one. Slow Cooking: proficiency with medium and heavy armor, shields, and martial weapons, and temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus at the start of each turn. Fast Food: proficiency with medium armor and Extra Attack. Patissier: learn two spells of any list (cantrips or levels you can cast), not counted against spells known; once per long rest when you finish a short rest, spend a Bardic Inspiration and recover spell slots totaling up to the roll (none 6th level or higher).

When a creature that can hear you rolls one of your Bardic Inspiration dice or eats one of your Petit Fours, it can immediately use its reaction to make one weapon attack or move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks (eating a Petit Four can be part of that same action).

As a bonus action, mark a creature you can see within 90 feet for 1 hour: +1d6 damage on your weapon hits against it and advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks to find it. Marking a new creature ends the old mark.

No action: learn either the saving throw and skill proficiencies or the damage resistances, immunities, vulnerabilities, and condition immunities of a creature you can see within 120 feet. Your next weapon hit against it within 1 minute deals maximum damage.

Reaction, uses equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) per short or long rest. Kill: when another creature hits your marked prey, it deals the Mark Prey extra damage. Retreat: when your marked prey attacks a creature you can see within 60 feet, that creature can use its reaction to move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks before the attack.
Mark Prey damage rises to 2d6, and to 3d6 at 14th level.

As a bonus action, your marked prey within 120 feet makes a Wisdom save or suffers Chase or Avoid (your choice) for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns; a success makes it immune for 24 hours. Chase: disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you, and a Wisdom save the first time it tries to move more than 30 feet from you on a turn or it can't. Avoid: disadvantage on attacks against you, and a Wisdom save the first time it tries to move within 30 feet of you on a turn or it can't move closer. Suppressed while you can't see it.
Proficiency with thieves' tools and double proficiency bonus when using them to disarm or manipulate traps.

After a short or long rest, augment one weapon or up to 20 pieces of ammunition with acid, cold, fire, or lightning until your next rest. Once per turn on a hit with it, deal 1d8 extra damage of that type. At 11th level, augment a second weapon or 20 more ammunition, and the damage becomes 2d8.

You learn traps at 3rd, 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level (see Ranger Traps). Physical traps take 1 hour and trap-making materials; magical traps are made after a long rest, up to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), some costing spell slots, and expire at your next long rest. As an action, throw a trap to a space within 30 feet; it arms at the start of your next turn and is visible unless you spend 1 minute concealing it (Wisdom (Perception) against your ranger save DC to find). Magical traps trigger on a creature of a chosen size within up to 30 feet, or with your bonus action or reaction within 150 feet. Creatures can disarm with Dexterity (thieves' tools) or spellcasting ability (Arcana) against your DC; failing triggers it with disadvantage on the save. Trap spell effects need no concentration, and magical traps must be 40 feet apart.

3rd: Bear Trap (physical, 4 gp: Dexterity save or 2d8 piercing and speed 0), Tanglevine (1st-level slot: entangle in 20 feet), Snare Trap (physical, 2 gp: Strength save or prone and speed 0), Solestriker (1st-level slot: spike growth in 20 feet). 5th: Immolation (2nd: 6d6 fire, Dexterity half, 20 feet), Miasma (2nd: gas cloud 20 feet for 1 minute, Constitution save or 3d6 poison and poisoned), Soulbind (2nd: Charisma save or soulbound as preserve and can't be invisible), Pit Trap (physical, 2 gp: 7-foot pit, Dexterity save or fall in, 4d8 piercing if spiked). 9th: Bewilderment (3rd: Wisdom save or 3d10 psychic and confusion), Net Trap (physical, 10 gp: 20-foot square, Dexterity save or restrained and hoisted 20 feet), Thunder Charge (3rd: 30 feet, Constitution save or 8d6 thunder and deafened). 13th: Catapult Trap (physical, 15 gp: Dexterity save or flung 60 feet, 6d10 bludgeoning), Infection (4th: Constitution save or a contagion disease), Snapfrost (4th: 20 feet for 1 minute, Constitution save or 6d6 cold, half speed, no reactions). 17th: Banisher (5th: 10 feet, Charisma save or sent to a harmless demiplane for 1 minute), Gravity Well (5th: 30 feet of difficult terrain, Dexterity save or prone, concentration checks, 2d8 force pulls each turn, then a Strength save for 6d8 force, prone, and pulled to the center, or half).
Add your proficiency bonus to checks to find or follow tracks even if not proficient; double it if you are.

Against a trap's activation effect that allows a save for half damage, you take none on a success and half on a failure, and traps' attack rolls against you have disadvantage. Doesn't apply to ongoing effects.

When you deploy a trap, expend a spell slot of 1st level or higher to make it invisible as it leaves your hand; creatures don't see where it lands and have disadvantage on saves against physical traps. You learn invisibility (a ranger spell for you, not counted against spells known) and can cast it once per short or long rest without a slot.

After a long rest, choose one effect until your next long rest; its 0 hit point trigger works once per long rest. Defibrillate: once per turn when hit by a melee attack, the attacker can't take reactions until its next turn and you move 10 feet without provoking; at 0 hit points, drop to 1 and take an extra turn, then fall to 0 if not healed. Dissolve: once per turn a melee attacker within 5 feet takes 1d6 acid (natural weapons or spell attacks) or its nonmagical ferrous weapon is destroyed if the attack hit; at 0 hit points, creatures within 10 feet make a Dexterity save or take 10d4 acid and 5d4 each turn until they wipe it off. Entomb: once per turn a melee attacker within 5 feet takes 1d4 cold and loses 15 feet of speed; at 0 hit points you are encased in ice (AC 15, 100 hp) giving total cover and no death saves for 1 minute. Self-Destruct: once per turn a melee attacker within 5 feet takes 1d8 fire and you take 1; at 0 hit points you fail one death save and creatures within 20 feet make a Dexterity save, 14d6 fire or half.

Spells known at sorcerer levels (not counted against spells known): 1st chameleon skin, inflict wounds; 3rd barkskin, protection from poison; 5th vampiric touch, zippit!; 7th freedom of movement, frogskin; 9th feverskin, greater restoration. On gaining a level you can swap one for a biomancy or transmutation spell of the same level from the sorcerer, warlock, or wizard list.

After casting a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, roll a d20; if it is at or under a third of your sorcerer level (minimum 1), roll on the Skinshift Adaptations table for an effect until the end of your next turn (spend 1 sorcery point to extend it to 10 minutes). Results range from drawbacks (1 to 7: vulnerabilities, a left foot, the wobbles, sunlight sensitivity, disadvantage on attacks) through utility (8 to 16: shrink, light, alter self, natural weapon, jumping, swimming, tentacle reach, growth, flight) to strong boons (17 to 30: elemental and physical resistances, temporary hit points, extra attack, empowered strikes, shimmerskin, secreted toxin, +2 AC, relentless metabolism, salamander skin, fortified metabolism, reflective carapace). Skin and metabolism adaptations don't stack within their group. From 6th level, add up to half your sorcerer level to the table roll.
As a bonus action, spend sorcery points to transform for 10 minutes, choosing one adaptation per point from entries numbered up to 20 + half your sorcerer level.
Immediately after taking damage, use your reaction and 1 sorcery point to gain resistance to that damage type for 10 minutes or until you use this again.

As a bonus action once per long rest, transform for 10 minutes: grapples and restraints on you end, you gain six adaptations of your choice ignoring stacking limits, and immediately after taking damage you gain resistance to that type (up to three at once, oldest replaced). Reactive Mutations and Selective Shift are unavailable and end.

As a bonus action, manifest a parasitic weapon. When you take the Attack action you can make a melee spell attack with it, reach 5 times your proficiency bonus in feet, dealing 1d12 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing (chosen on manifesting) with no ability modifier. Attacks rise to two at 5th level, three at 11th, and four at 17th (Extra Attack attacks replace these), and count as magical from 6th level. It can't make opportunity attacks and retracts if you are incapacitated or dismiss it as a bonus action.

Use your Charisma modifier for Strength saves. As a bonus action, manifest a shield in your free hand that you are proficient with (+3 AC instead of +2 from 10th level) until dismissed or you are incapacitated.
As a bonus action once per short or long rest, become liquid for 10 minutes: squeeze through 6-inch gaps and ignore extra movement cost from difficult terrain. Equipment falls or merges, your choice.

Over 1 minute once per short or long rest, extrude a parasitic ooze that acts as your familiar (as find familiar; counts for Pact of the Chain). Tiny ooze: AC 8 + PB, hit points 5 + three times your warlock level, speed and climb 5 + 5 x PB feet, blindsight 60 feet, resistance to necrotic, Amorphous, False Appearance, Spider Climb; Pseudopod uses your spell attack modifier for 1d6 + PB bludgeoning. A new one dissolves the old.

As a bonus action, command your ooze. Detonate Ooze: it moves and explodes; creatures within 10 feet make a Dexterity save, 4d6 necrotic and blinded until the end of your next turn, or half. Symbiote's Ward: it attaches to a willing creature, letting you speak telepathically and taking damage in its place until you detach it as a bonus action.

As an action once per short or long rest, for 1 minute: grow one size, gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier at the start of each turn, parasitic weapon damage becomes 2d8 and crits on 19 or 20, and when a creature within its reach damages you, you can attack it with your reaction. Optional invocation Parasitic Leech (Parasite patron): crits or kills with the parasitic weapon grant temporary hit points equal to the damage dice rolled.

When you rage, pick a concoction (change each rage). Combat: rubbery body; reaction to reduce a ranged hit's damage by 1d12 + Constitution modifier + barbarian level, and a bonus action before a melee attack to stretch your reach 5 feet for the turn (first hit +1d6 weapon damage). Utility: as a bonus action, swallow an object that fits in your mouth (destroying it if nonmagical) and optionally spend a Hit Die to heal (die + Constitution modifier), proficiency bonus times per long rest. Whimsy: at the start of each turn, either teleport 10 feet, take 1d4 necrotic to add that number to your next check this turn, or Help as a bonus action; plus a harmless visual quirk.
You learn Prestidigitation and Thaumaturgy.
Choose a common potion; once per long rest activate its effects as a bonus action (save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier). Swap it on gaining a level.
After a long rest choose blinded, charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, or stunned; you have advantage on saves against it until you choose another.
Quick Brew gains another common potion and one uncommon potion (each once per long rest).

Craft two theater masks (one more at 7th, 11th, and 15th level; swap one each time). Don or swap a mask as an action or bonus action and gain its abilities (save DCs use your spell save DC). Fish: swim speed, water breathing, Water Bullet and Whelm Weapon. Fox: move through hostile spaces, +1 AC, reaction for advantage on a Dexterity save. Old Man: Detect Magic and Identify at will. Protagonist: temporary hit points on initiative, mark an antagonist (advantage on checks involving it; reaction and Bardic Inspiration to reduce its attack roll). Sea Urchin: Bardic Inspiration bonus action heal, and a restraining toxin (Constitution save) proficiency bonus times per long rest. Stone: Athletics proficiency, -2 nonmagical weapon damage, advantage against being moved or knocked prone. 7th level: Demon (sense a creature's or object's past presence, see through walls 15 feet), Golem (+1d8 weapon damage, double damage to objects), Spirit (Speak with Dead, step through the Spirit Realm with Bardic Inspiration). 11th level: Harpy (fly 30 feet, psychic resistance).

As an action, spend a Bardic Inspiration to cast Alter Self (Change Appearance) as a humanoid you've seen, without concentration, gaining 5 temporary hit points (it ends if they're lost) and nonmagical copies of that person's visible gear.
Once per long rest, a 1-minute performance targets up to your bard level creatures within 60 feet that hear you: Wisdom save or charmed, frightened, or unconscious (your choice).
Once per short or long rest, as an action lend one of your masks to an ally within 5 feet for 1 minute.

As a bonus action, spend a Wild Shape use to wrap yourself in a petal cloud for 1 hour: +1 AC; a bonus action ranged spell attack within 30 feet for 1d6 slashing (2d6 at 5th, 3d6 at 11th, 4d6 at 17th); and a reaction to reduce damage to you or a creature within 10 feet by your druid level + Wisdom modifier, which disperses the cloud.

As an action, summon a petal bestial spirit within 30 feet (CR 1 stat block: hit points three times your druid level, your spell attack modifier, fly 20 feet with hover, moves through creatures). It acts on your turn, only Dashing or Attacking (Chomp 2d6 + 2 piercing and DC 14 Strength save or prone). At 0 it bursts, giving Faerie Fire in 20 feet until the end of your next turn; otherwise it lasts 1 minute. Two uses per long rest (three at 11th, four at 16th); from 11th you can spend two uses to summon two.

Advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to find a path or creature. Once per long rest as an action, raise an impassable petal wall 1 foot thick, 15 feet tall, and up to 60 feet long that only creatures you designate can cross, immune to damage, lasting minutes equal to your druid level.

Once per long rest when reduced to 0 hit points, you instead regain half your hit points, and can use your reaction so creatures within 10 feet make a Strength save or are pushed 15 feet and take 2d8 slashing.
Choose harmless quirks from your fused spirit, such as First Age gadgets glitching, coughing bubbles, or floating when unconscious.
You have four essence dice (d6), regained on a short or long rest: add one to a weapon attack roll or its damage, before or after rolling. 5 dice at 7th level, 6 at 10th, 7 at 15th, 8 at 18th.

Learn one channeling option and use it once per short or long rest; proficiency in the Salvage skill. Options: Ballooning Bag (float 30 feet up, or Feather Fall as a reaction), Entangling Cord (replace an attack with a ranged Constitution-based pull of 15 feet), Find the Thing (Locate Object without concentration, 1 hour, 1 mile), First Age Steed (summon a bonded 60-foot vehicle for 1 hour), Goggled Vision (darkvision 60 feet and advantage to spot illusions for 1 hour), Leaping Sneakers (Jump for 1 hour), Pocket Voice (speak through an object for 1 hour), Water Jettison (bonus action spray: move 10 feet back and Disengage).
You learn Jolt (Constitution-based; powers a machine for 1 hour). Once per turn, replace a weapon hit's damage dice with Jolt's lightning dice. You count as a spirit.
Learn a second channeling option; use Object Channeling proficiency bonus times per short or long rest.
When hit by an attack, use your reaction to roll an essence die and add it to your AC against that attack.
One more use of Second Wind, and when your hit points drop below your fighter level you can spend a Second Wind immediately (no action).
Learn another channeling option, and when you roll initiative with no Object Channeling uses left, regain two.

As a bonus action, spend ki to move a willing creature you can see within 60 feet without provoking opportunity attacks: 15 feet per ki point toward you or 10 feet per point in another direction, up to its speed. Two creatures at 5th level, three at 10th, four at 15th.
Replace an unarmed strike with a 60-foot ranged blast of air using your unarmed strike's bonus and damage; on a hit, spend 1 ki to force a Strength save or knock it prone or push it 10 feet.
When an ally within 10 feet is hit, use your reaction and 1 ki to reduce the damage by a Martial Arts die + Dexterity modifier.
Step of the Wind also gives a flying speed equal to your walking speed until the end of your turn, and grants both Disengage and Dash.
When you use Patient Defense, spend 1 more ki so allies within 30 feet that can see or hear you can use their reactions to gain the Dodge action's benefits until the start of your next turn.
The River Flows On; The River Quenches or Drowns; The River Rages; The River Seeks the Sea, Always.

The area within 10 feet of you (30 feet at 18th level) is difficult terrain for creatures you don't exempt. The first time each turn you hit a Large or smaller creature with a melee attack, you can move it up to 10 feet.
When you make a Dexterity save, use your reaction to halve the damage; expend a spell slot to extend this to a number of creatures within 10 feet equal to the slot level.

As a bonus action for 1 minute: swim speed 60 feet and +15 feet walking speed, advantage on all saves, and creatures you move with your aura can take 2d8 bludgeoning. Once per long rest, or again with a 5th-level slot.

Taking damage grants a curse marker (two on a critical hit), lasting until the end of your next turn, up to a maximum of 2 (3 at 5th level, 4 at 11th, 5 at 17th). Your next weapon hit consumes them for 1d4 necrotic each. As a bonus action you can fill to your maximum.
Replace the result of a Strength or Dexterity check with 10 + your ranger level, deciding after the roll but before the outcome. Half your proficiency bonus (round up) uses per long rest.
Once per turn, spend a curse marker to add 1d4 to a weapon attack roll. Once per short or long rest, use your reaction to reduce damage you take by your ranger level.

Choose an ailment. Graying Vision: blindsight 15 feet and automatically see through illusions whose Investigation DC is at most your spell save DC. Failing Lungs: as an action steal a creature's breath (it falls prone, no reactions, and takes your curse markers as 1d4 necrotic each), or as a reaction give a creature advantage on a Dexterity save and +15 feet speed. Losing Feeling: as a bonus action wreathe a creature within 60 feet in cold flame so your curse markers deal 1d6 to it instead of 1d4. Once per short or long rest.

As a bonus action until the start of your next turn: double walking speed, +2 AC, two extra attacks with the Attack action, and attacks treated as having maximum curse markers. Free once per long rest; a second use also gives a level of exhaustion and drops you to 1 hit point.
You learn Dancing Lights (as floating candles) and Produce Flame.

You have 3 wick points (+1 per rogue level), regained on a short or long rest, and learn three enchantments (two more at 5th, 10th, and 15th; swap one each time). Save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Intelligence or Charisma modifier. Options include Blooming Light (anti-divination light, 1), Bocha Glue Wax (bind two objects, 1), Candle Pop (bonus action Dexterity save or restrained in wax, 2), Delicacy (healing candle 1d6, 1), Fish Fat Candle (20-foot smoke cloud, 1), Flooding Abundance (15-foot square of flammable difficult-terrain wax, 2), Iron Seal (magically lock a lid or door, 1), Lost Wax Carving (Duplicate an object, 2), Maker's Mark (signet-ring strike 1d4 + Dex plus 1d6 fire with the Attack action, 1), Shielding Seal (5 to 15 temporary hit points, 1+), Spark Shower (advantage on your next attack and no opportunity attacks from the target, 2), Waxlings (candle familiars, 2), Wick Whip (finesse reach whip dealing 3d4 fire for 1 minute, 3); 5th level: Burning Delay and Detonate (20-foot burst 2d6 fire plus 2d8 thunder, 3+); 10th level: Consuming Flame (reaction Counterspell that can store a level 3 or lower spell, 3).
When you deal Sneak Attack damage, spend wick points for 1d6 extra fire each, up to 4d6.

Enchantments improve: Blooming Light lasts 8 hours, Burning Delay has more intervals, Candle Pop also affects creatures within 5 feet of the target, Delicacy heals 1d12 with up to four candles, Maker's Mark is unlimited per turn, three Shielding Seals at once, and two Waxlings for 3 points.

Once per long rest as a bonus action, light a pink candle for 1 minute: enchantments cost 1 fewer wick point, immunity to fire damage, and spirits have disadvantage on attacks against you (falling prone risks a DC 15 Dexterity save to keep it lit).

Oni traits manifest by how many sorcery points you are missing (lost again as you regain them), each lasting until a long rest: 0 to 1 Eyes, 2 to 4 Horns, 5 to 9 Skin, 10 to 14 Tongue, 15+ Hair. Eyes: as an action, advantage on Charisma checks against one non-hostile creature for 1 minute (it may realize afterward on a Wisdom save and turn hostile). Horns: channel attack cantrips through a horn melee spell attack for +1d6 piercing, and use your reaction to cast such a cantrip instead of an opportunity attack. Skin: casting a 1st-level or higher spell heals you by its level + Constitution modifier. Tongue: when a verbal spell targets one creature, a bonus action forces a Wisdom save or it uses its reaction to flee half its speed or falls prone. Hair: +2 AC.
Once per long rest as a bonus action, manifest one oni trait early for 1 minute.

Eyes: cast a single-target Zone of Truth without a slot while it can see your eyes. Horns: +1d12 instead. Skin: heal twice the spell's level + Constitution modifier. Tongue: with a 5th-level or higher slot, the target's passive Perception becomes 5 and it takes -5 AC against others' attacks until your next turn.

As an action, manifest all oni traits for 1 minute, with resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing and immunity to charm and fear. Once per long rest, or again for 5 sorcery points.

Your patron dwells in a lantern you can use as a spellcasting focus. Once per short or long rest as a bonus action, light it for 1 minute (bright 20 feet, dim 20 more): use your reaction to add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to a save made in its bright light, and hostile creatures in its dim light that fail a save take radiant damage equal to half your warlock level (round up).
Once per short or long rest as an action, a maroon light (bright 10 feet, dim 10 more) makes invisible creatures and objects in its bright light visible for 1 hour.

Illuminating Aura persists if you let go. Once per long rest (or by expending a warlock slot) control the lantern for 1 minute as a Spiritual Weapon of 2nd level (4th at 10th, 6th at 15th) while it remains your focus.
As an action, use a light source you can see or know as a Clairvoyance sensor for 10 minutes (once per light source per long rest).

Once per short or long rest while Illuminating Aura is active, as an action, creatures in its bright or dim light make a Constitution save: 2d8 + warlock level radiant and blinded until the end of your next turn, or half.
Activate Illuminating Aura at will. Once per long rest, the lantern casts Find the Path to a place you know.

As a bonus action, proficiency bonus times per long rest, fold an origami construct bound to you or a creature within 60 feet for hours equal to half your wizard level (AC your spell save DC, destroyed by any damage). Bird: Perception proficiency and +2 slashing on ranged hits. Cat: Stealth proficiency, and once per turn after your melee weapon hit it attacks for 1d6 slashing (1d8 at 5th, 1d10 at 11th, 1d12 at 17th). Crab: +1 AC and Athletics proficiency (one at a time).
