actions.description: The jester performs an ancient, nihilistic joke of necromantic power. This joke has no effect on undead or constructs. All other creatures within 60 feet of the jester must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. Those that fail fall prone in a fit of deadly laughter. The laughter lasts 1d4 rounds, during which time the victim is incapacitated and unable to stand up from prone. At the end of its turn each round, an incapacitated victim must make a successful DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be reduced to 0 hit points. The laughter can be ended early by rendering the victim unconscious or with greater restoration or comparable magic.

reactions.name: Ridicule Hope
reactions.description: When a spell that restores hit points is cast within 60 feet of the jester, the jester can cause that spell to inflict damage instead of curing it. The damage equals the hit points the spell would have cured.

display.languages: Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Gnomish, telepathy 120 ft.
display.damageImmunities: necrotic, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Last Laugh
traits.description: Unless it is destroyed in a manner amusing to the god of death that created it, the grim jester gains a new body in 1d20 days, regaining all its hp and becoming active again. The new body appears in a place of the god’s choosing.

traits.name: Mock the Dying
traits.description: Death saving throws made within 60 feet of the grim jester have disadvantage.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.description: The grim jester has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.description: The grim jester doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Necrotic Claw
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +9 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Killing Joke
actions.description: The grim jester tells an ancient, nihilistic joke to one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or fall prone in a fit of laughter, becoming incapacitated and unable to stand up for 1 minute. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is reduced to 0 hp instead. The incapacitated target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 14 (4d6) necrotic damage on a failed save or ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The grim jester casts one of the following spells, requiring no components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- At Will: disguise self, grease
- 3/Day Each: magic mouth (as an action), mirror image
- 1/Day Each: mislead, seeming

bonusActions.name: Joker's Shuffle
bonusActions.description: The grim jester exchanges locations with a Medium or smaller creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The jester and target each teleport to the other's space, and each becomes covered in a magical illusion to look and sound like the other. A creature must take an action to visually inspect an illusion and succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the jester and target are disguised. The illusions last for 1 minute, until the jester dies, or until the jester dismisses them as a bonus action.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The grimalkin has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) slashing damage. If the grimalkin moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target makes a DC 12 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Opportune Bite
bonusActions.description: The grimalkin makes a bite attack against a prone creature.

bonusActions.name: Shapeshift
bonusActions.description: The grimalkin changes its form to a Tiny cat or into its true form, which resembles a panther. While shapeshifted, its statistics are unchanged except for its size. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.description: The grimlock has advantage on Stealth checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The grimlock has advantage on Perception checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Spiked Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Throttle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 12) and can't breathe. Until this grapple ends  the grimlock can't use any attack other than throttle and only against the grappled target  and it makes this attack with advantage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Heightened Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The grimlock's Perception is 16 when perceiving by hearing or smell.

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.description: The grimlock's Stealth is 18 while in rocky terrain.

traits.name: Suppressed Senses
traits.description: The grimlock can't use its keensense while deafened and unable to smell.

actions.name: Spiked Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Strange Bauble
bonusActions.description:
The grimlock reaches into a pocket, pulls out a small object, and throws it at a creature the grimlock can sense within 30 feet. The grimlock chooses one of the following objects:
- Flashing Rock. The grimlock throws a warm, scintillating rock at the target that bursts with a myriad of colors. The target must succeed on a DC 11 DEX save or be blinded until the end of its next turn.
- Illusory Dancer. The grimlock throws a small disk that emits a blurry, fractured illusion of a graceful, humanoid dancer. The target must succeed on a DC 11 CHA save or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn as it is mesmerized by the dance.
- Whirling Death. The grimlock throws a small, bladed gear that grows larger and larger as it travels toward the target, threatening to slice the target into pieces. The target must succeed on a DC 11 WIS save or be frightened until the end of its next turn. On a success, the target realizes the gear's growth was a magical, illusory effect and that the gear never increased in size.

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.description: The grimlock has advantage on Stealth checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The grimlock has advantage on Perception checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Lightning Stick
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) lightning damage.

actions.name: Throttle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 12) and can't breathe. Until this grapple ends  the grimlock can't use any attack other than throttle and only against the grappled target  and it makes this attack with advantage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Silenced Blunderbuss
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage. The blunderbuss fires with a cloud of smoke and a quiet pop that can be heard from 30 feet away. It requires an action to reload the blunderbuss.

actions.name: Smoke Bomb
actions.description: The grimlock throws a vial at a point up to 20 feet away. The area within 30 feet of that point is heavily obscured for 1 minute or until cleared by a strong wind.

display.languages: understands Void Speech but can't speak
display.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
display.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, petrified, poisoned, prone, stunned

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
traits.description:
The grimmlet’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
At will: crushing curse, minor illusion
3/day each: maddening whispers

traits.name: Reproduce
traits.description: When a grimmlet takes damage from a spell and isn’t reduced to 0 hp, a number of new grimmlets equal to the spell’s level appear in unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of the grimmlet. If the spell is a cantrip, only one grimmlet is created. Sixteen or more grimmlets within 30 feet of each other can use their reactions to come together and form a grimmlet swarm in a space within 5 feet of one grimmlet.

traits.name: Self-destruct
traits.description: When the grimmlet dies, it explodes in a spray of Void-infused crystal shards. Each creature within 5 feet of the grimmlet must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 3 (1d6) slashing damage and 3 (1d6) psychic damage. Grimmlets damaged by this trait don’t Reproduce.

actions.name: Crystal Edge
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) psychic damage.

display.languages: understands Void Speech but can't speak
display.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Enervating Maelstrom
traits.description: When the grimmlet swarm dies, it explodes in a plume of ennui. Each creature within 20 feet of the grimmlet swarm must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage and suffers one level of exhaustion. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn’t suffer exhaustion. Grimmlets damaged by this trait don’t Reproduce.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
traits.description:
The grimmlet swarm’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
At will: maddening whispers, crushing curse, minor illusion
3/day each: hypnotic pattern, void strike, major image
1/day each: hallucinatory terrain

traits.name: Maze of Edges
traits.description: A creature that attempts to move out of or through the grimmlet swarm must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) slashing damage.

traits.name: Reproduce
traits.description: When a grimmlet swarm takes damage from a spell and isn’t reduced to 0 hp, a number of new grimmlets equal to the spell’s level appear in unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of the grimmlet swarm. If the spell is a cantrip, only one grimmlet is created. New grimmlets aren’t subsumed into the swarm. Sixteen or more new grimmlets within 30 feet of each other can use their reactions to come together and form a new grimmlet swarm in a space within 5 feet of one grimmlet.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The grimmlet swarm can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny grimmlet. The swarm can’t regain hp or gain temporary hp.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The grimmlet swarm makes two attacks with its crystal edges.

actions.name: Crystal Edges
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 18 (4d8) slashing damage, or 9 (2d8) slashing damage if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer. The target must make a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: The grindylow can mimic humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check.

traits.name: Slippery
traits.description: The grindylow has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.description: The grindylow can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The grindylow makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the grindylow can't use its claws on another target.

actions.name: Ink Cloud
actions.description:
A 20-foot-radius cloud of ink extends all around the grindylow if it is underwater. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink.

After releasing the ink, the grindylow can use the Dash action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Cheek Worm Regrowth
traits.description: Has twenty worms stored in its cheeks. Used worms regrow when the grivid finishes a long rest.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.description: Advantage: sight Wis (Percept) checks.

traits.name: Parasitic Cheek Worm
traits.description: Produces parasitic worms in its cheeks and it expels these worms into other creatures when it attacks. Worm burrows into target's flesh and that creature is poisoned while infested with at least one worm. At start of each of infested creature’s turns it takes 5 (2d4) poison. Any creature can take an action to remove one worm with successful DC 12 Wis (Medicine) check. An effect that cures disease removes and kills one worm infesting the creature. When grivid dies all worms currently infesting creatures die ending infestation in all infested creatures.

traits.name: Worm Regeneration
traits.description: If it has at least 1 hp grivid regains 5 hp for each worm infesting another creature at start of its turn.

bonusActions.name: Consume Worms
bonusActions.description: Consumes up to 3 cheek worms regaining 5 (2d4) hp for each worm consumed.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: Advantage: smell Wis (Percept) checks.

traits.name: Dismembering Strike
traits.description: If it scores a critical hit vs. stunned creature tears off one of creature’s limbs. Creature is immune to this if it is immune to slashing.

traits.name: Forest and Snow Camouflage
traits.description: Advantage: Dex (Stealth) checks to hide in forest terrain if fur is brown and snowy terrain if fur is white.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: Advantage: smell Wis (Percept) checks.

bonusActions.name: Versatile Coat
bonusActions.description: White fur white to brown vice versa.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.description: The bear has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the bear can't use its claws on another target.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8+1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

reactions.name: Protector's Parry
reactions.description: When a friendly creature the guard can see within 5 feet of it is the target of an attack, the guard can interpose its weapon between the creature and the attacker. The friendly creature adds 2 to its AC against that attack. To use this reaction, the guard must be able to see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

traits.name: Area Vulnerability
traits.description: The squad takes double damage from any effect that targets an area.

traits.name: Squad
traits.description: The squad is composed of 5 or more guards. If it is subjected to a spell, attack, or other effect that affects only one target, it takes any damage but ignores other effects. It can share its space with Medium or smaller creatures or objects. The squad can move through any opening large enough for one Medium creature without squeezing.

traits.name: Squad Dispersal
traits.description: When the squad is reduced to 0 hit points, it turns into 2 (1d4) guards with 5 hit points each.

actions.name: Spears
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 feet  one target. Hit: 17 (5d6) piercing damage  or half damage if the squad is bloodied.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: The shadow fey guardian has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can’t put it to sleep.

traits.name: Shadow’s Vigil
traits.description: The guardian has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks, and magical darkness doesn’t impede the guardian’s darkvision.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the shadow fey has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shadow fey guardian makes two Pike or Javelin attacks.

actions.name: Pike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Traveler
bonusActions.description: While in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the shadow fey disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A tendril of inky smoke appears at the origin and destination when it uses this bonus action.

reactions.name: Protective Interference
reactions.description: When a friendly creature the shadow fey guardian can see within 5 feet of it is the target of an attack, the guardian can impose disadvantage on the attack roll. To do so, the guardian must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The naga can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Forbiddance
traits.description: The nagas lair is under the forbiddance spell. Until it is dispelled, creatures in the lair can't teleport or use planar travel. Fiends and undead that are not the nagas allies take 27 (5d10) radiant damage when they enter or start their turn in the lair.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: If it dies, the naga gains a new body in 1d6 days, regaining all its hit points. This trait can be removed with a wish spell.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description:
The naga is an 11th level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 16). The naga has the following cleric spells prepared which it can cast with only vocalized components:

- Cantrips (at will): Mending, Thaumaturgy
- 1st-Level (4 slots): Command, Cure Wounds
- 2nd-Level (3 slots): Calm Emotions, Hold Person
- 3rd-Level (3 slots) Clairvoyance, Create Food and Water
- 4th-Level (3 slots): Divination, freedom of movement
- 5th-Level (2 slots): Flame Strike, Geas
- 6th-Level (1 slot): forbiddance

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw  taking 35 (10d6) poison damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Spit Poison
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: The target makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw  taking 35 (10d6) poison damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Command
actions.description: (1st-Level; V) One living creature within 60 feet that the naga can see and that can hear and understand it makes a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target uses its next turn to move as far from the naga as possible  avoiding hazardous terrain.

actions.name: Hold Person
actions.description: (2nd-Level; V, Concentration) One humanoid the naga can see within 60 feet makes a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Flame Strike
actions.description: (5th-Level; V) A column of divine flame fills a 10-foot-radius  40-foot-high cylinder within 60 feet. Creatures in the area make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw  taking 14 (4d6) fire damage and 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

bonusActions.name: Shapeshift
bonusActions.description: The naga changes its form to that of a specific Medium humanoid, a Medium snake-human hybrid with the lower body of a snake, or its true form, which is a Large snake. While shapeshifted, its statistics are unchanged except for its size. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Divine Strikes
traits.description: The naga's weapon attacks are magical. When the naga hits with any weapon attack, the weapon deals an extra 3d8 necrotic damage or radiant damage (included in the attack), the naga's choice.

traits.name: Monstrosity Resilience
traits.description: The naga is resistant to exhaustion and to the frightened condition.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days, regaining all its HP and becoming active again. Only a wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The guardian naga makes three Slam or Spit Poison attacks, or it makes one Constrict attack and two Slam attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage or radiant damage (the naga's choice), and the target is grappled (escape DC 16) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the naga can't Constrict another target.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage or radiant damage (the naga's choice).

actions.name: Spit Poison
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) poison damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage or radiant damage (the naga's choice).

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The guardian naga casts one of the following spells, requiring only verbal components and using WIS as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16).

- At Will: augury (as an action), command, mending, thaumaturgy
- 3/Day Each: bestow curse, cure wounds
- 2/Day Each: freedom of movement, hold1/day: geas (as an action)

bonusActions.name: Protector's Step
bonusActions.description: The naga magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space within the sacred site or temple it protects or within 30 feet of the exterior of such a site. Swirls of golden light or tendrils of inky shadow (the naga's choice) appear at the origin and destination when it uses this bonus action.

traits.name: Towering Strength
traits.description: A gug can lift items up to 4,000 pounds as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gug makes two slam attacks, two stomp attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If a creature is hit by this attack twice in the same turn, the target must make a successful DC 19 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.description: The gug moves up to half its speed.

legendaryActions.name: Attack
legendaryActions.description: The gug makes one slam or stomp attack.

legendaryActions.name: Grab
legendaryActions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: the target is grappled (escape DC 17).

legendaryActions.name: Swallow
legendaryActions.description: The gug swallows one creature it has grappled. The creature takes 26 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage immediately plus 13 (2d12) acid damage at the start of each of the gug's turns. A swallowed creature is no longer grappled but is blinded and restrained, and has total cover against attacks and other effects from outside the gug. If the gug takes 75 points of damage in a single turn, the swallowed creature is expelled and falls prone next to the gug. When the gug dies, a swallowed creature can crawl from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement.

legendaryActions.name: Throw
legendaryActions.description: The gug throws one creature it has grappled. The creature is thrown a distance of 2d4 times 10 feet in the direction the gug chooses, and takes 20 (2d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage (plus falling damage if they are thrown into a chasm or off a cliff). A gug can throw a creature up to Large size. Small creatures are thrown twice as far, but the damage is the same.

traits.name: Towering Strength
traits.description: The gug is considered to be a Gargantuan giant for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gug makes two four Grasping Claw attacks, or it makes two Grasping Claw attacks and two Stomp attacks. It can replace one Grasping Claw attack with a use of Fling or Swallow.

actions.name: Grasping Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17) if it is a Large or smaller creature. The gug has four Grasping Claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Fling
actions.description: One Large or smaller object held or creature grappled by the gug is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The gug makes one Grasping Claw attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the gug, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the gug's turns. A gug can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

display.speed: 60 ft., Climb 30 ft., Fly 80 ft., Swim 30 ft.
display.languages: understands all but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.
display.damageImmunities: fire, radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: Gugalanna doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Gugalanna has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: Gugalanna's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.description: If Gugalanna moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a horns attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, Gugalanna can make one kick attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Blazing Sun Disc (Costs 2 Actions, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The sun disc floating between Gugalanna's horns flares. Each creature within 30 feet of Gugalanna must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Gugalanna makes two attacks: one with its horns and one with its kick.

actions.name: Rearing Stomp (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.description: Gugalanna spreads his wings and stomps his hooves, shaking the earth. Each creature within 10 feet of Gugalanna must make a DC 22 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 18 (2d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage and is pushed 20 feet away from Gugalanna. On a success, a target takes half the damage and isn't pushed. Gugalanna can then fly up to half his flying speed.

actions.name: Horns
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 34 (5d10 + 7) piercing damage and 14 (4d6) fire damage.

legendaryActions.name: Kick
legendaryActions.description: Gugalanna makes a kick attack.

legendaryActions.name: Rearing Stomp

traits.name: Detachable Head
traits.description:
As a bonus action, the hantu penanggal detaches its head. The head trails entrails like flexible tentacles. While detached, the head and body act independently from each other on the same initiative, and each has hp equal to half its hp before detaching its head. Its statistics remain the same in both forms, except the body loses its truesight and gains blindsight out to a range of 60 feet.

The head and body can use the whole form’s innate spellcasting trait, expending daily uses as normal. The two forms can rejoin into the fiend’s whole form as a bonus action if they are within 5 feet of each other. If the head is destroyed while it is detached, the body also perishes. If the body is destroyed while the head is detached, the head has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until it acquires a new body. A creature within 30 feet of the penanggal and that can see the detachment must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way becomes the new body for the penanggal, if it is detached and its body died. Otherwise, the humanoid rises 24 hours later as a new hantu penanggal.

On each of its turns, the creature moves towards the harpy by the most direct route, not avoiding opportunity attacks or hazards. The eye can be noticed with a successful DC 18 Wisdom (Perception) check and can be dispelled as if it were 3rd-level spell. Spells that block other scrying spells work against Sepulchral Scrying as well. Unless dismissed by its creator or dispelled, lasts for up to 12 hours after its creation; only one can be created per 24-hour period.

While projecting its senses through the sensor, it can see, hear, telepathically communicate, and cast spells as if it was in the sensor's space, and it is blinded and deafened with regard to its own senses. The sensor can be dispelled (DC 14).

traits.name: Ancestral Spirits

Each uses the giant's AC and saving throws, has 15 hp and can only be harmed by radiant damage. If an ancestral spirit is reduced to 0 hp, it disappears temporarily. Reduce the giant's AC by 1 and remove one trait granted by the spirits for each spirit that is driven off. Ancestral spirits can't be turned.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.description: At the start of its turn, the giant can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn. This trait is granted by the ancestral spirits.

traits.name: Steadfast

traits.name: Dream Eating
traits.description:
As a bonus action, the heggarna can attach its lamprey-like maw to a sleeping creature. The target’s Charisma score is reduced by 1d4 when the heggarna first attaches to it. The target’s Charisma score is then reduced by 1 for each hour the heggarna stays attached. The target dies if this reduces its Charisma to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest at least 24 hours after the heggarna reduced its Charisma.

While attached, the heggarna fills the target’s dreams with nightmares. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or it doesn’t gain any benefit from its current rest. If the target succeeds on the saving throw by 5 or more, it immediately awakens.

The heggarna can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. It does so after it reduces the target’s Charisma by 8 or if the target dies.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Dream Rift
actions.description: The heggarna unleashes a barrage of psychic energy in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn as it is bombarded with nightmarish images. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Illusory Appearance
actions.description:
The heggarna covers itself with a magical illusion that makes it look like a Tiny cat. The illusion ends if the heggarna takes a bonus action to end it or if the heggarna dies. The illusion ends immediately if the heggarna attacks or takes damage, but it doesn't end when the heggarna uses Dream Eating.

The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the heggarna could appear to have fur, but someone touching it would feel its slippery flesh. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern the heggarna is disguised.

actions.name: Blood Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (5d8 + 3) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature with blood, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Call Blood
actions.description: Each creature with blood within 10 feet of the herald must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The herald then gains temporary hp equal to the single highest amount of necrotic damage dealt. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more also suffers one level of exhaustion.

bonusActions.name: Grant Blood Rage
bonusActions.description: The herald of blood infuses reckless rage in one creature it can see within 60 feet of it that isn't a Construct or Undead. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be enraged for a number of rounds equal to the target's Constitution modifier. While enraged, the target has advantage on all melee attack rolls, and attack rolls against it have advantage. When the rage ends, the target takes 13 (3d8) necrotic damage and suffers one level of exhaustion. A creature with any levels of exhaustion automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

name: Herald of Darkness (Tome of Beasts 2023)
spoken: herald of darkness tome of beasts 2023

display.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 30 ft., Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Made of Shadows (Shadow Form Only)
traits.description: The herald of darkness has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and can enter a hostile creature’s space and stop there. In addition, it can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Shadow’s Sight
traits.description: Magical darkness doesn’t impede the herald’s darkvision.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The herald of darkness makes two Embrace Darkness or Shadow Sword attacks.

actions.name: Embrace Darkness
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the herald's space. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Shadow Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Majesty of the Abyss
actions.description: The herald of darkness emits a sinister burst of infernal power. Each creature within 15 feet of the herald and that can see it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 27 (6d8) necrotic damage and is blinded for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more is also paralyzed until the end of its next turn. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Shape
bonusActions.description: The herald magically transforms into a Large shadow or back into its true form, which is a Fiend. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

display.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Corrupting Aura
traits.description: The calm emotions spell instantly fails when cast within 60 feet of the herald. In addition, any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the herald must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or grow hostile. On its turn, a hostile creature must move to and make one attack against the nearest creature other than the herald. If no other creature is near enough to move to and attack, the hostile creature stalks off in a random direction, seeking a target for its hostility. At the start of each of the herald’s turn, it chooses whether this aura is active.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
The herald’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect thoughts
3/day: charm person, fear, suggestion
1/day: modify memory, seeming

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The herald’s weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The herald can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The herald of slaughter makes three attacks: one with its gore and two with its cleaver. Alternatively, it can use Enkindle Hate twice. If it hits one target with Enkindle Hate twice using this action, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or use its reaction to immediately move up to half its speed and make one melee attack against a random target within range.

actions.name: Enkindle Hate
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Cleaver
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

display.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 50 ft. (hover), Swim 15 ft.
display.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, prone, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Annihilating Form
traits.description: Any object that touches or hits the herald of the Void vaporizes. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw to prevent the object from being vaporized. If the object is magical, the creature has advantage on the saving throw. The herald can choose to not vaporize an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the herald fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Zero-Dimensional
traits.description: The herald can move through any space without squeezing.

actions.name: Discorporate (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.description: The herald chooses up to two creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or become intangible until the end of its next turn. While intangible, the creature is incapacitated, drops whatever it's holding, and is unable to interact with physical objects. The creature is still visible and able to speak.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The herald makes two void claw attacks. Alternatively, it can use its Void Ray twice.

actions.name: Song of Mighty Doom (Costs 3 Actions)
actions.description: The herald emits a cacophonous dirge praising the Void. Each creature other than the herald within 30 feet of the herald and that understands Void Speech gains 10 temporary hp.

actions.name: Void Claw (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.description: The herald makes one void claw attack.

actions.name: Void Ray
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d8) cold damage and 9 (2d8) force damage.

actions.name: The Final Song
actions.description: The herald utters a melody of cosmic doom in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This melody doesn't affect creatures that understand Void Speech.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.description: The herald flies up to half its flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Void Claw
legendaryActions.description: The herald makes one void claw attack.

legendaryActions.name: Discorporate
legendaryActions.description: The herald chooses up to two creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or become intangible until the end of its next turn. While intangible, the creature is incapacitated, drops whatever it's holding, and is unable to interact with physical objects. The creature is still visible and able to speak.

legendaryActions.name: Song of Mighty Doom
legendaryActions.description: The herald emits a cacophonous dirge praising the Void. Each creature other than the herald within 30 feet of the herald and that understands Void Speech gains 10 temporary hp.

traits.name: Herd-Hidden (Herd Animal Form Only)
traits.description: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) and Cha (Deception) checks to blend into herd or convince those observing herd it is part of the herd.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: Has advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: One of the Herd
traits.description: A domesticated herd animal such as a cow horse sheep or chicken that can see the herd skulker treats it as a member of the herd regardless of the form skulker takes. When such an animal sees a herd skulker attack or feed it becomes immune to herd skulker’s One of the Herd for the next 24 hrs acting as it normally would when confronting a predator. Creatures immune to the charmed condition are immune to this.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.description: Transforms into a Large or smaller domesticated herd animal it can see such as a cow horse sheep or chicken or back into its true canine form. Its statistics other than its size are the same in each form. Reverts on death.

bonusActions.name: Nimble Escape
bonusActions.description: Takes the Disengage or Hide action.

display.damageResistances: cold, fire, lightning; damage from nonmagical weapons

traits.name: Chaotic Evil
traits.description: The hezrou radiates a Chaotic and Evil aura.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The hezrou has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hezrou makes one attack with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends  the target is restrained  and the hezrou can't bite another target.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The hezrou makes a bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits and the hezrou has not swallowed another creature  the target is swallowed and the grapple ends. A swallowed creature has total cover from attacks from outside the hezrou  it is blinded and restrained  and it takes 17 (5d6) ongoing acid damage while swallowed.

actions.name: If a swallowed creature deals 25 or more damage to the hezrou in a single turn, or if the hezrou dies, the hezrou vomits up the creature
Darkness
actions.description: Magical darkness spreads from a point within 30 feet  filling a 15-foot-radius sphere and spreading around corners. It remains for 1 minute  until the hezrou dismisses it  or until the hezrou uses this ability again. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

reactions.name: Stench
reactions.description: When hit by a melee attack, the hezrou emits a cloud of foul-smelling poison gas in a 20-foot radius. Each creature in the area makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature is poisoned for 1 minute. A creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success

display.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks, Demonic Resilience

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The hezrou can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Demonic Resilience
traits.description: The hezrou is resistant to cold, fire, and lightning damage. In addition, it is immune to poison damage and to the poisoned condition.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The hezrou has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Speak with Frogs and Toads
traits.description: The hezrou can communicate with frogs and toads as if they shared a language.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: The hezrou's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the hezrou must succeed on a DC 16 CON save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success, the creature is immune to the hezrou's Stench for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hezrou makes one Sticky Tongue attack, one Bite attack, and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8+4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sticky Tongue
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 STR save or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the hezrou.

bonusActions.name: Quick Leap
bonusActions.description: The hezrou jumps horizontally up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space it can see without provoking opportunity attacks.

display.damageImmunities: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Levitate
traits.description: As a bonus action, a hierophant lich can rise or descend vertically up to 20 feet and can remain suspended there. This trait works like the levitate spell, except there is no duration, and the lich doesn't need to concentrate to continue levitating each round.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: If it has a sacred vessel, a destroyed hierophant lich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hp and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the vessel.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description:
The lich is an 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The lich has the following cleric spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): guidance, mending, sacred flame, thaumaturgy
- 1st Level (4 slots): command, detect magic, protection from evil and good, sanctuary
- 2nd Level (3 slots): blindness/deafness, hold person, silence
- 3rd Level (3 slots): animate dead, dispel magic, spirit guardians
- 4th Level (3 slots): banishment, freedom of movement, guardian of faith
- 5th Level (1 slot): flame strike

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.description: The hierophant lich has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

actions.name: Damnation (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.description: The hierophant lich threatens one creature within 10 feet of it with eternal suffering. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the hierophant lich's Damnation for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Unholy Smite (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.description: The heirophant lich uses its Unholy Smite.

legendaryActions.name: Cantrip
legendaryActions.description: The hierophant lich casts a cantrip.

legendaryActions.name: Unholy Smite
legendaryActions.description: The heirophant lich uses its Unholy Smite.

legendaryActions.name: Damnation
legendaryActions.description: The hierophant lich threatens one creature within 10 feet of it with eternal suffering. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the hierophant lich's Damnation for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Ray of Frost
actions.description: (Cantrip; V, S) Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d8) cold damage  and the targets Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the nobles next turn.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: If the noble is wielding a melee weapon and can see their attacker, they add 2 to their AC against one melee attack that would hit them.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description:
The priest is an 11th level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15 +7 to hit with spell attacks). They have the following cleric spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): Light, Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy
- 1st-Level (4 slots): Ceremony, Detect Evil and Good, Healing Word
- 2nd-Level (3 slots): Augury, Hold Person, Zone of Truth
- 3rd-Level (3 slots): Daylight, Remove Curse
- 4th-Level (3 slots): Divination, Guardian of Faith, Revivify
- 5th-Level (2 slots): Flame Strike, Greater Restoration, Raise Dead
- 6th-Level (1 slots): Heal

actions.name: Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. On a hit  the priest can expend a spell slot to deal 7 (2d6) radiant damage  plus an extra 3 (1d6) radiant damage for each level of the spell slot expended above 1st.

actions.name: Sacred Flame
actions.description: (Cantrip; V, S) One creature the priest can see within 60 feet makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw  taking 13 (3d8) radiant damage on a failure. This spell ignores cover.

actions.name: Hold Person
actions.description: (2nd-Level; V, S, M, Concentration) One humanoid the priest can see within 60 feet makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is paralyzed for 1 minute. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Guardian of Faith
actions.description: (4th-Level; V) A Large  indistinct spectral guardian appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet and remains for 8 hours. Creatures of the priests choice that move to a space within 10 feet of the guardian for the first time on a turn make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw  taking 20 radiant or necrotic damage (high priests choice) on a failed save or half damage on a success. The spell ends when the guardian has dealt 60 total damage.

actions.name: Flame Strike
actions.description: (5th-Level; V, S, M) A column of divine flame fills a 10-foot-radius  40-foot-high cylinder within 60 feet. Creatures in the area make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw  taking 14 (4d6) fire damage and 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

bonusActions.name: Healing Word
bonusActions.description: (1st-Level; V) The priest or a living creature within 60 feet regains 6 (1d4 + 4) hit points. The priest can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.description: The pugilists AC equals 10 + their Dexterity modifier + their Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The pugilist attacks three times with their fists.

actions.name: Fists
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Grab
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends  the pugilist can't grapple a different target.

actions.name: Pin
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled creature. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage  and the target is restrained until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Body Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled creature. Hit: 20 (5d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage  and the grapple ends.

bonusActions.name: Haymaker
bonusActions.description: The pugilist attacks with their fists. On a hit, the attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage.

bonusActions.name: Head Shot
bonusActions.description: The pugilist attacks with their fists. On a hit, the target makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is stunned until the end of the pugilists next turn.

reactions.name: Opportune Jab
reactions.description: If a creature attempts to grapple the pugilist, the pugilist attacks that creature with their fists.

traits.name: Gullible
traits.description: The giant makes Insight checks with disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant attacks twice with its greatclub.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 16 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (6d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 16 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure. In lieu of a rock  the giant can throw a grappled Medium or smaller creature up to 30 feet. On a hit  the target and the thrown creature both take 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. On a miss  only the thrown creature takes the damage. The thrown creature falls prone in an unoccupied space 5 feet from the target.

actions.name: Greatclub Sweep
actions.description: Each creature within 10 feet makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure  a creature takes 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage  is pushed 10 feet away from the giant  and falls prone.

bonusActions.name: Grab
bonusActions.description: One creature within 5 feet makes a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the giant can't grab another target, and it makes greatclub attacks with advantage against the grappled target.

traits.name: Giant Attributes
traits.description: The hill giant is resistant to the stunned condition, and it is vulnerable to the prone condition.

traits.name: Show of Might
traits.description: The hill giant can use STR instead of CHA when making CHA (Intimidation) checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two Spiked Tree Branch or Rotten Snack attacks.

actions.name: Spiked Tree Branch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8+5) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Rotten Snack
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 CON save or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Body Bounce
bonusActions.description: The hill giant bumps its stomach, hip, shoulder, knee, or other part of its body into a creature within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 STR save or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the giant and knocked prone.

traits.name: Gullible
traits.description: The giant makes Insight checks with disadvantage.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 16 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (6d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 16 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure. In lieu of a rock  the giant can throw a grappled Medium or smaller creature up to 30 feet. On a hit  the target and the thrown creature both take 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. On a miss  only the thrown creature takes the damage. The thrown creature falls prone in an unoccupied space 5 feet from the target.

actions.name: Greatclub Sweep
actions.description: Each creature within 10 feet makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure  a creature takes 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage  is pushed 10 feet away from the giant  and falls prone.

bonusActions.name: Grab
bonusActions.description: One creature within 5 feet makes a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the giant can't grab another target, and it makes greatclub attacks with advantage against the grappled target.

bonusActions.name: Body Slam
bonusActions.description: The giant jumps up to 15 feet horizontally without provoking opportunity attacks and falls prone in a space containing one or more creatures. Each creature in its space when it lands makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and falling prone on a failure. On a success, the creature takes half damage and is pushed 5 feet to an unoccupied space of its choice. If that space is occupied, the creature falls prone.

bonusActions.name: Muddy Ground
bonusActions.description: Areas of unworked earth within 60 feet magically become swampy mud for 1 minute or until the giant dies. These areas become difficult terrain. Prone creatures in the area when the mud appears or that fall prone in the area make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the creatures Speed drops to 0 as it becomes stuck in the mud. A creature can use its action to make a DC 15 Strength check, freeing itself on a success.

bonusActions.name: Stomp
bonusActions.description: The giant stamps its foot, causing the ground to tremble. Each creature within 60 feet makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it falls prone.

traits.name: Aura of Misfortune
traits.description: Creatures within 15 ft. of it treat attack rolls of 20 as 19 and can’t gain advantage on ability checks attacks and saves.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: While hinderling curse remains on a victim a slain hinderling returns to life in 1 day regaining all its hp and becoming active again. Hinderling appears within 100' of victim.

bonusActions.name: Nimble Escape
bonusActions.description: Takes the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Run and Hide
reactions.description: When a creature hinderling can see targets it with weapon hinderling chooses another creature within 5 ft. as attack's target then moves up to half its speed with o provoking opportunity attacks.

display.speed: 30 ft., Burrow 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The hinn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the hinn doesn't disturb the material through which it moves.

traits.name: Nebulous (Cloud Form Only)
traits.description: The hinn's Stealth is 20, it can hover while flying, can't manipulate objects or attack, and it can pass through any space air can pass through without squeezing. In addition, it can enter and hide in any Tiny or larger container, such as a pouch, lamp, backpack, or barrel.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hinn makes three Gem-Studded Mace or Lob Stone attacks. If two Gem-Studded Mace attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 16 CON save or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Gem-Studded Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6+6) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Lob Stone
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10+6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Create Earth Elemental
actions.description: The hinn magically creates one earth-based Elemental of CR 5 or lower in an unoccupied space the hinn can see within 30 feet of it. The elemental acts as an ally of the hinn, obeying its spoken commands. The elemental remains for 1 hour, until the hinn dies, or until the hinn dismisses it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Travel the Planes
actions.description: The hinn transports itself to a different plane of existence. This works like the plane shift spell, except it can affect only itself and can't use this action to banish an unwilling creature.

bonusActions.name: Churned Earth
bonusActions.description: The hinn causes the ground on a point it can see within 60 feet of it to erupt. Each creature within 15 feet of that point must succeed on a DC 16 DEX save or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

bonusActions.name: Genie Shape
bonusActions.description: The hinn magically transforms into a Medium cloud of dust filled with miniscule clashing, bursting, and reforming rocks or back into its bipedal form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. It reverts to its bipedal form if it dies. The hinn can't use this bonus action to transform into its bipedal form while inside a Medium or smaller container.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The hippocampus can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Shared Breath
traits.description: The hippocampus's gills pull more air from the water than the hippocampus needs, expelling the excess as bubbles down its neck and across its back. If an air-breathing creature is riding the hippocampus, these bubbles can provide that creature a supply of fresh air when the hippocampus isn't in combat or traveling at a fast pace.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hippocampus makes one Bite attack and one Tail Slap attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail Slap
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) bludgeoning damage.

bonusActions.name: Rearing Kick
bonusActions.description: The hippocampus rears up and kicks its forelegs at one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 STR save or be knocked prone or pushed up to 10 feet away from the hippocampus (the hippocampus's choice).

display.speed: 40 ft., Climb 20 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 20 ft.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.description: The hippogriff has advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

display.speed: 40 ft., Climb 20 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 20 ft.

traits.name: Heightened Sight
traits.description: The hippogriff's Perception is 18 when perceiving by sight.

traits.name: Monstrosity Resilience
traits.description: The hippogriff is resistant to exhaustion and to the frightened condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hippogriff makes one Beak attack and one Claws attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Dive
bonusActions.description: While flying, the hippogriff dives onto a creature below it. The hippogriff moves at least 20 feet in a straight line toward a creature it can see. The target must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: Can hold its breath for 10 min.

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.description: Knows if it hears a lie.

traits.name: Divine Jaws
traits.description: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with Gore Gore deals extra 2d8 necrotic or radiant (included) hippo’s choice.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: Can hold its breath for 30 min.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

traits.name: Sacred Guardian
traits.description: Can pinpoint the location of an agent or worshiper of an opposing deity or a creature with ill intent toward its sacred site within 120' of itself. In addition it can sense when such a creature moves within 100' of the site and can sense general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of the site.

bonusActions.name: Protector's Step
bonusActions.description: Magically teleports with any items worn/carried up to 120' to unoccupied space within its sacred site or within 30' of exterior of its site. Golden light swirls or inky shadown tendrils (hippo's choice) appear at origin and destination.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Blood Scent
traits.description: Advantage on Wis (Perception) and Wis (Survival) checks to find or track a creature that doesn’t have all its hp.

bonusActions.name: Hidden Predator
bonusActions.description: Takes the Hide action.

display.speed: 25 ft., Climb 12 ft., Fly 40 ft., Swim 12 ft.

traits.name: Collective Mind
traits.description: The hivebound's individual insects and swarms under its control are connected via a hive mind. It can telepathically communicate with any of its individual insects and swarms within 1 mile of it, and it can't be surprised. It can have up to five swarms of insects under its control at a time.

traits.name: Monstrosity Resilience
traits.description: The hivebound is resistant to exhaustion and to the frightened condition.

traits.name: Reinforced Mind
traits.description: If the hivebound starts its turn afflicted by an ongoing effect that allows a repeated INT, WIS, or CHA save to end the effect, such as the hold spell, the hivebound can make the save at the start of the turn instead of the end and has advantage on the save.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hivebound makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, or it makes three Spit Insect attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8+3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4+3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spit Insect
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 DEX save or be pestered until the end of its next turn. A pestered creature has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the pester ends.

actions.name: Swarm Breath
actions.description: The hivebound exhales stinging insects in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 DEX save, taking 10 (4d4) piercing damage and 17 (5d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A swarm of insects under the hivebound's control then forms in an unoccupied space in that area.

bonusActions.name: Swift Flight
bonusActions.description: The hivebound flies up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Miser’s Fury
traits.description: The hoard drake knows the scent of every coin, gem and item of value in its hoard. The drake has advantage on Wisdom (Perception and Survival) checks to find and track its hoard. In addition, it has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if the creature is in possession of any portion of its hoard.

traits.name: Treasure Sense
traits.description: A hoard drake can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious metals and minerals, such as coins and gems, within 60 feet of it. In addition, it can differentiate between various types of metals and minerals and can determine if the metal or mineral is magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hoard drake makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Midas Breath
actions.description:
The hoard drake spits molten gold in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 36 (8d8) fire damage and the gold clings to it. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and the gold doesn't cling to it. A creature with gold clinging to it has its speed halved until it takes an action to scrape off the gold.

The gold produced by Midas Breath can be collected once it has cooled, providing roughly 50 gp worth of gold dust and scraps each time it spits molten gold.
